source: "We now have 4-month-old mice that are non-diabetic that used to be diabetic," he added.
reference: "Kamöe jinoe na tikoih umu 4 buleuen nyang hana diabetes nyang awaijih saket diabetes," geutamah le gobnyan.
hypothesis: "Kamoe jinoe na tikus umu 4 buleun nyang hana diabetes yang biasa jih diabetes", tambahnya.

source: Dr. Ehud Ur, professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia and chair of the clinical and scientific division of the Canadian Diabetes Association cautioned that the research is still in its early days.
reference: Dr. Ehud Ur, profesor kedokteran bak Universitas Dalhousie di Halifax, Nova Scotia ngôn keupala divisi klinis ngôn ilmiah dari Asosiasi Diabetes Kanada geupeuingat bahwa penelitian nyoe mantöng lam masa nyang keuphôn.
hypothesis: Dr. Ehud Ur, profesor kedokteran di Universitas Dalhousie di Halifax, Nova Scotia dan ketua divisi klinis dan ilmiah dari Asosiasi Diabetes Kanada geupeuingat bahwa penelitian nyan mantong bak awai.

source: Like some other experts, he is skeptical about whether diabetes can be cured, noting that these findings have no relevance to people who already have Type 1 diabetes.
reference: Lagèe ladom ureuëng caröng laenjih, gobnyan ragu peukeuh peunyaket diabetes jeut puléh, sabab nyang jiteumèe nyoe hana meusangkot deungôn ureuëng nyang ka meupeunyaket diabetes jeunèh 1.
hypothesis: Lagee padum-padum droe ahli laen, jih skeptis tentang peu jeut diabetes diubat, meunoe geupeugah bahwa penemuan nyo hana relevan untuk ureung nyang kaleuh na diabetes Tipe 1.

source: On Monday, Sara Danius, permanent secretary of the Nobel Committee for Literature at the Swedish Academy, publicly announced during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden the committee, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly about winning the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had abandoned its efforts to reach him.
reference: Bak uroe Senin, Sara Danius, sekretaris teutap Komite Nobel Sastra bak Akademi Swedia, geuumumkan ngôn bak mandum ureuëng lam masa program radio di Radio Sveriges di Swedia komite nyan, han jeuet meusambông deungôn Bob Dylan ngôn lansông teuntang keumenangan Hadiah Nobel 2016 lam Sastra, ka geupeutinggai usaha keu meusambông deungôn gobnyan.
hypothesis: Bak uroe Senin, Sara Danius, sekretaris permanen Komite Nobel untuk Sastra di Akademi Swedia, mengumumkan secara terbuka seulama program radio di Sveriges Radio di Swedia komite nyan, hana jeut meurumpok Bob Dylan secara langsung tentang meunang Nobel Prize 2016 dalam Sastra, ka geutinggai upaya untuk meurumpok jih.

source: Danius said, "Right now we are doing nothing. I have called and sent emails to his closest collaborator and received very friendly replies. For now, that is certainly enough."
reference: Danius kheun, "Jinoe kamöe hana meubuet sapeue. Lôn ka lôn talipun ngön lôn kirém email keu kolaborator gobnyan nyan paléng rab ngôn lôn teurimöng balah nyang paléng ruméh. Jinoe, nyan ka sep.
hypothesis: "Saboh uroe, awak nyan hana meupubuet, tapi awak nyan ka tahubungi dan ta kirem email keu rakan terdekat jih dan ka geuteurimong tanggapan nyang ramah. "

source: Previously, Ring's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, remarked the company started when his doorbell wasn't audible from his shop in his garage.
reference: Sigohlom gobnyan, CEO Ring, Jamie Siminoff, geukheun keu perusahaan phôn watèe bel pinto gobnyan han jeuet meudeungö dari keudèe gobnyan lam garasi gobnyan.

source: He built a WiFi door bell, he said.

source: Siminoff said sales boosted after his 2013 appearance in a Shark Tank episode where the show panel declined funding the startup.

source: While one experimental vaccine appears able to reduce Ebola mortality, up until now, no drugs have been clearly demonstrated suitable for treating existing infection.

source: One antibody cocktail, ZMapp, initially showed promise in the field, but formal studies indicated it had less benefit than sought in preventing death.
reference: Sabôh koktail antibodi, ZMapp, nyang awaijih peuleumah harapan lam lapangan nyan, teutapih studi formal jipeuleumah bahwa gunajih leubéh ubit nibak nyang tamita lam tatham mawot.

source: In the PALM trial, ZMapp served as a control, meaning scientists used it as a baseline and compared the three other treatments to it.
reference: Lam ujoe PALM, ZMapp meutugah sebagoe nyang peutimang, nyang maknajih awak ilmuwan geungui nyan sebagoe asai keu geubandéng lhèe macam cara peuubat nyang laen nibak nyan.

source: USA Gymnastics supports the United States Olympic Committee's letter and accepts the absolute need of the Olympic family to promote a safe environment for all of our athletes.
reference: Seunam AS dukong surat Komite Olimpiade Amerika Serikat ngôn teurimöng hai nyang bit jipeureulee le keuluwarga Olimpiade keu promosi mukim nyang aman keu bandum atlet kamöe.

source: We agree with the USOC's statement that the interests of our athletes and clubs, and their sport, may be better served by moving forward with meaningful change within our organization, rather than decertification.
reference: Kamöe pih teurimöng yang jipeugah dari USOC bahwa hai nyang peunténg dari atlet ngôn klub kamöe, ngôn olahraga awaknyan, jeut leubéh get geupeutimang ngôn grak u keue deungôn perobahan nyang meumakna lam organisasi kamöe, nibak desertifikasi.

source: USA Gymnastics supports an independent investigation that may shine light on how abuse of the proportion described so courageously by the survivors of Larry Nassar could have gone undetected for so long and embraces any necessary and appropriate changes.

source: USA Gymnastics and the USOC have the same goal — making the sport of gymnastics, and others, as safe as possible for athletes to follow their dreams in a safe, positive and empowered environment.

source: Throughout 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy as his advisor and then the Lyndon B. Johnson administration.

source: During the 1976 selections he advised Carter on foreign policy, then served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.

source: Late on Sunday, the United States President Donald Trump, in a statement delivered via the press secretary, announced US troops would be leaving Syria.

source: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.

hypothesis: Nyo hana hanya meukonfirmasi bahwa seutidak jih padum-padum boh dinosaurus na bulu, saboh teori yang kaleuh meutabu, tapi meujok detail fosil umumnya hana, lage warna ngen susunan lhee dimensi.

source: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.
reference: Awak ilmuwan kheun bulèe hewan nyoe meuwareuna coklat kastanye bak bagian ateueh ngôn bagian yup meuwareuna pucat atawa meuwareuna karotenoid.

source: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.

source: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
reference: Kareuna bulèe dinosaurus hana meubak nyang meukeumang ngôn get, nyang geuseubôt rachis, teutapi na ciri-ciri bulèe laenjih — duroë ngôn barbul — awak peneliti geucok ikhtisar bahwa rachis mungken nakeuh perkembangan evolusi leubéh hayeu dari ciri-ciri laen nyoe.
hypothesis: Kareuna bulu dinosaurus hana na poros nyang berkembang get, nyang dikhen rachis, teutapi na fitur bulu laen  barbs ngon barbules  para peneliti menyimpulkan bahwa rachis mungken merupakan perkembangan evolusioner yang leubeh beurakhir dari fitur laen nyo.

source: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
reference: Struktur bulèe geupeutunyok bahwa bulèe hana geungui watèe teureubang teutapih keu ato hawa atawa piasan. Awak peneliti geupeugah bahwa, bahpih nyoe nakeuh iku dinosaurus muda, sampel geupeutunyok bulèe dewasa ngôn kon aneuek manoek.
hypothesis: Struktur bulée nyan meupeunyata bahwa bulée nyan hana dipakek untuk terbang teuma keu mengatur suhu atawa keu geupeuleumah. Para peneliti meupeunyata bahwa, bah pih nyoe ek ek ek bak dinosaurus muda, sampel nyan meupeudeh bulu dewasa dan kon ek bak ayam.

source: The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
reference: Awak peneliti geupeunapat bahwa, bahpih nyoe nakeuh iku dinosaurus muda, sampel meupeutunyok bulèe dewasa ngôn kon aneuek manoek.

reference: Awaknyan geupeuteumèe Matauroe na ateuh ngôn prinsip asai nyang saban lagèe bintang laenjih: Aktivitas bandum bintang lam sistem geuteumèe geugeudra lé luminositasjih, rotasijih, ngôn hana nyang laen.

source: The smaller the Rossby number, the less active the star with respect to magnetic reversals.
reference: Semakén ubit numboi Rossby, semakén kureuëng aktif bintang nyan keu pembalikan magnet.

source: During his trip, Iwasaki ran into trouble on many occasions.

source: The Report opens with plea for open debate and the formation of a consensus in the United States about the policy towards the Middle East.
reference: Laporan geubuka ngôn peurmohonan keu dawa teubuka ngôn peumbeuntukan konsensus i Amerika Seurikat teuntang keubijakan keu Timu Teungöh.
hypothesis: Laporan nyan dipeuphon deungen meulakée keu perdebatan terbuka dan pembentukan konsensus di Amerika Serikat teuntang kebijakan terhadap Timur Tengah.

source: The Report is highly critical of almost every aspect of the present policy of the Executive towards Iraq and it urges an immediate change of direction.
reference: Laporan nyoe kritis that nibak karap tiep aspek keubijakan Eksekutif jinoe keu Irak ngôn meukarat peurubahan arah lam sigra.
hypothesis: Laporan nyan sangat kritis terhadap mandum aspek kebijakan eksekutif saat nyoe terhadap Irak dan mendesak perubahan arah langsong.

source: First among its 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be taken before the end of this year to secure Iraq’s borders against hostile interventions and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.
reference: Phôn antara 78 rekomendasi nyan keuh bahwa inisiatif diplomatik baro suwah geucok sigohlom akhée thôn nyoe keu geupeuaman peurbatasan Irak nibak intervensi peurmusuhan ngôn geupeudoeng lom sinambong diplomatic ngôn ureuëng lingkajih.
hypothesis: Nyang phon nibak 78 rekomendasi jih adalah bahwa inisiatif diplomatik baro haroh di peuget sigohlom akhe thon nyoe untuk meupeutahan perbatasan Irak dari intervensi musoh dan untuk meupeudong lom hubungan diplomatik deungen teutangga jih.

source: Current senator and Argentine First Lady Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner announced her presidential candidacy yesterday evening in La Plata, a city 50 kilometers (31 miles) away from Buenos Aires.
reference: Seunator jinoe ngôn Ibuk Nanggroe Argentina Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner geupeugoet maklumat peugoet dröe kandidat sebagoe presiden malam baroe i La Plata, kuta nyang jioh 50 kilometè (31 mil) nibak Buenos Aires.
hypothesis: Senator dan Ibu Negara Argentina Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner geupeutrok kandidat jih untuk jabatan presiden baroe malam di La Plata, saboh kota 50 kilometer (31 mil) dari Buenos Aires.

source: Mrs. Kirchner announced her intention to run for president at the Argentine Theatre, the same location she used to start her 2005 campaign for the Senate as member of the Buenos Aires province delegation.
reference: Nyonya Kirchner geupeugoet maklumat niet jih geupeugoet dröe kandidat sebagoe presiden i Teater Argentina, lokasi nyang sama ngôn nyang geungui keu geupeuphôn kampanye 2005 keu Seunat sebagoe anggeeta delegasi provinsi Buenos Aires.
hypothesis: Kirchner geupeutrang keurija jih untuk maju keu presiden di Teater Argentina, lokasi yang sama jih dipakek untuk memulai kampanye awak nyan keu Senat 2005 seubagoe anggota delegasi provinsi Buenos Aires.

source: The debate was sparked by controversy over spending on relief and reconstruction in the wake Hurricane Katrina; which some fiscal conservatives have humorously labeled "Bush's New Orleans Deal."
reference: Dawa geupicu le kontroversi ateuh peng tubiet keu bantuan ngön rekonstruksi oh lheuh Bade Katrina; nyang ladom konservatif fiskal geubri cap ngön lawak "Keusepakatan New Orleans Bush."
hypothesis: Peurdengarangan nyan dipeuphon le kontroversi teuntang pengeluaran bantuan dan rekonstruksi di seulanjut Hurricane Katrina; nyang na ureung konservatif fiskal yang geuboh nan "Deal New Orleans Bush".

source: Liberal criticism of the reconstruction effort has focused on the awarding of reconstruction contracts to perceived Washington insiders.
reference: Kritik liberal keu upaya rekonstruksi ka meufokus bak geubi kontrak rekonstruksi keu ureuëng i Washington nyang geuanggap.
hypothesis: Kritik liberal dari upaya rekonstruksi ka fokus bak pemberian kontrak rekonstruksi keu ureung yang dianggap ahli dalam Washington.

source: Over four million people went to Rome to attend the funeral.
reference: Leubeh nibak peuët juta ureuëng geujak u Roma keu teuka lam bhôm.
hypothesis: Leubeh nibak peuet juta ureuëng jijak u Roma keu teudjak bak upacara peukubu.

source: The number of people present was so large that it was not possible for everybody to gain access to the funeral in St. Peter's Square.
reference: Ramee that ureuëng nyang teuka sampöe hana mungkèn keu tiëp ureuëng meuteumèe akses u bhôm i Lapangan Santo Petrus.
hypothesis: Le that ureung nyang teuka sampoe hana mungken mandum ureung jeut tamong bak upacara peuratoran di Lapangan St. Peter.

source: Several large television screens were installed in various places in Rome to let the people watch the ceremony.
reference: Ladôm layeue tivi rayôek geupasang dum pat i Roma mangat ureuëng-ureuëng kalön upacara nyan.
hypothesis: Padum-padum boh layar televisi rayek dipeuduek di meubagoe teumpat di Roma mangat rakyat hase jikalon upacara nyan.

source: In many other cities of Italy and in the rest of the world, particularly in Poland, similar setups were made, which were viewed by a great number of people.
reference: Dumna jai kuta laèn i Itali ngôn ban sigom dônya, khasjih i Polandia, atôran nyang saban geupeugöt, nyang geungieng le ramee ureuëng.
hypothesis: Di le kota laen di Italia dan di laen nanggroe, terutama di Polandia, pengaturan serupa dipeuget, yang ditonton le le ureung.

source: Historians have criticized past FBI policies for focusing resources on cases which are easy to solve, especially stolen car cases, with the intent of boosting the agency's success rate.
reference: Seujarawan ka geutham keubijakan FBI nyang awai keu geupeuteuntè sumberdaya bak peukara-peukara nyang mangat lheueh, keu phön that peukara moto cue, ngôn heut keu meupeurayeuk tingkat meuhasè a’gèn nyan.
hypothesis: Seujarawan kaleuh geu kritik kebijakan FBI masa jameun untuk geu fokus sumber daya bak kasus yang mudah dipecahkan, terutama kasus mobil yang dicuri, deungen tujuan geu tingkatkan tingkat keberhasilan agensi.

source: Congress began funding the obscenity initiative in fiscal 2005 and specified that the FBI must devote 10 agents to adult pornography.
reference: Kongres geupeuphôn geubi peunayah inisiatif keucabulan bak thôn fiskal 2005 ngôn meupeuteutap bahwasajih FBI suwah geupeujôk 10 a’gèn keu pornografi ureuëng ka rayek.
hypothesis: Kongres mulai mendanai inisiatif obscenitas bak thon fiskal 2005 dan dipeutentei bahwa FBI harus mendedikasikan 10 agen untuk pornografi dewasa.

source: Robin Uthappa made the innings highest score, 70 runs in just 41 balls by hitting 11 fours and 2 sixes.
reference: Robin Uthappa peugöt nilai tingkat palèng manyang, 70 plueng sit lam 41 bohla ngôn geupéh 11 ​​peuët ngôn 2 nam.
hypothesis: Robin Uthappa peuget skor tertinggi dalam babak, 70 run lam 41 bola deungen meucang 11 boh peut dan 2 boh set.

source: Middle order batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, performed well and made a hundred-run partnership.
reference: Middle order batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar ngôn Rahul Dravid, deuh göt ngôn geupeugöt sinambông sireutôh -plueng.
hypothesis: Peumimpén tim yang di peugot gol, Sachin Tendulkar dan Rahul Dravid, geupeuget penampilan yang get dan geupeuget kemitraan 100 run.

source: But, after losing the captain's wicket India only made 36 runs loosing 7 wickets to end the innings.
reference: Teutapih, 'oh lheuh gadöh gawang kapten India geupeugöt 36 plueng sagai gadöh 7 gawang keu peuseuneulheuh babak.
hypothesis: Tapi, lheuh ka gadôh wicket kapten India hanya geupeuget 36 run ka gadôh 7 wicket untuk geupeuseuleusoe inning.

source: U.S. President George W. Bush arrived in Singapore the morning of November 16, beginning a week-long tour of Asia.
reference: Présidén AS George W. Bush teuka i Singapura beungöh tanggai 16 November, nyang peuphôn tur na meusigöe aleuhad i Asia.
hypothesis: Presiden AS George W. Bush troh di Singapura bak beungoh uroe 16 November, mulai siuroe siuroe di Asia.

source: He was greeted by Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister Wong Kan Seng and discussed trade and terrorism issues with the Singapore Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong.
reference: Jih geusambôt lè Wakie Peurdana Meuntröe Singapura Wong Kan Seng ngôn geupeugah peurdagangan ngôn terorisme deungôn Peurdana Meuntröe Singapura Lee Hsien Loong.
hypothesis: Jih disambut le Wakil Perdana Menteri Singapura Wong Kan Seng dan membahas masalah perdagangan dan terorisme deungen Perdana Menteri Singapura Lee Hsien Loong.

source: After a week of losses in the midterm election, Bush told an audience about the expansion of trade in Asia.
reference: Oh lheuh sialeuhad talôe lam peumilèh siteungöh watèe, Bush geukheun keu ureuëng nyang kalön hai peuluwah peurdagangan i Asia.
hypothesis: Lheuh seminggu ka hana le di pilkada paruh masa, Bush geupeugah bak ureung duek tentang ekspansi perdagangan di Asia.

source: Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to send the government's 'Clean Air Act' to an all-party committee for review, before its second reading, after Tuesday's 25 minute meeting with NDP leader Jack Layton at the PMO.
reference: Peurdana Meuntröe Stephen Harper ka sapue kheun keu geukirèm 'Clean Air Act' pömeuréntah u komite bandum pihak keu geukalön lom, sigöhlöm geubaca keuduwa jih, ‘oh lheuh meurumpok 25 minét uröe Seulasa ngôn syheh NDP Jack Layton di PMO.
hypothesis: Perdana Menteri Stephen Harper ka setuju untuk geukirem 'Undang-Undang Udara Bersih' pemerintah keu komite mandum partai untuk ditinjau, seugolom pembacaan kedua, lheuh pertemuan 25 menit seulaen pemimpin NDP Jack Layton bak PMO.

source: Layton had asked for changes to the conservatives' environmental bill during the meeting with the PM, asking for a "thorough and complete rewriting" of the Conservative party's environmental bill.
reference: Layton ka geulakée peurubahan bak qanun mukim konservatif watée meuteumée ngôn PM, "geulakée tulèh lömnyan mandum ngôn sampôrna" nibak qanunmukim Peurti Konservatif.
hypothesis: Layton ka geulakee perubahan keu rilis lingkungan partai konservatif seulama rapat deungen PM, geulakee "penulisan ulang secara menyeluruh dan lengkap" rilis lingkungan partai konservatif.

source: Ever since the Federal Government stepped in to take over funding of the Mersey hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal MPs have criticised this act as a stunt in the prelude to the federal election to be called by November.
reference: Mulapôn Pömeuréntah Federal teulibat keu cok lom peundanaan rumöh sakèt Mersey i Devonport, Tasmania, pömeuréntah nanggröe bahgian ngôn ladôm anggèeta parleumén federal ka geupeuteugah buet nyöe sebagöe geulagat awai nibak peumilèh federal nyang geu neuk peugöt bak buleuën November.
hypothesis: Seujak pemerintah federal meutanggong jaweueb keu meutanggong dana rumah sakit Mersey di Devonport, Tasmania, pemerintah negara bagian dan beberapa anggota parlemen federal telah mengkritik tindakan ini sebagai aksi dalam prelude untuk pemilu federal yang akan digelar pada November.

source: But Prime Minister John Howard has said the act was only to safeguard the facilities of the hospital from being downgraded by the Tasmanian government, in giving an extra AUD$45 million.
reference: Teutapi Peurdana Meuntröe John Howard ka kheun buet nyan sit keu kaloen beu gét teumpat rumöh sakèt mangat hana geutrôn peuringkat lè pömeuréntah Tasmania, ngôn geubri tamah AUD$45 juta.
hypothesis: Teuma Perdana Menteri John Howard geupeugah tindakan nyan hanya untuk geu lindong fasilitas rumah sakit dari dipeurendah le pemerintah Tasmania, deungon geubri tambahan AUD$45 juta.

source: According to the latest bulletin, sea level readings indicated a tsunami was generated. There was some definite tsunami activity recorded near Pago Pago and Niue.
reference: Meunuröt bulletin palèng barô, prakiraan laot meupeutunyôk tsunami kameuhasè. Na ladôm buet si uröe-uröe tsunami teuntèe nyang meutulèh rap Pago-Pago ngôn Niue.
hypothesis: Meunurot laporan terbaru, tingkat laot dipeutunyok tsunami dipeuget. na aktivitas tsunami pasti dicatat di sagoe Pago Pago dan Niue.

source: No major damage or injuries have been reported in Tonga, but power was temporarily lost, which reportedly prevented Tongan authorities from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the PTWC.
reference: Hana keurusakan rayek atawa ceudeura nyang geubri thèei i Tonga, teutapi listrèk len siat, nyang geubrithéei geupeu siblah pihak nyang mat kuwasaTonga teurimöng peuringatan tsunami nyang jipeutubiet le PTWC.
hypothesis: Hana na kerusakan atau luka-luka yang rayek di Tonga, tapi daya dipeugadeh sementara, yang dilaporkan meumungken pihak-pihak yang bertanggung jawab di Tonga untuk menerima peringatan tsunami yang dikeluarkan oleh PTWC.

source: Fourteen schools in Hawaii located on or near coastlines were closed all of Wednesday despite the warnings being lifted.
reference: Peuët blah sikula i Hawaii nyang na nibak atawa rap garèh pantè geutôp mandum uröe Rabu bahpih peuingat ka geucabôt.
hypothesis: Peuet blah boh sikula di Hawaii nyang na di atau rab ngon panté ditutup mandum uroe Rabu meskipun peringatan nyan di angkat.

source: U.S. President George W. Bush welcomed the announcement.
reference: Présidén AS George W. Bush geusambôt maklumat nyan.
hypothesis: Presiden AS George W. Bush geu sambot pengumuman nyan.

source: Bush spokesman Gordon Johndroe called North Korea's pledge "a major step towards the goal of achieving the verifiable denuclearization of the Korean peninsula."
reference: Juru peugah haba Bush, Gordon Johndröe, kheun janji Korea Utara seubagöe "langkah rayek u tujuan geupeusampöe denuklirisasi nyang jeut iverifikasi i seumeunanjung Korea."
hypothesis: Juru bicara Bush Gordon Johndroe geupeugah janji Korea Utara "saboh langkah rayek keu tujuan untuk mencapai denuklirisasi semenanjung Korea yang jeut dipastikan".

source: The tenth named storm of the Atlantic Hurricane season, Subtropical Storm Jerry, formed in the Atlantic Ocean today.
reference: Badé keu siploh nibak musèm badé Atlantik, badé Subtropis Jerry, teuka nibak Samudra Atlantik uröe nyôe.
hypothesis: Badai subtropis nyang keu siploh nyang na nan bak musem topan Atlantik, Jerry, geupeudong bak Laot Atlantik uroe nyoe.

source: The National Hurricane Center (NHC) says that at this point Jerry poses no threat to land.
reference: National Hurricane Center (NHC) kheun bahwa jinöe Jerry hana meubahya u darat.
hypothesis: Pusat Badai Nasional (NHC) geupeugah bahwa bak saat nyoe Jerry hana meukarat keu darat.

source: The U.S. Corps of Engineers estimated that 6 inches of rainfall could breach the previously damaged levees.
reference: Korps Insinyur AS geupeukira bahwa curah ujeuën 6 inci jeut teumbôh ateuëng nyang sigöhlöm nyan reulöh.
hypothesis: Korps Insinyur AS geuestimasi bahwa 15 cm ujeuen jeut ji peuglah bendungan yang ka rusak.

source: The Ninth Ward, which saw flooding as high as 20 feet during Hurricane Katrina, is currently in waist-high water as the nearby levee was overtopped.
reference: Bangsal keu Sikureuëng, nyang keunöng ie raya deungôn manyang 20 gaki lawèt badé Katrina, jinöe teudöng ie deungôn manyang bak keuieng sabab ateuëng nyang rab nyan meuruwah.
hypothesis: Kecamatan Sikureueng, nyang keunong banjir sampoe 6 meter bak watée Badai Katrina, jinoe lam ie sampoe bak pinggang kareuna bendungan di teukeulileng nyan ka ji leuh.

source: Water is spilling over the levee in a section 100 feet wide.
reference: Ie röe i ateuëh ateuëng nibak bahgian deungôn bideuëng 100 gaki.
hypothesis: Ié teungoh ji aboh di ateueh bendungan lam saboh bagian nyang luwah jih 100 feet.

source: Commons Administrator Adam Cuerden expressed his frustration over the deletions when he spoke to Wikinews last month.
reference: Administrator Commons Adam Cuerden geupeudeuh rasa frustrasijih ateuh jili nyan watée jih peugah haba ngôn Wikinews buleun ka leupah.
hypothesis: Peutaba Commons Adam Cuerden geupeugah frustasi jih ateuh penghapusan nyan bak buleun baroe bak Wikinet.

source: "He [Wales] basically lied to us from the start. First, by acting as if this was for legal reasons. Second, by pretending he was listening to us, right up to his art deletion."
reference: "Jih [Wales] nibak asaijih jimeusulèt keu tanyôe ka nibak phôn. Nyang phôn, ngôn geupuebuet sang-sang nyôe nakeuh keu daleh hukôm. Keduwa, ngôn meupura-pura jih deungö awak tanyôe, sampöe jili seunijih."
hypothesis: "Gobnyan [Wales] seucara mendasar membohongi kamoe dari awai. phon that, deungen meupeuget lagee nyoe untuk alasan hukum. keudua, deungen meupeuget jih deungo kamoe, sampoe jih tapeupupupuih karya jih".

source: The community irritation led to current efforts to draft a policy regarding sexual content for the site which hosts millions of openly-licensed media.
reference: Keulompok nyang palak nyan meuubah meuheut keu geurancang keubijakan meusangkôt kontenseksual keu situs nyang tampông meujuta media deungôn lisensi teuhah.
hypothesis: Keujadian nyan meuakibatkan upaya untuk meupeugot kebijakan tentang konten seksual untuk situs yang meupeutamah jutaan media yang dilisensikan secara terbuka.

source: The work done was mostly theoretical, but the program was written to simulate observations made of the Sagittarius galaxy.
reference: Keurija nyang geupubuet ladôm seucara teoretis, teutapi program nyôe geutulèh keu simulasi peungamatan nyang geupeugöt nibak galaksi Sagitarius.
hypothesis: Karya nyang dipeuget seubagian rayek teoritis, teutapi program nyan dituleh untuk ji simulasi pengamatan nyang dipeuget dari galaksi Sagittarius.

source: The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter.
reference: Efek nyang geumita keulompok nyan mungkén geupeuwap lè geulagat ék trôen nibak materi galaksi seupôt ngôn mateuri Bima Sakti seupôt.
hypothesis: Efek nyang ji mita tim nyan akan disebabkan le gaya pasang antara materi gelap galaksi ngon materi gelap Bima Sakti.

source: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.
reference: Saban lagèe buleuen nyang na gaya tarék keu bumoe, nyang geuakibat na geulumbang, meunan cit Bima Sakti bri gaya teunarék nibak galaksi Sagitarius.
hypothesis: Lage buleun meumungkenkan daya tarik bak bumoe, meumungkenkan pasang, meunan cit Bima Sagu meumungkenkan daya bak galaksi Sagitarius.

source: The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does.
reference: Awak meu’ileumée jeuet geupeukieh bahwa mateuri seupôt geupeuleumah mateuri seupôt laènjih deungôn cara nyang sama lagée mateuri biyasa.
hypothesis: Para ilmuwan jeut menyimpulkan bahwa materi gelap mempengaruhi materi gelap laen seucara yang sama lagee materi biasa.

source: This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.
reference: Tiori nyôe kheun bahwa ladôm mateuri seupôt i lingka galaksi na i lingka galaksi lam bagöe lingkaran cahya, ngôn meupeugöt nibak le partikel ubit.
hypothesis: Teori nyoe peugah bahwa sebagian rayek materi gelap di seukitaran saboh galaksi na di seukitaran saboh galaksi lam saboh macam halo, dan teupeuget dari le partikel ubit.

source: Television reports show white smoke coming from the plant.
reference: Laporan tivi meupeutunyok asap putèh nyang jitubiet nibak pabrèk.
hypothesis: Laporan televisi dipeudeh asap puteh nyang teuka dari peunula.

source: Local authorities are warning residents in the vicinity of the plant to stay indoors, turn off air-conditioners and not to drink tap water.
reference: Pömeuréntah i sinan geupeuingat ureue di lingka pabrèk keu tinggai lam rumöh, peumate AC ngôn bek jeb ie kran.
hypothesis: Peumeurintah lokal dipeugah penduduk di sekitar pabrik untuk tinggai di dalam rumoh, peunyet AC dan hana meminum ie keran.

source: According to Japan's nuclear agency, radioactive caesium and iodine has been identified at the plant.
reference: Meunurôt badan nuklir Jeupang, cesium ngôn yodium radioaktif ka geuidentifikasi i pabrèknyan.
hypothesis: Meunurot lembaga nuklir Jepang, cesium dan yodium radioaktif kaleuh diidentifikasi di peunula.

source: Authorities speculate that this indicates that containers holding uranium fuel at the site may have ruptured and are leaking.
reference: Nyang mat kuwasa meuspekulasi bahwa nyôe meupeutunyok bahwa kontainer nyang keubah bahan bakar uranium i teumpat mungkèn ka beukah ngôn tirèh.
hypothesis: Peumeurintah ji spekulasi bahwa nyoe meupeudeuh bahwa kontainer nyang na bahan bakar uranium di lokasi mungken ka meucrebre dan na bocoran.

source: Dr. Tony Moll discovered the Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the South African region KwaZulu-Natal.
reference: Dr. Tony Moll geuteumée Ubat Nyang Keubai That Keu Tuberkulosis (XDR-TB) di wilayah Afrika Seulatan KwaZulu-Natal.
hypothesis: Dr. Tony Moll meuteumee Tuberkulosis yang sangat tahan ubat (XDR-TB) di wilayah Afrika Selatan KwaZulu-Natal.

source: In an interview, he said the new variant was "very highly troubling and alarming because of the very high fatality rate."
reference: Lam saboh wawancara, göbnyan jikheun varian barô "peususah that ngôn peugöt ye sabab tingkat matèe nyang rayek that."
hypothesis: Lam saboh wawancara, jih peugah varian baro nyan "sangat meukarat dan meukarat karena tingkat kematian yang that tinggi".

source: Some patients might have contracted the bug in the hospital, Dr. Moll thinks, and at least two were hospital health workers.
reference: Ladôm ureuëng sakèt mungkèn meujangkèt peunyakèt nyan i rumöh sakèt, pikée Dr. Moll, ngôn nakeuh duwa peutugah keuséhatan rumöh sakèt.
hypothesis: Padim droe pasien mungken ka keunong bak virus nyan di rumoh sakét, geupike Dr. Moll, dan seutidak jih dua droe nyan adalah pekerja kesehatan rumoh sakét.

source: In one year's time, an infected person may infect 10 to 15 close contacts.
reference: Lam watée sithôn, ureuëng nyang teuinfeksi jeut geupeuinfeksi 10 sampöe 15 ureuëng nyang rab.
hypothesis: Lam jangka watee sithon, sidroe ureueng nyang keunong peunyakét nyan mungken ji peularat 10 sampoe 15 ureuëng nyang that rapat.

source: However, the percentage of XDR-TB in the entire group of people with tuberculosis still seems to be low; 6,000 of the total 330,000 people infected at any particular moment in South Africa.
reference: Teutapi, peurséntase XDR-TB bak bandum kawom nyang keunöng tuberkulosis deuhjih mantöng ubeut; 6.000 nibak mandum 330.000 ureuëng teuinfeksi bak meujan-jan watée i Afrika Seulatan.
hypothesis: Namun, persentase XDR-TB di mandum kelompok ureung yang na tuberkulosis teungeh lage nyan rendah; 6.000 dari total 330.000 ureung yang terinfeksi di wate tertentu di Afrika Selatan.

source: The satellites, both of which weighed in excess of 1,000 pounds, and traveling at approximately 17,500 miles per hour, collided 491 miles above the Earth.
reference: Satelit, nyang ban dua na brat leubeh dari 1.000 pon, ngon meugrak lam kecepatan silingka 17.500 mil per jeum, teupok 491 mil di ateueh Bumoe.
hypothesis: satelit, yang dua jih brat jih leubeh dari 1.000 pon, dan meugeurjalan deungen kecepatan kira-kira 17.500 mil/jam, tabrak 491 mil di ateuh bumoe.

source: Scientists say the explosion caused by the collision was massive.
reference: Ureueng meueleumee geukheun beureutoh nyan nyang teujadi sabab meupok nyan nakeuh beureutoh nyang raya that.
hypothesis: Para ilmuwan geupeugah ledakan nyang dipeuteuka le tabrakan nyan that rayek.

source: They are still trying to determine just how large the crash was and how the Earth will be affected.
reference: Awak nyan mantong geucuba geupeuteuntee ubena rayek meupok nyan ngon kiban Bumoe akan teupeungaba.
hypothesis: Awak nyan mantong ji coba untuk meuteumee padubna rayek jih tabrakan dan pakriban bumoe akan keunong.

source: The United States Strategic Command of the U.S. Department of Defense office is tracking the debris.
reference: Komando Strategis Amerika Serikat dari kanto Departemen Pertahanan AS teungoh geumita puing-puing nyan.
hypothesis: Panglima Strategis Amerika Serikat dari kantor Departemen Pertahanan Amerika Serikat teungoh geu teumeung peucrok pucok nyan.

source: The result of plotting analysis will be posted to a public website.
reference: Hase analisis plot akan geuposting bak situs publik.
hypothesis: Hasil analisis plot akan di pasang bak situs web publik.

source: A doctor who worked at Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania will be charged with aggravated murder after her mother was found dead in the trunk of her car Wednesday, authorities in Ohio say.

source: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope.
reference: Di Peurancih, peumungutan su seucara tradisional nakeuh peungalaman deungôn tehnologi miyup: peumiléh geupeusiblah lam bilék, geupeutamông si'ôn keureutaih nyang ka geucita nyang meupeutunyôk kandidat peumiléhan awaknyan lam baluëm.
hypothesis: Di Prancis, pemungutan suara secara tradisional adalah pengalaman teknologi rendah: peundi mengisolasi diri di dalam sebuah kios, menyoet lembar kertas yang dicetak sebelumnya yang menunjukan calon pilihan mereka ke dalam amplop.

source: After officials verify the voter's identity, the voter drops the envelope into the ballot box and signs the voting roll.
reference: ‘Oh lheuh peutugas geutilék löm identitas peumiléh, peumiléh geupeutamöng amplop u lam plôk su ngon geutèkèn jadôi peumiléh.
hypothesis: Lheuh peugawée-peugawée nyan geuverifikasi identitas peungundi, peungundi nyan geupeutron amplop lam kotak peungundi dan geutanda bak daftar peungundi.

source: French electoral law rather strictly codifies the proceedings.
reference: anun peumilu Peurancih geupeuatôe proses seucara keutat.
hypothesis: Hukom pemilu Prancis leubeh ketat mengkodifikasi prosedur.

source: Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters.
reference: Phôn thôn 1988, kutak su suwah transparan beujeuet peumiléh ngön peungamat geukalöen bahwa hana amplop bak awai peumungutan su ngön hana amplop nyang geutamah keucuwali ata peumiléh nyang ka geubileung ngön geubri kuwasa.
hypothesis: Nibak thon 1988, kotak pemungutan suara harus transparan sehingga peungundi dan pengamat jeut geu saksi bahwa hana amplop yang na bak awai pemungutan suara dan hana amplop yang ditamah kecuali amplop peungundi yang terhitung dan terwenang.

source: Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.
reference: Kandidat jeuet kirém geulantöe keu geukalöen tiep bahgian nibak proses. Bak malam uröe, su geubileung lé sukarelawan lam peungawasan nyang keutat, seutöet prosedur meuteuntèe.
hypothesis: Peunandita jeut geu kirem wakil untuk geu saksi mandum bagian proses. bak malam, suara dihitung le sukarelawan di miyueb pengawasan yang ketat, mengikuti prosedur khusus.

source: ASUS Eee PC, earlier launched world-wide for cost-saving and functionality factors, became a hot topic in 2007 Taipei IT Month.
reference: ASUS Eee PC, nyang sigohlömjih geupeutubiët banmandum dônya keu faktor peuhèmat bayeu ngônfungsionalitas, jeut keu töpik seu'um bacut i Buleuën IT Taipei 2007.
hypothesis: ASUS Eee PC, awai diluncurkan di seluruh donya untuk penghematan biaya dan faktor fungsionalitas, jeut keu topik hangat di Bulan TI Taipei 2007.

source: But the consumer market on laptop computer will be radically varied and changed after ASUS was awarded in the 2007 Taiwan Sustainable Award by Executive Yuan of the Republic of China.
reference: Teutapih pasai konsumen bak komputér laptop meubagöe macam that ngônmeuubah ‘oh lheuh ASUS geubri Bungôeng Jaröe sabé-sabé i Taiwan 2007 lé Eksekutif Yuan nibak Reupublik Cina.
hypothesis: Tapi pasar konsumen bak laptop akan bervariasi ngen meu ubah seulama ASUS dijok penghargaan Taiwan Sustainable Award 2007 le Executive Yuan Republik China.

source: The station's web site describes the show as "old school radio theater with a new and outrageous geeky spin!"
reference: Situs web stasiyôn nyan geugamba piasan nyan sebagöe "sandiwara radio sikula jemeun deungôn iputa jemeun nyang barô ngôn ayéb!"
hypothesis: Laman web stasiun nyan geu peutrang acara nyan seubagoe "teater radio sekolah tuha ngon putaran geeky nyang baro dan that-that galak!"

source: In its early days, the show was featured solely at the long-running internet radio site TogiNet Radio, a site focused on talk radio.
reference: Ak awai jih, acara nyoe geupeuleumah sagai bak situs radiô internet nyang ka trép meuöperasi, TogiNet Radio, saböh situs nyang meupusat bak radiô peugah haba.
hypothesis: Bak awai jih, acara nyan dipeuturi bak situs radio internet TogiNet Radio, saboh situs nyang fokus bak radio talk.

source: In late 2015, TogiNet established AstroNet Radio as a subsidiary station.
reference: Bak akhée thôn 2015, TogiNet ipeudöng Radio AstroNet sebagöe stasiyôn aneu' peurusahaan.
hypothesis: Bak akhe thon 2015, TogiNet geupeudöng AstroNet Radio seubagoe stasiun subsidier.

source: The show originally featured amateur voice actors, local to East Texas.
reference: Piasan nyôe awai jih geupeuleumah lé aktör su peumula, lokal u Texas Timuë.
hypothesis: Acara nyan awai jih na aktor suara amatir, lokal di Texas Timu.

source: Widespread looting reportedly continued overnight, as law enforcement officers were not present on Bishkek's streets.
reference: eunjarahan nyang meuluwah geubrithèe jisambông simalam, sabab peutugas peunegak hukôm hana teuka bak jalan-jalan Bishkek.
hypothesis: Peunjara nyang meuluah-luah nyan teutap terjadi seulama malam, karena peulisi hana di jalanan Bishkek.

source: Bishkek was described as sinking into a state of "anarchy" by one observer, as gangs of people roamed the streets and plundered stores of consumer goods.
reference: Bishkek geugamba ngôb lam keuadaan "anarki" lé peungamat, watèe tamôn ureuëng jak dum ho bak jalan-jalan ngôngeupeujarah keudè-keudè dabeuh konsumsi.
hypothesis: Bishkek dipeugah le sidroe pengamat seukitar jih ka lam keadaan "anarki" seudangkan geng ureung nyan ji keulileng jalan-jalan dan ji rampok toko-toko barang-barang konsumen.

source: Several Bishkek residents blamed protesters from the south for the lawlessness.
reference: Ladôm ureuëng gampông Bishkek geupeusalah peungunjôk rasa nibak seulatan ateuh meulanggéh hukôm.
hypothesis: Padum droe ureung Bishkek meudakwa ureung demo dari selatan nyang na salah bak pelanggaran hukum.

source: South Africa have defeated the All Blacks (New Zealand) in a rugby union Tri Nations match at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in Rustenburg, South Africa.
reference: Afrika Seulatan ka geupeutalôe All Blacks (Seulandia Barô) lam tandéng Rugby Union Tri Nations i Stadiön Royal Bafokeng i Rustenburg, Afrika Seulatan.
hypothesis: Afrika Selatan ka geupeutaloe All Blacks (New Zealand) lam pertandingan rugby union Tri Nations di Royal Bafokeng Stadium di Rustenburg, Afrika Selatan.

source: The final score was a one-point victory, 21 to 20, ending the All Blacks' 15 game winning streak.
reference: Nilai seuneulheuh nakeuh keumeunangan saböh pöin, 21 bandéng 20, nyang geupeuseuneulheuh 15 keumeunangan meuturôt-turôt All Blacks.
hypothesis: Skor akhir adalah kemenangan saboh poin, 21 untuk 20, meupeutôh All Blacks' 15 game menang beruntun.

source: For the Springboks, it ended a five-match losing streak.
reference: Keu Springboks, nyan geupeuseuneulheuh limôeng göe talôe meuturôt-turôt.
hypothesis: Untuk Springboks, nyan ka geupeuseuleusoe ronde keu limong laga.

source: It was the final match for the All Blacks, who had already won the trophy two weeks ago.
reference: Nyan nakeuh tandéng keuneulheueh keu All Blacks, nyang ka geupeumeunang piyala duwa aleuhad nyang ka leupah.
hypothesis: Nyan adalah pertandingan terakhir untuk All Blacks, yang kaleuh meunang trofi dua minggu yang ka leupah.

source: The final match of the series will take place at Ellis Park in Johannesburg next week, when the Springboks play Australia.
reference: andéng seueneulheuh nibak babak nyôe keuneuk ipuduëk i Ellis Park di Johannesburg aleuhadukeu watèe Springboks meu‘en lawan Australi.
hypothesis: Pertandingan final seri akan di lakukan di Ellis Park di Johannesburg minggu ukeu, wate Springboks meumeunaloen Australia.

source: A moderate earthquake shook western Montana at 10:08 p.m. on Monday.
reference: Geumpa biyasa meudali i Môntana barat bak pöh 22:08. Bak uröe Seulanyan.
hypothesis: Gempa bumi nyang moderat geumpa bagian barat Montana bak poh 22.08 uroe Senin.

source: No immediate reports of damage have been received by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and its National Earthquake Information Center.
reference: Hana laporan reulöh nyang geuterimông lé Survei Geologi Ameurika Seurikat (USGS) ngônPusat Informasi Geumpa Nasional.
hypothesis: Hana laporan kerusakan langsong yang diterimeng oleh Survei Geologi Amerika Serikat (USGS) dan Pusat Informasi Gempa Nasional jih.

source: The earthquake was centered about 20 km (15 miles) north-northeast of Dillon, and about 65 km (40 miles) south of Butte.
reference: Geumpa nyôe meupusat seulingka 20 km (15 mil) utara-timu la'ôt Dillon, ngôn seulingka 65 km (40 mil) seulatan Butte.
hypothesis: Gempa nyan teuduek sekitar 20 km (15 mil) utara-timur Dillon, dan sekitar 65 km (40 mil) selatan Butte.

source: The strain of bird flu lethal to humans, H5N1, has been confirmed to have infected a dead wild duck, found on Monday, in marshland near Lyon in the east of France.
reference: Jeunéh flu cicèm nyang peumatée manusiya, H5N1, ka geuteuntèe geupeujangkét iték kleuët nyang matée, nyang geuteumée bak uröe Seulanyan, i paya rap Lyon i timuë Peurancih.
hypothesis: Stam flu burung nyang jeut keu peunyakét manusia, H5N1, ka dipastikan ka ji peularat bebek liar nyang ka mate, nyang teume bak uroe Senin, di padang paya di rab Lyon di timu Prancis.

source: France is the seventh country in the European Union to suffer this virus; following Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece and Italy.
reference: Peurancih nakeuh nanggroe ketujôh i Uni Ierupa nyang keunöng virus nyoe; oh lheuh Austria, Jeurman, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Yunani ngön Itali.
hypothesis: Prancis adalah nanggroe keu tujoh di Uni Eropa nyang keunong virus nyoe; lheuh Austria, Jerman, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Yunani ngon Italia.

source: Suspected cases of H5N1 in Croatia and Denmark remain unconfirmed.
reference: Peukara dugaan H5N1 i Kroasia ngôn Denmark mantông gohlöm geuteuntèe.
hypothesis: Kasus-kasus yang diduga H5N1 di Kroasia dan Denmark manteng hana dipastikan.

source: Chambers had sued God for "widespread death, destruction and terrorization of millions upon millions of the Earth's inhabitants."
reference: Chambers ka tuntôt Tuhan ateueh "dum jai ureuëng meuninggai, ancoe ngôn terror meujuta-juta ureuëng i bumôe."
hypothesis: Chambers ka jituntut Allah keu "peumaté, keubinasaan, dan terorisasi jutaan-juta penduduk bumoe".

source: Chambers, an agnostic, argues that his lawsuit is "frivolous" and "anybody can sue anybody."
reference: Chambers, ureuëng agnostik, geupeutubiet haba bahwa gugatanjih "meuröh that" ngôn "dabeuh sibeurangkasoe pih jeut tuntôt dum soe ureuëng."
hypothesis: Chambers, sidroe agnostik, berpendapat bahwa gugatan jih "saboh nyang hana peunteng" dan "soe mantong jeut gugatan soe mantong".

source: The story presented in the French opera, by Camille Saint-Saens, is of an artist "whose life is dictated by a love for drugs and Japan."
reference: Kisah nyang geupeusaneut lam opera Peurancih, lé Camille Saint-Saens, nakeuh teuntang seuniman "nyang udépjih ipeuteuntèe lé galak atè bak narkoba ngôn Jeupang."
hypothesis: Kisah nyang diteubit lam opera Prancis, le Camille Saint-Saens, adalah tentang sidroe seniman "yang udep jih didikte le cinta keu narkoba ngen Jepang".

source: As a result, the performers smoke cannabis joints on stage, and the theatre itself is encouraging the audience to join in.
reference: Musababjih, awak nyang meu'en nyan geupiëp rukök ganja i ateueh panggông, ngôn sandiwara nyan keudröe geupeumeuheut ureuëng kalön keu meusapat.
hypothesis: Akibat jih, para pemain ngerokok ganja di panggung, dan teater keudroe mendorong penonton untuk bergabung.

source: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas governor Rick Perry, and Congresswoman Michele Bachmann finished in fourth, fifth, and sixth place, respectively.
reference: Enciet Cheh DPR Newt Gingrich, Gubernur Texas Rick Perry, ngôn Anggauta Kongres Michele Bachmann maséng-maséng geu duek nibak keupeuet, keulimöng, ngôn keunam.
hypothesis: Bek Ketua DPR Newt Gingrich, Gubernur Texas Rick Perry, dan anggota Kongres Michele Bachmann di peuseuleusoe di posisi keempat, limong, dan nam, seucara berurutan.

source: After the results came in, Gingrich lauded Santorum, but had tough words for Romney, on whose behalf negative campaign advertisements were aired in Iowa against Gingrich.
reference: Oh lheuh haséjih tamong, Gingrich geupeupujoe Santorum, teutapih na kalimah gasa keu Romney, nyang ateuh nan soe iklan kampanye hana get geupeudeuh nibak Iowa meulawan Gingrich.
hypothesis: Lheuh hasil election, Gingrich pujoe Santorum, tapi na haba keras keu Romney, yang keu jih iklan kampanye negatif dipileh di Iowa keu Gingrich.

source: Perry stated that he would "return to Texas to assess the results of tonight's caucus, determine whether there is a path forward for myself in this race", but later said that he would remain in the race and compete in the January 21 South Carolina primary.
reference: Perry kheun bahwa jih neuk "jibalék u Texas keu geupeuyum hasé kaukus malam nyoe, geupeuteuntèe pue keuh na jalan ukeu keu lôn lam meulet nyoe", teutapi oh lheuh nyan geukheun bahwa jih neuk teutap nibak meulét ngön meusaing bak 21 Januari primer Carolina Seulatan.
hypothesis: Perry geupeugah bahwa jih akan "meugisa u Texas untuk meunjo hasil caucus malam nyoe, untuk menentukan peu na jalan maju untuk droe jih dalam balapan nyoe", tapi lheuh nyan geupeugah bahwa jih akan teutap dalam balapan dan bersaing di primary Carolina Selatan 21 Januari.

source: Bachmann, who won the Ames Straw Poll in August, decided to end her campaign.
reference: Bachmann, nyang meunang Ames Straw Poll bak buleuen Agustus, geuputoh keu geupeuakhée kampanyejih.
hypothesis: Bachmann, nyang meunang Ames Straw Poll bak buleuen Agustus, ka geupike untuk geupeuputôh kampanye jih.

source: The photographer was transported to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he subsequently died.
reference: Fotografer nyan geuba u Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, teumpat jih alheuh nyan meninggai.
hypothesis: Fotografer nyan ji angkot u Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, di pat jih lheuh nyan meuninggai donya.

source: He was reportedly aged in his 20s. In a statement, Bieber said "[w]hile I was not present nor directly involved with this tragic accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the family of the victim."
reference: Jih geubrithèe meuumu 20-an. Lam sabôh peunutoe, Bieber kheun "[adakpih] lôn hana teuka atawa meulibat lansông ngôn meupok tragis nyoe, pikéran ngôn do’a lôn keu keuluwarga keureubeuen."
hypothesis: Lam saboh pernyataan, Bieber geupeugah bahwa "meskipun ulon hana hadir atawa terlibat secara langsung bak kecelakaan tragis nyoe, pikeran dan doa lon na deungen keluarga korban".

source: Entertainment news website TMZ understands the photographer stopped his vehicle on the other side of Sepulveda Boulevard and attempted to take pictures of the police stop before crossing the road and continuing, prompting the California Highway Patrol police officer conducting the traffic stop to order him back across, twice.
reference: Situs web haba hiburan TMZ pham bahwa fotografer geupeudong kandra jih bak sagoe laen Sepulveda Boulevard ngôn cuba cok gamba peuneudong pulisi sigohlom geupeusibrang jalan ngôn geupeulanjut, geutulak petugas pulisi Patroli Jalan Raya California nyang teungoh geupeudong lalu lintah keu mueyue jih gisa geupeusibrang, duwa gö.
hypothesis: Laman berita hiburan TMZ meuphom bahwa peugöt foto nyan geupiôh bak saboh sagoe Sepulveda Boulevard dan geumita geumita foto polisi seugolom geukeupoh jalan dan geulanjutkan, nyang geu paksa polisi California Highway Patrol nyang peuget peugöt lalu lintas untuk geuyue jih woe lom, dua goe.

source: According to police, the driver of the vehicle that hit the photographer is unlikely to face criminal charges.
reference: Meunurot pulisi, pengemudi kandra nyang geupeupo fotografer nyan hana mungken teurimöng tuntutan pidana.
hypothesis: Meunurot polisi, sopir kendaraan nyang jipok fotografer hana mungken jihadapi dakwa pidana.

source: With only eighteen medals available a day, a number of countries have failed to make the medal podium.
reference: Ngôn lapan blah medali sagai nyang meuseudia siuroe, padum bôh nanggroe han jeut geupeureueh podium meudali.
hypothesis: Deungen hanya lapan blah medali nyang na bak tiep uroe, padum-padum boh nanggroe hana meuhase jeut keu podium medali.

source: They include the Netherlands, with Anna Jochemsen finishing ninth in the women's standing class in the Super-G yesterday, and Finland with Katja Saarinen finishing tenth in the same event.
reference: Awaknyan teumasok Belanda, deungôn Anna Jochemsen nyang geuduek keusik ureuëng lam glah dong inöng nibak Super-G baroe, ngôn Finlandia deungôn Katja Saarinen nyang geuduek-geuduek keusiplôh lam acara nyang sama.
hypothesis: Teumasok Beulanda, deungen Anna Jochemsen finish keu sikureueng di kelas berdiri wanita di Super-G baroe, dan Finlandia deungen Katja Saarinen finish keu siploh di acara yang sama.

source: Australia's Mitchell Gourley finished eleventh in the men's standing Super-G. Czech competitor Oldrich Jelinek finished sixteenth in the men's sitting Super-G.
reference: Awak nyang meu’èn tenis Australia Mitchell Gourley geuduek keuseblah lam Super-G döng agam. Pesaing Ceko, Oldrich Jelinek, finis bak posisi keuenam blah lam kategori duek Super-G agam.
hypothesis: Mitchell Gourley dari Australia ke-11 di Super-G berdiri. Oldrich Jelinek dari Ceko ke-16 di Super-G duduk.

source: Arly Velasquez of Mexico finished fifteenth in the men's sitting Super-G. New Zealand's Adam Hall finished ninth in the men's standing Super-G.
reference: Arly Velasquez nibak Meksiko geuduek keulimöng blah lam Super-G duek agam. Adam Hall nibak Selandia Baroe geuduek keusik ureuëng lam Super-G döng agam.
hypothesis: Arly Velasquez dari Meksiko tamat keudjeumeulhee blah lam Super-G jiduek ureung agam. Adam Hall dari Selandia Baru tamat keudjeumeulhee lam Super-G jidong ureung agam.

source: Poland's men's visually impaired skier Maciej Krezel and guide Anna Ogarzynska finished thirteenth in the Super-G. South Korea's Jong Seork Park finished twenty-fourth in the men's sitting Super-G.
reference: Awak nyang meu’èn ski agam dari Polandia nyang han jeut eu, Maciej Krezel, ngön pemandu Anna Ogarzynska geuduek keulhèe blah bak Super-G. Jong Seork Park dari Korea Seulatan geuduek keuduwa plôh peuet bak Super-G duek agam.
hypothesis: Peulisi buta mata Polandia Maciej Krezel dan pemandu Anna Ogarzynska keulhee blah di Super-G. Jong Seork Park Korea Selatan keulhee blah peuet di Super-G jiduek.

source: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment.
reference: Teuntra kawai dame PBB, nyang troh di Haiti lheueh gempa bumoe thon 2010, geupeusalah ateueh geusebarjih peunyaket nyang dimulai di toe kimah pasukan nyan.
hypothesis: Peutahanan perdamaian PBB, nyang troh u Haiti lheuh geumpa bumoe thon 2010, dipeudakwa seubab peunyaket peunyaket nyan nyang phon di teukeupong pasukan nyan.

source: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.
reference: Meunurot gugatan nyan, broh dari kimah PBB hana dipeugleh ngon beutoi, nyang peugot bakteri tamong u aneuk krueng Artibonite, salah saboh krueng nyang paleng rayeuk di Haiti.
hypothesis: Meunurot gugatan, limbah dari kamp PBB hana disinfeksi seucara nyang paih, nyang menyebabkan bakteri jitamong u silur sungai Artibonite, salah saboh nyang paleng rayeuk di Haiti.

source: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.
reference: Sigohlom pasokan troh, Haiti hana keunong masalah sapeue nyang teukaet ngon peunyaket nyan dari thon 1800-an.
hypothesis: Sigohlom pasukan teuka, Haiti hana meurumpok masalah nyang na hubongan ngon peunyaket nyan seujak thon 1800-an.

source: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.
reference: Institut Keadilan ngon Demokrasi Haiti ka mengacu pada studi independen nyang geupeugah bahwa batalion kawai dame PBB Nepal hana geuthei geuba peunyaket nyan u Haiti.
hypothesis: Institut Keadilan dan Demokrasi Haiti ka geucatat saboh studi independen nyang geu sarankan pasukan peudamé PBB Nepal hana sadar geuba peunyaket nyan u Haiti.

source: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
reference: Danielle Lantagne, paka PBB keu peunyaket nyan, meukheun bahwa wabah nyan mungken jipeuseubab le teuntra kawai dame nyan.
hypothesis: Danielle Lantagne, ahli PBB tentang penyakit nyan, geupeugah wabah nyan mungken dipeuteuka le peutahanan perdamaian.

source: Hamilton confirmed Howard University Hospital admitted the patient in stable condition.
reference: Hamilton geupeuteuntèe bahwa Rumoh Sakét Universitas Howard teurimoeng ureueng sakét lam kondisi stabil.
hypothesis: Hamilton geu konfirmasi bahwa Rumah Sakit Universitas Howard geu peutamong pasien lam kondisi stabil.

source: The patient had been to Nigeria, where some cases of the Ebola virus have occurred.
reference: Ureueng sakét tom u Nigeria, teumpat ladom peukara virus Ebola ka meudali.
hypothesis: Pasien nyan ka geujak u Nigeria, di pat na padum-padum boh kasus virus Ebola.

source: The hospital has followed protocol for infection control, including separating the patient from others to prevent possible infection of others.
reference: Rumoh sakét ka ipateh protokol peungeundalian infeksi, teumasok geupeuaséng ureueng sakét nibak ureueng laén keu geuhindar keumungkénan infeksi ureueng laén.
hypothesis: Rumah sakit ka geuturot protokol untuk ngontrol infeksi, termasuk memisahkan pasien dari ureung laen untuk mencegah kemungkinan infeksi ureung laen.

source: Before The Simpsons Simon had worked on several shows in various positions.
reference: Sigohlom The Simpsons Simon ka keurija i ladom piasan bak macam posisi.
hypothesis: Sigohlom The Simpsons Simon ka geulaku bak padum-padum boh acara bak padum-padum boh posisi.

source: During the 1980s he worked on shows such as Taxi, Cheers, and The Tracy Ullman Show.
reference: Seulama thôn 1980-an gobnyan keurija bak acara-acara lagèe Taxi, Cheers, ngön The Tracy Ullman Show.
hypothesis: Lam thon 1980-an jih bekerja bak acara lagee Taxi, Cheers, dan The Tracy Ullman Show.

source: In 1989 he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and was responsible for hiring the show's first writing team.
reference: Bak thôn 1989 gobnyan geutulông geupeugöt The Simpsons seureuta Brooks ngön Groening, ngön meutanggong jaweueb ateuh geupeukeurija tim teumuleh phôn piasan nyan.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1989 jih membantu peuget The Simpsons deungen Brooks ngen Groening, dan bertanggung jawab untuk menyewa tim penulis pertunjukan.

source: Despite leaving the show in 1993 he kept the title of executive producer, and continued to receive tens of millions of dollars every season in royalties.
reference: Bahpih geupeutinggai piasan bak thôn 1993 gobnyan geupeutheun geular produser eksekutif, ngön mantöng teurimoeng meuplôh juta dolar tiep musem lam beuntuk royalti.
hypothesis: Meskipun geutinggai acara bak thon 1993 jih dipeutahankan jabatan produser eksekutif, dan terus geuteurimong puluhan juta dolar setiap musim sebagai royalti.

source: Earlier the Chinese news agency Xinhua reported a plane to be hijacked.

source: Four skiers in the women's sitting group failed to finish their runs, and 45 of the 117 total skiers in the Giant Slalom failed to rank in the race.
reference: Peuet ureueng meu’èn ski bak kawom duek inöng hana wasé geupeuseuleusoe plueng awak nyan, ngön 45 nibak 117 mandum ureueng meu’èn ski i Giant Slalom hana meuhasé geucok lam reugam peuringkat lam tandéng.
hypothesis: Lhee droe pemain ski di grup jiduek inong hana meuhase seuleusoe peulisi jih, dan 45 dari 117 total pemain ski di Slalom Raksasa hana meuhase dipeuteubiet di pacu.

source: The Madhya Pradesh Police recovered the stolen laptop and mobile phone.
reference: Pulisi Madhya Pradesh geuteumèe laptop ngön talipun geunggam nyang icue.
hypothesis: Polisi Madhya Pradesh ka jiteumé laptop ngon handphone nyang ji cue.

source: Deputy Inspector General D K Arya said, "We have arrested five persons who raped the Swiss woman and recovered her mobile and laptop".
reference: Wakie Inspektur Jendeural D K Arya geukheun, "Kamoe ka drob limong droe ureueng nyang reupaih inöng Swiss ngön geupeupuleh talipun ngön laptopjih".
hypothesis: Wakil Inspektur Jenderal D.K. Arya geupeugah, "Kamoe ka kamoe tanggong limong droe nyang teugadoh inong Swiss nyan dan kamoe cok hape ngon laptop jih".

source: The accused are named as Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar and Vishnu Kanjar.
reference: Teurdakwa nyan nakeuh Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar ngön Wisnu Kanjar.
hypothesis: Teumudoh nyan nan jih Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar dan Vishnu Kanjar.

source: Police superintendent Chandra Shekhar Solanki said the accused appeared in court with covered faces.
reference: Inspektur pulisi Chandra Shekhar Solanki geukheuen teurdakwa teuka i peungadilan ngön deungön meutop muka.
hypothesis: Supertendent polisi Chandra Shekhar Solanki geupeugah terdakwa tampil di pengadilan deungon muka nyang teutôb.

source: Although three people were inside the house when the car impacted it, none of them were hurt.
reference: Bahpih na lhèe ureueng lam rumoh watèe moto ipeupoekjih, hana nibak awak nyan nyang luka.
hypothesis: Meskipun lhee droe na di dalam rumoh watee mobil nyan keunong, hana sidroe pih dari awak nyan nyang luka.

source: However, the driver sustained serious injuries to the head.
reference: Tapi, ureueng mèe moto brat that lut bakulèe.
hypothesis: Namun, supir nyan keunong luka parah bak ulée.

source: The road where the crash happened was temporarily closed while emergency services freed the driver from the red Audi TT.
reference: Jalan dipat musibah nyan teujadi geutop siat seumeuntara layanan darurat geupeuhah keu ureueng mèe moto nibak Audi TT mirah.
hypothesis: Jalan di pat na kecelakaan nyan sementara ditutup sementara layanan darurat dipeubeubaih sopir dari Audi TT mirah.

source: He was initially hospitalised in the James Paget Hospital in Great Yarmouth.
reference: Gobnyan awaijih ipeuubat bak Rumoh Sakét James Paget i Great Yarmouth.
hypothesis: Jih awai jih di rumoh sakit di Rumah Sakit James Paget di Great Yarmouth.

source: He was subsequently relocated to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge.
reference: Gobnyan dudoe ipinah u Rumoh Sakét Addenbrooke i Cambridge.
hypothesis: Jih lheuh nyan ji pindahkan u Rumah Sakit Addenbrooke di Cambridge.

source: Adekoya has since been in Edinburgh Sheriff Court charged with murdering her son.
reference: Adekoya mulaphôn nyan ka bak Peungadilan Sheriff Edinburgh deungön itudoh geupohmaté aneuk agamjih.
hypothesis: Adekoya ka di pengadilan Edinburgh nyang jitudoh jipoh maté aneuk jih.

source: She is in custody pending indictment and trial, but any eyewitness evidence may be tainted because her image has been widely published.
reference: Gobnyan geutheun sira geupréh dakwaan ngön peursidangan, tapi bukti saksi mata mungkén jeuet reuloh sabab citra gobnyan ka geupublikasi seucara luwah.
hypothesis: Jih na dalam tahanan seulama teungeh dakwa dan sidang, tapi bukti saksi mata mungken ka tercemar kareuna gamba jih ka ji publikasi secara luah.

source: This is common practice elsewhere in the UK but Scottish justice works differently and courts have viewed publication of photos as potentially prejudicial.
reference: Nyoe nakeuh praktik umum bak teumpat laén i Inggreh, tapi peuradilan Skotlandia keurija seucara meubeda ngön peungadilan geupandang publikasi foto na keukuatan peurugoe.
hypothesis: Nyo biasa di nanggroe Inggris, tapi keadilan Skotlandia bekerja beda dan pengadilan ka melihat publikasi foto sebagai berpotensi berdampak negatif.

source: Professor Pamela Ferguson of the University of Dundee notes "journalists do seem to be walking a dangerous line if publishing photos etc of suspects."
reference: Profesor Pamela Ferguson nibak University of Dundee geutuleh "wartawan deuh ijak bak ruweueng nyang meubahaya meunyô geupeuteubiet foto-foto teusangka, dsj."
hypothesis: Profesor Pamela Ferguson dari Universitas Dundee geupeugah "peulisi deuh jih teungoh geujak bak gareh nyang berbahaya jika jipeutubit foto dll tersangka".

source: Crown Office, which is in overall charge of prosecutions, has indicated to journalists that no further comment will be made at least until indictment.
reference: Kantoe Mahkota, nyang mandum geutenggong jaweub ateuh penuntotan, ka keu wartawan bahwa hana haba leubèh ukeu lom nyang geuneuk peugöt seukureungjih sampoe dakwaan.
hypothesis: Kantor Mahkota, nyang bertanggung jawab untuk tuntutan hukum, ka geutunyok bak wartawan bahwa hana komentar leubèh le akan geupeuget seulama dakwa.

source: The document, according to the leak, will refer to the borders dispute, which Palestine wants based on the borders before the 1967 Mideast War.
reference: Dokumen nyan, meunurot bocoran, geucok peudoman bak karu peurbatasan, nyang meuheut Palestina meunurot peurbatasan sigohlom Prang Timu Teungoh 1967.
hypothesis: Dokumen nyan, meunurot bocoran, akan meuhubong keu peukara perbatasan, nyang Palestina keuneuk berdasarkan perbatasan sigohlom prang 1967 di Timur Tengah.

source: Other topics covered reportedly include the future state of Jerusalem which is sacred to both nations and the Jordan Valley issue.
reference: Topik laén nyang geubrithèe teumasok keuadaan masa ukeu Yerusalem nyang suci keu banduwa nanggroe ngön peukara Leumbah Yordan.
hypothesis: Bahsa-bahsa laen nyang ji teume nyan na kheueh masa ukeue Yerusalem nyang suci keu bandua bansa dan masalah Lembah Yordan.

source: Israel demands an ongoing military presence in the valley for ten years once an agreement is signed while the PA agrees to leave such presence only for five years.
reference: Israel geulakee teuntra militer keujaga panton nyan nibak siplôh thôn lheuh keuseupakatan geuteken seumeuntara PA seupakat keu geupeutinggai panton nyan keu nibak limong thôn sagai.
hypothesis: Israel meungaku akan kehadiran militer di lembah nyan selama siploh thon setelah kesepakatan ditandatangani sementara PA setuju untuk tinggai kehadiran nyan hanya selama limong thon.

source: Shooters in the supplementary pest control trial were to be closely supervised by rangers, as the trial was monitored and its effectiveness evaluated.
reference: P Teumimbak lam ujoe cuba peungeundalian hama geutamah suwah geungieng seucara keutat lé peunjaga uteuen, sabab ujoe cuba geukaloen ngön efektivitasjih geuevaluasi.
hypothesis: Peulisi lam uji coba peumaté hama tambahan harus di pantau teuliti le peungawai hutan, karena uji coba di pantau dan efektifitas jih dievaluasi.

source: In a partnership of NPWS and the Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, qualified volunteers were recruited, under the Sporting Shooters Association's hunting program.
reference: Lam keurija sama NPWS ngön Asosiasi Peunembak Ulahraga Australi (NSW) Inc, sukarelawan nyang geupeupeunoh syarat geurekrut, imiyup program peurburuan Asosiasi Peunembak Ulahraga.
hypothesis: Lam saboh kemitraan NPWS ngon Asosiasi Penembak Olahraga Australia (NSW) Inc, sukarelawan nyang layak direkrut, lam program perburuan Asosiasi Penembak Olahraga.

source: According to Mick O'Flynn, the Acting Director Park Conservation and Heritage with the NPWS, the four shooters selected for the first shooting operation received comprehensive safety and training instruction.
reference: Meunurot Mick O'Flynn, Peujabat Direktur Taman Konservasi ngön Waresan deungön NPWS, peuet droe ureueng timbaknyang geupileh keu opeurasi teumimbak phôn teurimoeng instruksi keuselamatan ngön peulatihan nyang komprehensif.
hypothesis: Meunurot Mick O'Flynn, Wakil Direktur Konservasi dan Warisan Taman di NPWS, peuet droe penembak nyang teupiléh untuk operasi penembakan phon jiteurimong instruksi keselamatan dan pelatihan yang komprehensif.

source: Martelly swore in a new Provisional Electoral Council (CEP) of nine members yesterday.
reference: Martelly geumeusumpah lam Dewan Peumilihan Simeuntara (CEP) barô nibak sikureueng anggota baroe.
hypothesis: Martelly geu sumpah lam Dewan Pemilihan Sementara (CEP) baro nyang na sikureueng droe anggota baroe.

source: It is Martelly's fifth CEP in four years.
reference: Nyoe nakeuh CEP keu limong Martelly lam peuet thôn.
hypothesis: Nyoe keuh CEP keulimong Martelly dalam peut thon.

source: Last month a presidential commission recommended the prior CEP's resignation as part of a package of measures to move the country towards new elections.
reference: Buleuen nyang ka leupah komisi keupresidenan geurekom peungunduran droe CEP sigohlomjih sebagoe bahgian nibak paket buet keu peugrak nanggroe u peumileh barô.
hypothesis: Buleuen baroe, komisi presiden geu rekomendasikan pengunduran diri dari CEP seugolom jih seubagoe bagian dari langkah-langkah untuk maju nanggroe u arah pemilu baroe.

source: The commission was Martelly's response to widespread anti-regime protests that started in October.
reference: Komisi nyan nakeuh haba Martelly keu proteh anti-rezim nyang meuluwah nyang geumulphôn bak buleuen Oktober.
hypothesis: Komisi nyan adalah tanggapan Martelly keu protes anti rezim yang meuluah yang dimulai bak buleun Oktober.

source: The sometimes-violent protests were triggered by failure to hold elections, some due since 2011.
reference: Proteh nyang meujan geuseureuta keukeurasan geupicu sabab hana wasé geupubuet peumileh, ladom antarajih mulaphôn 2011.
hypothesis: Protes nyang kadang-kadang keujam nyan dipeuteuka le gagal keu pemilu, sebagian jih diumumkan bak thon 2011.

source: Around 60 cases of malfunctioning iPods overheating have been reported, causing a total of six fires and leaving four people with minor burns.
reference: Silingka 60 peukara keurusakan iPod nyang that seuuem ka geubrithèe, musabab mandum nam droe ureueng tutoeng ngön musabab peuet droe ureueng keunoeng lut tutoeng bacut.
hypothesis: Na kira-kira 60 kasus iPod nyang hana meuguna nyang brat that, sampoe total jih nam droe keunong apui dan peuet droe luka luka ubit.

source: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said that it had been aware of 27 accidents related to the devices.
reference: Keumeunteurian Ekonomi, Peurdagangan, ngön Industri (METI) Jeupang geukheuen ka itupue 27 keuceulakaan nyang meusangkot deungön peurangkat nyan.
hypothesis: Kementerian Ekonomi, Perdagangan dan Industri Jepang (METI) geupeugah bahwa awak nyan ka jiteupeue 27 kecelakaan nyang terkait deungen alat-alat nyan.

source: Last week, METI announced that Apple had informed it of 34 additional overheating incidents, which the company called "non-serious."
reference: Peukan nyang ka leupah, METI geuumum bahwa Apple ka geubrithèe teuntang 34 keujadian seuum meuleubèh tamah, nyang geukheun peurusahaan "hana meukeubit."
hypothesis: Phon minggu baroe, METI geupeutrang bahwa Apple ka geupeutrang keu jih 34 inciden peungeuh nyang leubeh, nyang dipeugah le perusahaan "hana serius".

source: The ministry responded by calling Apple's postponement of the report "truly regrettable."
reference: Keumeunterian jaweueb deungön geukheuen peunundaan laporan Apple "beutoi-beutoi teulah geu."
hypothesis: Kementerian nyan geu tanggong jaweueb deungon geu sebut Apple nyang geutanggong laporan nyan "sangat menyesal".

source: The eathquake struck Mariana at 07:19 a.m. local time (09:19 p.m. GMT Friday).
reference: Gempa melanda Mariana watee poh 07:19 beungoh di sinan (Jumat 09:19 p.m. GMT).
hypothesis: Gempa nyan terjadi bak poh 07:19 (09:19 GMT)

source: The Northern Marianas emergency management office said that there were no damages reported in the nation.
reference: Kanto manajemen darurat Mariana Utara geukheun bahwa hana nyang reuloh nyang geupeuthee bak negara nyan.
hypothesis: Kantor manajemen darurat Marianas Utara geupeugah bahwa hana na kerusakan yang dilaporkan di nanggroe nyan.

source: Also the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center said that there was no Tsunami indication.
reference: Meunan cit Pusat Peringatan Tsunami Pasifik geukheun bahwa hana indikasi Tsunami.
hypothesis: Meunan cit Pusat Peringatan Tsunami Pasifik geupeugah bahwa hana tanda Tsunami.

source: A former Filipino policeman has kept Hong Kong tourists hostage by hijacking their bus in Manila, the capital of the Philippines.
reference: Pulisi Filipina awai ka jidrop tureh Hong Kong deungon cara geubajak moto beus awaknyan nibak Manila, nang Filipina.
hypothesis: Sidroe mantan polisi Filipina ka dipeutahan ureung wisata Hong Kong dengan ji curi bus awak nyan di Manila, ibu kota Filipina.

source: Rolando Mendoza fired his M16 rifle at the tourists.
reference: Rolando Mendoza ka jitimbak tureh ngon beude M16-jih.
hypothesis: Rolando Mendoza dipeuleumah seunjata M16 jih bak awak wisata.

source: Several hostages have been rescued and least six have been confirmed dead so far.
reference: Meupadum droe ureueng nyang jidrop ka jipeuseulamat ngon paleng niet nam droe nyang jibi thee ka mate seujioh nyoe.
hypothesis: Padum-padum droe sandera ka dipeuseulamat dan sitroe na nyang ka teupat mate sampoe jinoe.

source: Six hostages, including the children and elderly, were released early, as were the Filipino photographers.
reference: Nam droe teuneuboh, teumasok aneuk mit ngon ureueng tuha, geupubebah leubeh awai, meunan cit awak fotografer Filipina.
hypothesis: Nam teutap, termasuk aneuk miet ngon ureung tuha, dipeuleueh leubeh awai, lage ureung poto Filipina.

source: The photographers later took the place of an aged lady as she needed the lavatory. Mendoza was gunned down.
reference: Alheueh nyan tukang-tukang poto nyan jigantoe sidroe ureueng inong tuha nyang peureulee jak u kama manoe. Mendoza ka jitimbak mate.
hypothesis: Peugöt foto nyan lheuh nyan geucok teumpat sidroe inong tuha kareuna jih peurle toilet. Mendoza ditembak mate.

source: Liggins followed in his father’s footsteps and entered a career in medicine.
reference: Liggin geuikot jeujak abu gobnyan ngön tamöng karir lam bideueng keudokteran.
hypothesis: Liggins geu ikot langkah ayah jih dan geu mulai karir lam kedokteran.

source: He trained as an obstetrician and began to work at the Auckland's National Women's Hospital in 1959.
reference: Gobnyan geupeubiyasa sebagoe dokter kandungan ngön geumulai keurija i Rumoh Sakét Inöng Nasional Auckland bak thôn 1959.
hypothesis: Jih dipeulatih seubagoe dokter kandungan dan mulai bekerja di Rumah Sakit Wanita Nasional Auckland bak thon 1959.

source: While he was working at the hospital Liggins began to investigate premature labor during his spare time.
reference: Watèe gobnyan keurija i rumoh sakét, Liggins phôn geupeupareksa peursalenan prematur lawét watèe lheueng gobnyan.
hypothesis: Watee gobnyan bekerja di rumoh sakit Liggins mulai menyelidiki kelahiran prematur bak watee luang jih.

source: His research showed that if a hormone was administered it would speed up the baby's foetal lung maturation.
reference: Peuneulitian gobnyan meupeutunyok bahwa meunyô hormon geubri, nyan geupeubagah peumatangan paru-paru bijeh aneuk mirah.
hypothesis: Penelitian jih dipeudeh bahwa jika hormon dipeutahan akan geugalak peumaté paru-paru janin.

source: Xinhua reported that government investigators recovered two 'black box' flight recorders on Wednesday.
reference: Xinhua geubrithèe bahwa peunyelidek poemeurentah geuteumèe duwa boih peureukam peuneurbangan 'kutak itam' bak uroe Rabu.
hypothesis: Xinhua melaporkan bahwa peuneliti pemerintah meuteume dua 'kotak itam' perekam penerbangan bak Rabu.

source: Fellow wrestlers also paid tribute to Luna.
reference: Rakan peugulat bri sit peunghormatan keu Luna.
hypothesis: Rameung peulisi cit geu peujok pujoe keu Luna.

source: Tommy Dreamer said "Luna was the first Queen of Extreme. My first manager. Luna passed away on the night of two moons. Pretty unique just like her. Strong woman."
reference: Tommy Dreamer geukheun "Luna nakeuh Ratu Ekstrim phôn. Menejer phôn lôn. Luna matèe bak malam duwa buleuen. Sép ceudah lagèe gobnyan. Inöng nyang teuga."
hypothesis: Tommy Dreamer geupeugah "Luna adalah ratu Extreme phon. manajer phon lon. Luna meuninggai bak malam dua buleun. cukop unik lagee jih. inong nyang teuga".

source: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels commented that "Luna was as freaky as me...maybe even more...love her and will miss her...hopefully she's in a better place."
reference: Dustin "Golddust" Runnels geupeugah bahwa "Luna sama ganjejih deungön lôn...mungkén bah keuh leubèh...galak keu gobnyan ngön meucen keu gobnyan...seumoga gobnyan na i teumpat nyang leubèh gèt."
hypothesis: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels geupeugah bahwa "Luna nyan seucara aneh lagee lon... mungken leubeh... cinta keu jih dan akan rindu keu jih... mudah-mudahan jih di teumpat nyang leubeh get".

source: Out of 1,400 people polled prior to the 2010 federal election, those who oppose Australia becoming a republic grew by 8 per cent since 2008.
reference: Dari 1.400 ureueng nyang geusurvei sigohlom peunileh federal 2010, awak nyang lawan Australi nyang jeut keu republik timoh 8 persen mulaphôn 2008.
hypothesis: Nibak 1.400 droe yang diteurimeng seugolom pemilu federal 2010, ureung nyang hana galak Australia jeut keu republik meutamah 8 persen dari thon 2008.

source: Caretaker Prime Minister Julia Gillard claimed during the campaign of the 2010 federal election that she believed Australia should become a republic at the end of Queen Elizabeth II's reign.
reference: Simeuntara Peurdana Meuntroe Julia Gillard peuklaim lawét kampanye peunileh federal 2010 bahwa gobnyan geupateh Australi haroih jeut keu republik bak akhe pemerintahan Ratu Elizabeth II.
hypothesis: Perdana Menteri sementara Julia Gillard diklaim seulama kampanye pemilu federal 2010 bahwa gobnyan peucaya Australia haroh jeut keu republik bak akhe pemerintahan Ratu Elizabeth II.

source: 34 per cent of those in the poll share this view, wanting Queen Elizabeth II to be Australia's last monarch.
reference: 34 persen dari awak nyang peuikot jajak peunteumèe na pandangan nyoe, meuheut Ratu Elizabeth II jeut keu ratu nyang akhe Australi.
hypothesis: 34 persen dari awak nyang dalam survei nyan meupeuturi pandangan nyo, yang meuheut Ratu Elizabeth II jeut keu raja Australia nyang keuneulheueh.

source: At the extremes of the poll, 29 per cent of those surveyed believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent believe Australia should never become a republic.
reference: Bak ekstrem jajak peunteumèe, 29 persen dari awak nyang geusurvei pateh bahwa Australi haroih jeut keu republik beubagah mungkén, simeuntara 31 persen pateh Australi hana jeut keu republik.
hypothesis: Bak ekstrim survei, 29 persen dari awak nyang diteureksa percaya Australia haroh jeut keu republik seugolom mungken, seudangkan 31 persen percaya Australia haroh han tom jeut keu republik.

source: The Olympic gold medalist was due to swim in the 100m and 200m freestyle and in three relays at the Commonwealth Games, but due to his complaints his fitness has been in doubt.
reference: Peraih medali meuih Olimpiade nyan akan meulangue lam gaya bibeuh 100m ngön 200m ngön lam lhèe estafet di Commonwealth Games, tapi sabab keluhanjih kebugaranjih geuragu.
hypothesis: Peumeunang medali méuh Olimpiade nyan ka teutap meulangoe bak 100m dan 200m gaya bebas dan lam lhee relay bak Commonwealth Games, teutapi kareuna keluhan jih kebugaran jih ka na lam ragu.

source: He has been unable to take the drugs needed to overcome his pain as they are banned from the Games.
reference: Gobnyan hana jeut jeb ubat nyang geupeureulèe keu geupeupuleh rasa sakétjih sabab geutham dari Olimpiade.
hypothesis: Jih hana jeut ji intat ubat-ubatan nyang peurle keu ji peuhanco rasa sakét jih kareuna nyan ji peugadeh dari Olimpiade.

source: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and computer science professor at the University of Central Missouri, has discovered the largest known prime number to date on January 25.
reference: Curtis Cooper, sidroe ahli matematika ngön profesor ilmu komputer di Universitas of Central Missouri, ka geuteumèe bilangan prima paléng rayëk nyang geutupue sampoe watèe nyoe bak tanggai 25 Januari.
hypothesis: Curtis Cooper, sidroe matematikawan ngen profesor ilmu komputer di Universitas Missouri Teungoh, ka meuteume bilangan prima terbesar nyang diteupeu sampoe saat nyoe bak 25 Januari.

source: Several people verified the discovery using different hardware and software by the beginning of February and it was announced on Tuesday.
reference: Ladom ureueng geupeuverifikasi penemuan nyang ngui peurangkat kreuh ngön perangkat lunak nyang bida bak awai Februari ngön geuumum bak uroe Seulasa.
hypothesis: Padum droe ureung geu verifikasi penemuan nyan ngon meupakek perangkat keras ngon perangkat lunak yang beda bak awai buleun Februari dan nyan diumumkan bak uroe Selasa.

source: Comets may possibly have been a source of water delivery to the earth along with organic matter that can form proteins and support life.
