reference: Komet mungkén ka jeut keu asai pengireman ie u bumoe meusigèe deungön bahan organik nyang jeut geupeugöt protein ngön dukông keudépan.
hypothesis: Komet mungken jeut keu sumber pembawaan ie u bumoe meusigoe deungen bahan organik yang jeut membentuk protein dan mendukung kehidupan.

source: Scientists hope to understand how planets form, especially how the Earth formed, since comets collided with the Earth long ago.
reference: Awak ilmuwan meuharap jeut meuphom kiban planet meupeugöt, khusuihjih kiban Bumoe meupeugöt, mulaphôn komet meupôk deungön Bumoe nyang ka trep.
hypothesis: Para ilmuwan berharap untuk meuphom pakriban planet terbentuk, terutama pakriban Bumo terbentuk, kareuna komet ta tabrakan deungen Bumo jameun baro.

source: Cuomo, 53, began his governorship earlier this year and signed a bill last month legalizing same-sex marriage.
reference: Cuomo, 53, phôn jeut keu gubernur awai thôn nyoe ngön geuboh teken RUU buleuen nyang ka leupah nyang geupeulegal meukawén saban jeuneh.
hypothesis: Cuomo, 53, mulai jabatan gubernur jih awai thon nyoe dan diteken saboh undang-undang buleun baroe nyang meumungken perkawinan sesama jenis.

source: He referred to the rumors as "political chatter and silliness".
reference: Gobnyan geukheuen rumor nyan sebagoe "obrolan politik ngön kekonyolan".
hypothesis: Jih geu kheun haba-haba nyan "keucarita politik dan keubodohan".

source: He is speculated to make a run for president in 2016.
reference: Gobnyan meuspekulasi keu geupeucalon droe sebagoe presiden bak 2016.
hypothesis: Jih dipeugalak jeut keu calon presiden bak thon 2016.

source: NextGen is a system the FAA claims would allow aircraft to fly shorter routes and save millions of gallons of fuel each year and cut carbon emissions.
reference: NextGen nakeuh sistem nyang geuklaim FAA akan geupeumungkén kapaiteureubang keu teureubang rute nyang leubèh paneuk ngön himat meujuta galon bahan bakar tiep thôn ngön peukureueng emisi karbon.
hypothesis: NextGen adalah sistem nyang diklaim FAA akan memungkinkan pesawat untuk terbang rute yang leubeh pendek dan menghemat jutaan galon bahan bakar setiap thon dan mengurangi emisi karbon.

source: It uses satellite-based technology as opposed to older ground-radar-based technology to allow air traffic controllers to pinpoint aircraft with greater precision and give pilots more accurate information.
reference: Kapai teureubang nyoe paké teknologi berbasis satelit nyang bida dari teknologi berbasis radar darat nyang leubèh tuha untuk geupeumungkén keu control lalu lintas udara geupeuteuntèe kapai teureubang deungön presisi leubèh rayëk ngön bri informasi nyang leubèh akurat keu pilot.
hypothesis: Nyo dipakek teknologi berbasis satelit seulaen teknologi berbasis radar darat yang leubeh tuha untuk meubileh pengendali lalu lintas udara untuk menunjuk pesawat deungen presisi yeng lubeh rayek ngen meupeujok pilot informasi yeng lubeh akurat.

source: No extra transport is being put on and overground trains will not stop at Wembley, and car parking and park-and-ride facilities are unavailable at the ground.
reference: Hana transportasi leubèh nyang geupasang ngön gritan di ateuh tanoh hana akan meupiyoh di Wembley, ngön fasilitas parkir moto seureuta parkir-ngön-ek moto hana teuseudia di darat.
hypothesis: Hana na transportasi tambahan nyang dipeuget dan tren darat hana akan teupiôh di Wembley, dan parkir mobil dan fasilitas parkir dan naik hana tersedia di darat.

source: Fears of lack of transportation raised the possibility that the game would be forced to play behind closed doors without the team's supporters.
reference: Rasa kawaté akan kureuengjih transportasi peugöt leubèh rayëk keumungkénan bahwa peurtandéngan akan geupaksa geumeu’èn seucara meutop ngön hana pendukông tim.
hypothesis: Takot kureung transportasi geu angkat kemungkinan bahwa pertandingan akan dipaksa untuk diputer di likot pinto tertutup tanpa pendukung tim.

source: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.
reference: Saboh studi nyang geuteubiet bak uroe Hameh di jurnal Science geupeuthèe rupaakan geupeuna spesies cicem barô di Kepulauan Galapagos Ekuador.
hypothesis: saboh penelitian yang dipublikasikan bak uroe Kamis lam jurnal Science dipeugah tentang terbentuk spesies cicem baroe di Kepulauan Galapagos Ekuador

source: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.
reference: Awak peneliti dari Universitas Princeton di Amèrika Seurikat ngön Universitas Uppsala di Swedia geupeuthèe bahwa spesies barô meuevolusi hanya lam duwa generasi, bahpih proses nyoe geuyakin pajoh watèe leubèh treb, sabab perkembangbiakan antara kutilang Darwin endemik, Geospiza fortes, ngön kutilang kaktus imigran, Geospiza conirostris.
hypothesis: Peneliti dari Universitas Princeton di Amerika Serikat ngen Universitas Uppsala di Swedia melaporkan spesies baroe berevolusi lam dua generasi, meskipun proses nyo diyakini leubeh treb, kareuna peukan antara finch Darwin endemik, Geospiza fortes, ngen finch kaktus imigran, Geospiza conirostris.

source: Gold may be worked into all sorts of shapes. It can be rolled into tiny shapes.
reference: Meuih jeut geuolah jeut keu bandum macam rupa. Meuih jeut geugulong jeut keu rupa nyang ubit.
hypothesis: Méuh jeut teupeuget lam meubagoe rupa bentuk.

source: It can be pulled into thin wire, which can be twisted and plaited. It can be hammered or rolled into sheets.
reference: Meuih jeut geutarek jeut keu kawat lipeh, nyang jeut geupunyie ngön geuanyam. Meuih jeut geupalèe atawa geugulong jeut keu meu oen-oen.
hypothesis: Nyan jeut ji tarek jeut keu kawat tipis, nyang jeut ji pileh ngon ji ikat.

source: It can be made very thin, and stuck onto other metal. It can be made so thin that it was sometimes used to decorate the hand-painted pictures in books called "illuminated manuscripts".
reference: Meuih jeut gepeugöt that lipeh, ngön geupeutimpe bak logam laén. Meuih jeut gepeugöt that lipeh sampoe meujan-jan geupaké keu peumeungui gamba-gamba nyang geulukeh deungön jaroe lam buku-buku nyang geukheun "manuskrip meucahya".
hypothesis: Nyan jeut ji peuget sangat tipis, dan ji ikat bak logam laen. nyan jeut ji peuget teupat sampoe kadang-kadang ji pakek untuk ji hias gamba-gamba nyang ji cat ngon jaroe lam buku nyang geu sebut "naskah nyang geulayang".

source: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
reference: Nyoe geukheun pH bahan kimia. Gata jeut peugöt indikator ngön jus kubis mirah.
hypothesis: Nyo dikhen pH bahan kimia. jeut ta peuget indikator ngon jus kubis mirah

source: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
reference: Jus kubis meuubah wareuna meugantong nibak kiban asam atawa basa (alkalin) bahan kimia nyan.
hypothesis: Jus kubis meu ubah warna tergantung bak seberapa asam atau basa (alkaline) bahan kimia nyan.

source: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
reference: Tingkat pH geutunyok lé jumlah ion Hidrogen (H lam pH) lam bahan kimia nyang geuuji.
hypothesis: Tingkat pH dipeudeh deungen jumlah ion Hidrogen (H dalam pH) lam bahan kimia yang ji uji.

source: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
reference: Ion hidrogen nakeuh proton nyang elektronjih meulheueh (sabab atom Hidrogen terdiri dari saboh proton ngön saboh elektron).
hypothesis: Ion hidrogen adalah proton yeng na elektron jih yang dicoret dari awak nyan (sabab atom hidrogen terdiri dari saboh proton ngen saboh elektron).

source: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.
reference: Lawok banduwa bubo tho nyan ngön dudoe, deungön jaroe buluet nyang gleh, geupeujeupat jeut keu bola.
hypothesis: Meugabong dua bubuk kering nyan seureuta, deungen jaroe basah nyang gleh, peucet nyan jeut keu bola.

source: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.
reference: Juem di jaroe gata akan meureaksi deungön lapeh nyang luwa, nyang akan geurasa gleuen ngön geupeuhasé hi cangkang.
hypothesis: Kelembaban bak jaroe gata akan bereaksi deungen lapisan lua, nyang akan terasa lucu dan membentuk semacam cangkang.

source: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.
reference: Kuta Harappa ngön Mohenjo-daro na bagan siram di rab tiep rumoh, nyang meusambong deungön sistem pembuangan broih nyang hayeu.
hypothesis: Banda-banda Harappa ngon Mohenjo-daro na toilet nyang ji drop lam mandum rumoh, nyang na hubongan ngon sistem limbah nyang canggih.

source: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.
reference: Euncit-euncit sistem pembuangan broih ka geuteumèe di rumoh-rumoh kuta Minoa di Kreta ngön Santorini di Yunani.
hypothesis: Sisa-sisa sistem limbah kaleuh ditume di rumoh-rumoh kota Minoan di Kreta ngen Santorini di Yunani.

source: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.
reference: Na sit bagan di Mesir kuno, Persia ngön Cina. Lam peuradaban Romawi, bagan meujan-jan jeut keu bahagian dari teumpat manoe umom nibak teumpat awak agam ngön inöng meukumpoi.
hypothesis: Di Mesir kuno, Persia dan Cina na cit toilet. bak peradaban Romawi, toilet kadang-kadang bagian dari bak mandi umum di pat ureung agam ngon inong meusapat dalam perusahaan campuran.

source: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
reference: Watèe gata télépon ureueng nyang jiohjih meuribèe mil, gata ngui satelit.
hypothesis: Watee neutuleh gob nyang na di jiôh ribuan mil, neutuleh satelit.

source: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.
reference: Satelit di luwa angkasa teurimong panggilan ngön dudoe geupeuulajih balek, rab keujap.
hypothesis: Satelit di angkasa geuteurimong panggilan nyan dan lheuh nyan dipeutrang lom, seucara langsong.

source: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.
reference: Satelit geukirém u luwa angkasa deungön roket. Awak ilmuwan pakè teleskop di luwa angkasa sabab atmosfer Bumoe geupeudistorsi ladom cahya ngön pandangan geutanyoe.
hypothesis: Satelit nyan ji kirem u angkasa deungen roket. para ilmuwan ji pakek teleskop di angkasa kareuna atmosfer Bumo ji peuglah padim boh cahya dan pandangan geutanyoe.

source: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.
reference: Geupeureulèe roket rasasa deungön manyang leubèh dari 100 gaki keu peuduek satelit atawa teleskop di luwa angkasa.
hypothesis: Teurlôh roket raksasa leubeh dari 100 feet manyang untuk dipeuduek satelit atawa teleskop di angkasa.

source: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.
reference: Ruda ka geupeuubah dônya deungön cara nyang hayeu that. Hai paléng rayëk nyang ka geupubuet ruda keu geutanyoe nakeuh bri keu geutanyoe transportasi nyang leubèh mangat ngön leubèh bagah.
hypothesis: Giling nyan ka meu ubah donya deungon cara yang hana mungken. hal nyang paleng rayeuk nyang ka jipeuget giling nyan keu geutanyoe adalah geubri keu geutanyoe transportasi nyang leubeh mudah dan leubeh bagah.

source: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
reference: Ruda ka geupeuba geutanyoe gritan, moto, ngön lë alat transportasi laénjih.
hypothesis: Nyan ka geubri keu geutanyoe kereta api, mobil, ngon le alat transportasi laen jih.

source: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
reference: Di yubjih na leubèh lë miong deungön ukoe teungoh nyang pajoh eumpeuen deungön ukoe teungoh rab dari ranab sampoe glueh ngön jlueh.
hypothesis: Di miyueb nyan na kucing ukuran ubit nyang pajoh mangsa ukuran ubit mulai dari kelinci sampoe antelop dan rusa.

source: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
reference: Teurakhe, na ramé miong ubit (na roeh miong peuliharaan) nyang pajoh eumpeuen ubit nyang jeuoh leubèh lë lagèe seureungga, tikoih, tarom, ngön cicem.
hypothesis: Akhe jih, na le kucing ubit (termasuk kucing peuliharaan long) yang pajoh mangsa ubit nyang leubeh le lagee serangga, tikus, kadal, ngen cicem.

source: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
reference: Rasiya kesuksesan awak nyan nakeuh konsep niche, keurija khusuih nyang geumiliki tiep miong nyang geupeutham awak nyan meusayeng deungön nyang laén.
hypothesis: Rahasia keberhasilan jih adalah konsep niche, pekerjaan khusus yang dimiliki setiap kucing yang mencegahnya bersaing dengan yang laen.

source: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
reference: Singa nakeuh miong nyang paléng sosial, udép lam keulompok rayëk nyang geukheun prides.
hypothesis: Singa adalah kucing nyang paleng sosial, udep dalam kelompok rayek nyang dikhen pride.

source: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
reference: Prides meucakop saboh sampoe lhèe jantan baleh nyang meukawet, deungön lhèe plôh beutina ngön aneukjih.
hypothesis: Keulompok jih terdiri dari saboh sampoe lhee ek yang dewasa, seulaen seulama lhee ploh ek inong ngon aneuk.

source: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
reference: Beutina lazemjih meukawet toe sabé kedroe-kedroe, jeut keu keuluarga rayëk syédara inöng ngön aneuk inöng.
hypothesis: Aneuk inong biasa jih meusyeuhu that, jeut keu keluarga rayek adoe dan putroe.

source: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
reference: Prides singa meubuet lagèe saboh kawan rubah atawa asèe, hiweuen nyang seucara teukeujot hi deungön singa (tapi bukon miong rayëk laénjih) lam naseubah, ngön that bahaya sit keu eumpeuenjih.
hypothesis: Singa yang sombong meubuet lagee kawanan srigala atau anjing, binatang yang sangat mirip singa (tapi hana kucing rayek laen) lam perilaku, dan cit sangat mematikan bagi mangsa.

source: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
reference: Sidroe atlet nyang meupengetahuan luaih, rimeung jeut lawa (bahpih hana gèt), meulangue, lumpat jeuoh ngön geupeutarek deungön limong gö teunaga manusiya nyang teuga.
hypothesis: Seurangga nyang bulat, harimau jeut jiek (meskipun hana get), meulangoe, meulumpat jarak yang rayek dan ji tarek deungen kekuatan limong goe leubeh teuga nibak manusia nyang teuga.

source: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
reference: Rimeung na lam keulompok nyang saban (Genus Panthera) deungön singa, macan tutul, ngön jaguar. Keupeuet miong nyoe nakeuh saboh-sabohjih nyang jeut meurawong.
hypothesis: Harimau nyan na lam kelompok yang sama (Genus Panthera) deungen singa, macan tutul, dan jaguar.

source: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
reference: Rawongan rimeung hana lagèe rawongan singa nyang meusu peunoh, tapi leubèh lagèe kalimah narit-narit klik nyang beurigen.
hypothesis: Meurengek harimau hana lagee meurengek singa, tapi leubeh lagee kalimat kata-kata yang geulanteu.

source: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
reference: Ocelot galak pajoh meulatang ubit. Ocelot akan geudrop siben, uleue, tikoh ngön cicem meunyoe jijeut. Rap bandum meulatang nyang geupeucrok ocelot jeuoh leubéh ubit nibakjih.
hypothesis: Ocelot galak pajoh binatang ubit. awak nyan akan meukaru monyet, uleue, tikus dan cicem meunyoe jeut. hampir mandum binatang yang di teumeung ocelot leubeh ubit dari awak nyan

source: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
reference: Awak ilmuwan meupikèe bahwa ocelot peuikot ngön peuteumee hiweuen untuk geupajoh (eumpeuen) deungön geupeucom, geupeuhirop teumpat awak nyan berada di tanoh.
hypothesis: Para ilmuwan geupike bahwa ocelots jiseutôt dan mita binatang untuk jipajoh (mangsa) deungen bau, mengendus untuk teumpat awak nyan di ateuh tanoh.

source: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
reference: Awak nyan jeut ngieng deungön that gèt lam glap deungön penglihatan malam, ngön meugrak sit deungön that meusom-som. Ocelot geupeucrok eumpeuenjih deungön meujampu deungön silingkajih lheuhnyan geupeuteugom eumpeuenjih.
hypothesis: Nyan jeut ji kalon get lam seupôt ngon penglihatan malam, dan ji piyoh ngon seungab-seungab, cit. Ocelot jimita mangsa jih ngon cara meucampong ngon lingkungan jih dan laju ji teugom mangsa jih.

source: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
reference: Watèe saboh keulompok ubit meukheulu udép (populasi ubit) meuaséng dari populasi utama asai awak nyan (lagèe meunyô awak nyan pinah u pegunongan atawa krueng, atawa meunyô awak nyan pinah u pulo barô sehingga awak nyan hana jeut deungön mangat mundo) awak nyan akan seureng peuteumèe droe awak nyan silingka nyang bida dari sigohlomnyan.
hypothesis: Wate saboh kelompok ubit makhluk udep (populasi ubit) dipeubeda dari populasi utama yang awak nyan teuka dari (lage jih jika awak nyan geupinah di ateuh baroh gunong atau krueng, atau jika awak nyan geupinah u saboh pulau baro sehingga awak nyan hana mudah geupinah lom) awak nyan seureng meurumpok droe jih lam lingkungan yang beda dari yang awak nyan na di awai.

source: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
reference: Silingka barô nyoe na sumber daya nyang bida ngön pesayeng nyang bida, sehingga populasi barô akan peureulèe fitur atawa adaptasi nyang bida untuk jeut keu pesayeng nyang teuga dari nyang awak nyan peureulèe sigohlomnyan.
hypothesis: Lingkungan baroe nyoe na sumber daya yang beda dan pesaing yang beda, sehingga populasi baroe akan perlee fitur atau adaptasi yang beda untuk jeut pesaing yang kuat dari yang mereka perlee seugolom jih.

source: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
reference: Populasi aseuli hana meuubah bacut pih, awak nyan manteng peureulèe adaptasi nyang saban lagèe sigohlomnyan.
hypothesis: Populasi asli hana meu ubah sama sekali, awak nyan manteng peureulee adaptasi lagee awai.

source: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
reference: Watèe, watèe populasi barô mulai meuadaptasi deungön Silingka barô awak nyan, awak nyan mulai maken hana lagèe populasi laénjih.
hypothesis: Seulama watee, seulama populasi baro mulai beradaptasi deungen lingkungan baroe, awak nyan mulai tampak kureung lage populasi laen.

source: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
reference: Akhejih, lheuh meuribèe atawa bahkan meujuta thôn, banduwa populasi akan that bida sehingga hana jeut geukheun spesies nyang sama.
hypothesis: Akhe jih, lheuh meuribée atawa bahkan jutaan thon, dua populasi nyan akan meubagoe rupa sampoe hana jeut geukheun spesies yang sama.

source: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
reference: Kamoe meukheun proses nyoe spesiasi, nyang meumakna peuna spesies barô. Spesiasi nakeuh konsekuensi nyang hana jeut geutapih ngön bagian nyang that peunteng dari evolusi.
hypothesis: Geutanyoe geukheun proses nyoe spesiasi, yang hanya meuarti peumbentukan spesies baro. Spesiasi adalah akibat yang hana jeut dihindari dan bagian yang sangat peunteng dari evolusi.

source: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
reference: Tumbuhan peugöt oksigen nyang geuhirop manusiya, ngön tumbuhan co karbon dioksida nyang geuproih manusiya (nakeuh, geuyub).
hypothesis: Tanaman meuget oksigen yang ji ambon le manusia, dan awak nyan ji tarek karbon dioksida yang ji ambon le manusia (yaitu, ji ambon luwah).

source: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
reference: Tumbuhan peugöt makanan dari matauroe deungön fotosintesis. Tumbuhan bri naungan sit.
hypothesis: Tanaman meuget makanan dari mata uroe ngen fotosintesis.

source: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.
reference: Kamoe peugöt rumoh kamoe dari tumbuhan ngön peugöt ija dari tumbuhan. Ladom makanan nyang kamoe pajoh nakeuh tumbuhan. Hana tumbuhan, hiweuen hana jeut meutheun udép.
hypothesis: Geutanyoe peugot rumoh dari bungong dan peugot peukayan dari bungong. Sebagian rayek makanan nyang tanyoe pajoh adalah bungong. Hana bungong, binatang hana jeut udep.

source: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
reference: Mosasaurus nakeuh predator puncak nibak masajih, jadi ijih han yö keu baranggapeuë pih, kecuali mosasaurus laénjih.
hypothesis: Mosasaurus adalah pemangsa puncak watee jih, jadi jih hana takot keu sia-sia, kecuali mosasaurus laen.

source: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
reference: Rahangjih nyang panyang meususôn leubéh dari 70 gigoë sitajam silet, sajan deungön saboh set tambahan di bubông babahjih, nyang meuhareutoe bahwa hana jalan teubiët keu peuë pih nyang léwat jalanjih.
hypothesis: Rungkang jih nyang panyang na leubeh nibak 70 gigoe nyang tajam, seulaen saboh gigoe nyang leubeh le bak babah jih, nyan meumakna hana mungken soe mantong nyang meurumpok ngon jih nyan hase jiplueng.

source: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
reference: Kamoë han kamoë teupeuë pasti, tapi mungkén lidah jih meucabang. Peunajôhjih rôh kura-kura, eungkôt rayek, mosasaurus nyang laén, ngön bahkan mungkén meulatang nyan kanibal.
hypothesis: Kamoe hana meuteupeue pasti, tapi mungken lidah jih na nyang meucang, makanan jih na kheueh kura-kura, eungkot rayeuk, mosasaurus laen jih, dan mungken bahkan jeut keu kanibal.

source: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
reference: Ijih geuserang cit peuë mantöng nyang itamöng u dalam ië; bahkan dinosaurus raksasa lagèë T.rex hana tandéngan jih.
hypothesis: Jih cit menyerang peue mantong nyang jitamong u dalam ie; bahkan dinosaurus raksasa lagee T. rex hana hase jitanggong jih.

source: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
reference: Venus ladôm peunajôh awaknyan toe keu tanyoe, Romawi na jatahjih nibak khanduri aneh atawa hana biyasa, itamoeng keunan bui uteuen, cicém meurak, sipôt, ngön seujeuneh meulatang peungeurat nyang jikheuntikôh
hypothesis: Meskipun le makanan awaknyan ka biasa keu geutanyoe, ureuëng Roma na peunajoh nyang hana biasa, teumasok bui, merak, siput, dan saboh jenis tikus nyang geuboh nan dormouse

source: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
reference: Nyang laén nakeuh ureueng gasien ngön ureueng inoeng geupajôh peunajôh nyan sira geuduek bak kursi, ureueng kaya geu idang peunajôh ban mandum ureueng nyan geupeurasat seura geuseumajôh.
hypothesis: Perbedaan laen jih bahwa seudangkan ureung gasien dan inong nyan pajoh peunajoh seudangkan awaknyan duek bak kurusi, ureung kaya galak that bak pesta bersama-sama di pat awaknyan duek bak sisi seudangkan awaknyan pajoh makanan.

source: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
reference: Peunajoh Romawi jameun hana itamöng keunan nyang trôk u Eropa nibak Amerika atawa nibak Asia bak abad-abad ukeunyan.
hypothesis: Makanan Romawi kuno hana jeut na makanan yang ji peutamong u Eropa dari Amerika atau dari Asia bak abad-abad lheuh nyan.

source: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
reference: Tamsejih, ureueng nyan hana jagông geuh, atawa boh tumat, atawa boh gantang, atawa boh coklat, ngön hana ureueng Romawi jameun geurasa sie manok kalkun.
hypothesis: Miseu jih, awak nyan hana na jagong, tomat, kentang, atawa kakao, dan hana sidroe Roma kuno yang pernah geu rasa kalkun.

source: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
reference: Ureueng Babilonia geupeudöng dewa droe geuh keudroe saboh kuil phon nyang jianggap seubagoe rumoh dewa.
hypothesis: Ureuëng Babel geupeudong saboh kuil keu tieb-tieb dewa awaknyan nyang dianggap rumoh dewa nyan.

source: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
reference: Ureueng geuneuk jôk keureubeuen keu dewa ngön awak peundeta geuuseuha peusep peu nyang peureulee lé dewa röt upacara ngön khanduri rayeuk.
hypothesis: Ureueng-ureueng akan jiba keureubeuen keu dewa-dewa dan teungku-teungku imeum akan ji coba untuk ji jaga kebutuhan dewa-dewa melalui upacara dan festival.

source: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
reference: Tiep-tiep kuil na leun kuil nyang meuhalak ngön lheueh nyan na saboh kuil lam kuil nyan jeuet tamöng keunan peureutei peundeta-peundeta.
hypothesis: Tieb-tieb Baét TUHAN na saboh peulataran nyang teuhah, dan saboh teumpat nyang leubeh suci nyang na di dalam nyang jeuet jitamong lé imeum-imeum mantong.

source: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
reference: Meujan-jan meunara nyang meubeuntok piramida, nyang ikheun ziggurat, ipeudöng beujeuet keu saboh bagoe nibak candi.
hypothesis: Kadang-kadang meunara khas nyang meu bentuk piramida, yeng dikhen ziggurat, dibangun seubagai bagian dari kuil.

source: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
reference: Pucak meunara nakeuh teumpat meusom keu dewajih.
hypothesis: Ateuh meunara nyan na teumpat suci khusus keu dewa nyan.

source: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
reference: Bak cuwaca seuuem bacut i Timue Teungoeh, rumoh nyan hana that peunténg.
hypothesis: Lam iklim nyang seu-uem di Timur Teungoh, rumoh hana that peunteng.

source: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
reference: Ladom keuluwarga Ibrani udep i angѐn meuhalak.
hypothesis: Seubagian rayek kehidupan keluarga Ibrani teujadi di luwa ruangan.

source: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
reference: Ureueng inöng geumaguen i leun; keudѐ nyankeuh pat bayeu teuhah nyang deuh u jalan. Batѐe geungui keu geu peugöt rumoh.
hypothesis: Ureuëng inong ji masak di halaman; toko-toko nyan cuma meja nyang teubuka nyang deuh bak jalan. Batée ji pakek keu peudong rumoh.

source: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
reference: Hana uteuen rayeuk i tanoh Kanaan, jadi kayѐe sép meuh’ai.
hypothesis: Hana na uteuen nyang raya di nanggroe Kanaan, ngon sabab nyan kayée nyan lumpah meuhái.

source: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.
reference: Greenland jiduek seucara jareueng-jareueng. Lam hikayat Norse awaknyan jipeugah bahwasajih Erik si Mirah jiböh nibak Islandia sabab seumeupoh, ngön watѐe neujak jiôh-jiôh u barat, neutumee Greenland ngön geupeunan jih Greenland.
hypothesis: Greenland hana le ureung tinggai di nanggroe nyan. lam kisah-kisah Norse, Erik the Red geu suroh dari Islandia karena jipoh gob, dan watee geujak u barat, geu teume Greenland dan geuboh nan Greenland.

source: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.
reference: Adakpih lheueh nibak geutumee nyan, ureueng Eskimo ka geutinggai hideh bak masa nyan.
hypothesis: Teuma hana geupakoe penemuan jih, suku Eskimo kaleuh tinggai di sinan bak wate nyan.

source: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.
reference: Adakpih tiep nanggroe nyankeuh ‘Skandinavia’ na dum meubeda nibak ureueng, Raja, adat istiadat ngön hikayah Denmark, Swedia, Norwegia ngön Islandia.
hypothesis: Meskipun tiep-tiep nanggroe 'Scandinavia', na le perbedaan antara ureung, raja, adat dan sejarah Denmark, Swedia, Norwegia ngen Islandia.

source: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
reference: Meunyö neukalön filem National Treasure, droeneuh mungken neupikee peuta hareuta karun kalheueh meutuleh i likot Maklumat Meurdheka.
hypothesis: Meunyoe gata ka takalon film National Treasure, gata mungken pike peta harta karun teutuléh dilikot Deklarasi Kemerdekaan.

source: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
reference: Beuranggadum, nyan hana beutôi. Adakpih na sipue-pue nyang ituleh i likot naseukah nyan, nyan könsaboh peuta hareuta.
hypothesis: Bah pih na nyang teutuleh bak bagian likot dokumen nyan, nyan kon peta harta.

source: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
reference: Nyang ituleh i likôt Maklumat Meurdheka nyankeuh "Maklumat Meurdheka Aseuli tanggai keu-4 buleuen Juli thon 1776". Matan nyan deuh i miyup nibak maklumat nyan, meubalek.
hypothesis: Di bagian likot Deklarasi Kemerdekaan na teutuléh haba "Deklarasi Kemerdekaan Asli tanggal 4 Juli 1776".

source: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
reference: Sabab hana ureueng nyang tupeue deungön teuntѐe soe nyang tuléh nyan, nyang itupeue nyankeuh watѐe awai udépjih, na saboh keureutah maklumat rayeuk (ukoranjih 29¾ eunci ngön 24½ eunci) nyang igulông keu ikeubah.
hypothesis: Bah pih hana meusidroe pih nyang pasti soe nyang tuléhnyan, teunyata bahwa bak awai masa udeb jih, dokumen pergamen nyang rayeuk (nyan ukuran jih 293⁄4 inci deungon 241⁄2 inci) ji bungkôh keu jikeubah.

source: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
reference: deungön meunan, nyan mungkén cara teumuléh keu peunandajih.
hypothesis: Jadi, mungken notasi nyan ditamah hanya seubagai label.

source: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.
reference: Uroe trôh ngön prang-prang lheueh nyan ka ipeulheueh Peurancih blah baroh, teutapi blah tunoeng gohlom ipeulheueh.
hypothesis: Tapakatan uroe D dan prang-perang nyang lheuh nyan ka geupeubeubaih utara Prancis, tapi selatan mantong hana bebas.

source: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.
reference: Nyan ipeurintah Ureueng Peurancih "Vichy". Nyoekeuh Ureueng Peurancih nyang kalheueh meudame deungön Ureueng Jeurman nibak thon 1940 ngön ikeureuja deungön ureueng nyang reubot teuma ibandeng iprang awak nyan.
hypothesis: Jih ji peurintah le "Vichy" Prancis. nyoe ureung Prancis nyang ka peuget perdamaian deungen Jerman bak thon 1940 dan bekerja deungen penjajah daripada meuprang deungen awaknyan.

source: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
reference: Bak tanggai 15 Agustus 1940, awak sekutu ireubot Peurancih blah tunoeng, hajat nyan ipeunan “Operasi Dragoon”.
hypothesis: Bak tanggai 15 Agustus 1940, Sekutu ji serang Prancis seulatan, invasi nyan geuboh nan "Operasi Dragoon".

source: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
reference: Lam watѐe 2 minggu sagai teuntra Amerika ngön Peurancih Meurdheka geupeulheueh Peurancih blah tunong teuma ijak u Jeurman.
hypothesis: Lam dua minggu mantong pasukan Amerika dan Prancis Bebas ka jipeubeubaih Prancis selatan dan ji piyoh u Jerman.

source: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
reference: Saboh peuradaban nyankeuh saboh budaya nyang iweuek nibak saboh kawom ureueng nyang rayeuk nyang itinggai ngön ikeureuja meusajan, saboh masyarakat.
hypothesis: Peradaban adalah budaya tunggal yeng dibagi le sekelompok rayek ureung yeng udep ngen bekerja secara kooperatif, masyarakat.

source: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
reference: Tutoe peuradaban nyan asaijih nibak Basa Laten civilis, nyang artijih sipil, meusambong ngön Basa Laten civis, nyang artijih ureueng gampong, ngön civitas, nyang artijih kuta atawa nanggroe-kuta, ngön nyan pih meujan-jan ipeumakna ukoran nibak masyarakat.
hypothesis: Kata peradaban teuka dari bahasa Latin civilis, yang meuarti sipil, terkait deungen bahasa Latin civis, yang meuarti warga, dan civitas, yang meuarti kota atau kota-negara, dan nyan cit meuarti ukuran masyarakat.

source: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
reference: Nanggroe-kuta nyankeuh nyang puphon nanggroe-nanggroe. Saboh budaya peuradaban nyan peutunyok rot keu ipeutroen illeumee keu padum-padum boh masa, saboh euncit budaya nyang han gadoh ngön meusipreuk deungön ade.
hypothesis: Kota-negara nyan adalah pendahulu bangsa. budaya peradaban meupeujeut peunyata pengetahuan nyang ji peutron dari beberapa generasi, jejak budaya yang bertahan dan penyebaran yang adil.

source: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
reference: Budaya nyang ubeut nyan kayem gadoh deungön han ipeutinggai tanda seujarah nyang na ngön nyan han jeuet ikheun seubagoe peuradaban nyang patot.
hypothesis: Budaya ubit seureng lenyap tanpa meucre bukti sejarah yang relevan dan gagal diakui seubagai peradaban nyang layak.

source: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
reference: Seulama Prang Revolusi, lhee blah nanggroe bahgian phon that geupeugoet pomeurentah pusat nyang leumoh-deungön Koengres seubagoe saboh-sabohjih komponen- imiyup Anggaran Koenfederasi.
hypothesis: Seulama Prang Kemerdekaan, lhee blah nangroe phon-phon that geupeudeng peumeurintah pusat nyang leumoh deungon Kongres seubagoe saboh-saboh jih komponen di miyueb Artikel Konfederasi.

source: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.
reference: Koengres kön poe teunaga neuk peukeunong pajak, ngön, sabab hana eksekutif atawa yudikatif nasional, nyan meunurot bak otoritas nanggroe, nyang kayem that hana koorperatif, neuk peuteugak mandum buet.
hypothesis: Kongres hana na kuasa untuk geu peutren pajak, dan, kareuna hana eksekutif nasional atau keuputosan, jih meugantung bak otoritas negara bagian, yang seureng hana kooperatif, untuk geu kencengkan mandum tindakan jih.

source: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.
reference: Nyan pih kön poe keurajeuen neuk peusiblah qanun-qanun pajak ngön engkoeh nibak nanggroe bahgian.
hypothesis: Jih cit hana na kewenangan untuk meulanggar undang-undang pajak ngen tarif antara negara bagian.

source: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
reference: Pasai-pasai nyan peureule saboh kheun nibak mandum nanggroe bahgian seugolom jeuet geu ubah ngön nanggroe bahgian geuanggap hina pomeurentah pusat sampoe wakie awak nyan kayem that hana deuh.
hypothesis: Artikel nyan dipeureulee persetujuan seucara bulat dari mandum negara bagian seugolom jih jeut dipeubah dan negara bagian dipeutren pemerintah pusat seucara ringan sampoe perwakilan awak nyan seureng hana.

source: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.
reference: Sipak bhan nasional Italia, sajan deungön keulompok sipak bhan nasional Jeurman na keuh keulompok paléng meuhase keuduwa i donya ngön nyan keuh juara Piala Donya FIFA nibak thon 2006.
hypothesis: Tim nasional Italia, meusigoe ngon tim nasional Jerman, nakeuh tim nyang keudua nyang paléng meuhase di donya ngon jeut keu juara Piala Donya FIFA bak thon 2006.

source: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
reference: Ulahraga meusyeuhue itamoeng keuh sipak bhan, bola basket, bola poli, polo ie, angga, rugby, weng itangen, hoki eh, hoki roller, ngön balap moto F1.
hypothesis: Olahraga populer teumasok sepak bola, bola basket, voli, polo air, pajoeh, rugbi, bersepeda, hoki es, hoki roller dan balap motor F1.

source: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.
reference: Ulahraga musem leupie paléng meusyuhue i wilayah Utara, deungön ureueng Italia meulomba lam tandeng internasional ngön acara Olimpiade.
hypothesis: Olahraga musim dingin paleng populer di wilayah utara, deungen Italia bersaing di game internasional ngen acara Olimpiade.

source: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
reference: Jeupang geumat karap 7.000 pulo (paléng rayeuk nakeuh Honshu), peugoet Jepang jeuet pulo rayeuk keu 7 bak donya!
hypothesis: Jepang na hampir 7.000 pulo (paling rayek jih adalah Honshu), jeut keu pulo keu-7 paleng rayek di donya!

source: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"
reference: Kareuna klaster/keulompok nibak pulo Jepang, Jepang kayem dipeugah, bak posisi geografis, sebagoe "kepuloan"
hypothesis: "Kaleuh cluster/kelompok pulo nyang na di Jeupang, Jeupang seureng dikhen, bak posisi geografis, seubagoe "kapulauan"

source: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.
reference: Taiwan pu phon jak teuma bak abad keu 15 dipat ureueng meulaôt Eropa roet geutuleh nan pulo nyan sebagoe Ilha Formosa, atawa pulo lagak.
hypothesis: Taiwan mulai dimulai bak abad keu-15 di pat para pelaut Eropa nyang lewat catat nama pulau nyan seubagoe Ilha Formosa, atau pulau yang indah.

source: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.
reference: Bak thon 1624, Kanto India Timu Beulanda peudong basis bak Taiwan Baratdaya, pu phon transformasi lam meuhase bijeh-bijeh aseuli ngön geujok buet kuli Cina keu keureuja bak blang ngön lampoh saka.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1624, Perusahaan Hindia Timur Beulanda dipeudeng pangkalan di barat daya Taiwan, dipeulaku transformasi lam praktek produksi gandom pribumi ngen dipeukerjakan buruh Cina untuk bekerja di perkebunan beras dan gula jih.

source: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.
reference: Bak thon 1683, pasukan Dinasti Qing (1644-1912) geumat kuasa wilayah bineh barat ngön utara Taiwan ngön deklarasi Taiwan sebagoe propinsi poemeurintah Qing bak thon 1885.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1683, pasukan dinasti Qing (1644-1912) ji kontrol wilayah pantai barat ngon utara Taiwan ngon ji peumaklum Taiwan seubagoe propinsi Kekaisaran Qing bak thon 1885.

source: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.
reference: Bak thon 1895, oh lheueh taloe lam Prang Sino-Jeupang Phon (1894-1895), pomeurentah Qing geuteken peurjanjian Shimonoseki, nyang toh dijok keudaulatan ateueh Taiwan u Jeupang, nyang mat poemerentah sampoe 1945.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1895, lheuh ka glah lam Prang Sino-Jepang (1894-1895), pemerintah Qing ditanda tangani Perjanjian Shimonoseki, yang dipeutren kedaulatan atas Taiwan keu Jepang, yang peumeurintah pulo nyan sampoe thon 1945.

source: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.
reference: Machu Picchu nyan na lhee boh geudong, nyang geukheun Intihuatana, Kuil Mata Uroe, ngön Kama Lhee Boh Tingkeup.
hypothesis: Machu Picchu terdiri dari lhee struktur utama, yaitu Intihuatana, Kuil Matauroe, ngen Ruang Lhee Jendela.

source: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.
reference: Le nibak geudoeng nyang na ibineh peurumahan ka i peudoeng keu duwa goe ngön makeusud keu geubie keu jamee saboh peumandangan nyang leubeh beutôi pakriban hi geudoeng nyoe nyang seubeutôijih.
hypothesis: Sebagian rayek bangunan di pinggiran kompleks kaleuh ji peugot lom untuk jibri ide yang leubeh get keu wisatawan tentang rupa asli jih.

source: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and restoration continues till today.
reference: Lam thon 1976, lhee persen dari Machu Picchu ka ipeugoet lom ngön buet pueget nyoe mantoeng jipubuet sampoe uroenyo.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1976, lhee ploh persen Machu Picchu kaleuh ji restorasi dan restorasi manteng sampoe uroe nyoe.

source: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era.
reference: Tamseejih, ukoe gamba foto teudoeng nyan paléng ladem lam donya nakeuh 35mm, nyan keuh ukoe pilem nyang paléng le nyang toe ngön masa pilem analog.
hypothesis: Miseu jih, format fotografi gambar teutap nyang paleng umum di donya adalah 35mm, yeng merupakan ukuran film dominan bak akhe era film analog.

source: It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.
reference: Nyoe mantoeng dipeuna sampoe ino hat, tapi nyang leubeh peunténg aspek rasiojih nyang ka dipeuwareh lam ukoe sensor gamba nibak kamera digital.
hypothesis: Nyan manteng ji produksi uroe nyoe, tapi yang leubeh peunteng rasio aspek jih ka ji wareh le format sensor gamba kamera digital.

source: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.
reference: Ukoe 35mm nyan seubeutôijih, nyang mumangjih, 36mm lam panyang meusampeng ngön 24mm manyang.
hypothesis: Format 35mm nyan, seubagian bingung, luwah jih 36mm, tinggi jih 24mm.

source: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.
reference: Aspek rasio lam ukoe nyoe (nyang jibagi lam duwablah keu tatumee dum-numboi rasi nyang paléng biyasa) nakeuh dikheun 3:2.
hypothesis: Rasio aspek format nyo (meubagi dua blah untuk meutumeng rasio bilangan bulat yeng paleng sederhana) oleh karena nyan dikhen 3:2.

source: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.
reference: Jai format nyan biyasa (keuluwarga APS keu format, keu tamsee) nyan seubandeng atawa leubeh toe keunira u aspek rasio nyo.
hypothesis: Le format umum (APS keluarga format, miseu jih) sama atau mendekati rasio aspek nyo.

source: The much-abused and often-ridiculed rule of thirds is a simple guideline creating dynamism while keeping a measure of order in an image.
reference: Hukom keulhee nyang paléng jai dipeureuloh ngön nyang paléng jai dikheun keu brok nakeuh saboh peutunyok nyang biyasa keu peuna peurobahan oh watѐe peuteutap ukoe nyang meujalen lam saboeh gamba.
hypothesis: Aturan pertiga nyang le that ji peuguna seucara salah dan seureng ji hina adalah pedoman sederhana yang ji peuget dinamisme seudangkan ji jaga urutan dalam gambar.

source: It states that the most effective place for the main subject is at the intersection of lines dividing the image into thirds vertically and horizontally (see example).
reference: Nyoe jipeugah bahwasajih teumpat nyang paléng jroeh keu beunda nyang phon nakeuh bak simpang nibak meubagoe gareh nyang bagi gamba lam keulhee gareh linteueng ateueh ngön meusampeng (neukalon tamsee).
hypothesis: Nyo dipeugah bahwa teumpat yeng paleng efektif untuk subjek utama adalah di simpang gareh yeng meubagi gamba jeut keu lhee secara vertikal ngen horizontal (nging contoh).

source: During this period of European history, the Catholic Church, which had become rich and powerful, came under scrutiny.
reference: Seulama periode seujarah Eropa nyoe, Geureja Katolik, nyang ka kaya ngon meukuasa, meuteumeung sorotan.
hypothesis: Seulama periode seujarah Eropa nyo, Gereja Katolik, nyang ka jeut kaya ngon meukuasa, ka teuliti.

source: For over a thousand years the Christian religion had bound European states together despite differences in language and customs. I
reference: Seulama leubeh dari siribee thon agama Kristen ka lheueh meuikat nanggroe-nanggroe Eropa mandum adak pih na meubeda basa ngon adat istiadat. Lon
hypothesis: Seulama leubeh dari siribée thon agama Kristen ka meuikat nanggroe-nanggroe Eropa seucara meusapat meskipun na perbedaan bahasa dan adat istiadat.

source: Its all-pervading power affected everyone from king to commoner.
reference: Kuasajih nyang meucakop sigalajih ipeungaroh mandum ureueng dari raja sampoe rakyat jeulata.
hypothesis: Kuasa jih nyang meulimpah ruwah meupeungaroh bak mandum ureuëng phon nibak raja sampoe rakyat biasa.

source: One of the main Christian tenets is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty and that the monetary funds of the church are there specifically for that reason.
reference: Salah saboh peurinsep utama Kristen nakeuh bahwa keukayaan haroh jingui keu peukureueng deurita ngon kemisikinan ngon bahwa peng moneter geureja na khusus keu alasan nyan.
hypothesis: Salah saboh ajaran Kristen utama adalah bahwa keukayaan haroh dipakek untuk meupeukureung penderitaan ngen kemiskinan dan bahwa dana moneter gereja na khusus untuk alasan nyan.

source: The central authority of the church had been in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money led many to question whether this tenet was being met.
reference: Otoritas pusat geureja kalheueh na di Roma seulama leubeh dari siribee thon ngon pemusatan kekuasaan ngon peng nyoe jipeuget le ureng teumanyong peu peurinsep nyoe teupeunuhi.
hypothesis: Keukuasaan pusat geurija na di Roma seulama leubeh dari siribeng thon dan konsentrasi kekuasaan ngen peng nyoe geu peu manyak le ureung untuk geu tanyong peu kheueh ajaran nyo dipeutente.

source: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany.
reference: Hana trep oh leuh bicah prangnyan, ureueng Britania ggeupuphon peutheun rauh i laôt keu ureueng Jeurman.
hypothesis: Hana treb óh ka lheueh prang nyan, Britania geupeuphon blokade angkatan laut Jerman.

source: The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries.
reference: Reuncana nyan beutôi keu jeuet meuhase, nyan jipeuputoh peukakah keu ureueng militer ngön masyarakat, adakpi peutheun rauh nyoe meulanggeh ngön hukom Donya nyang ka geuteurimong le mandum nyang dipeugöt le ladom nyang meusaboh pakat duwa reutoh thon nyang ka ulikot.
hypothesis: Strategi nyan terbukti efektif, meupeutôh pasokan militer ngon sipil nyang peunteng, meskipun blokade nyo melanggar hukum internasional nyang umum dituri nyang dikodifikasi le perjanjian internasional bak dua abad nyang ka leupah.

source: Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships.
reference: Ureueng Britain geujaga wilayah laôt le bansa keu peutheun mandum kapai nak bek jeuet jitamoeng lam wilayah laôt nyang dumpat na, nyan jeuet keu sabab ceulaka bahpih kapai biyasa.
hypothesis: Inggréh dipeuget minyeuk di ie internasional untuk geucegah kapai-kapai dipeutamong u mandum bagian laot, nyang jeut keu bahaya bahkan keu kapai-kapai netral.

source: Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.
reference: Nibak phon nyoe dit nyang na jipakoe keu reuncana nyoe, ureueng Jeurman geupreh saboh reuncana nyang rap saban u kapai seulam prang ureueng nyan nyang bibeuh.
hypothesis: Kareuna na tanggapan nyang teubatah keu taktik nyo, Jerman diharap tanggapan nyang saban untuk prang kapai selam hana teubatah jih.

source: During the 1920s, the prevailing attitudes of most citizens and nations was that of pacifism and isolation.
reference: Oh thon 1920an, peukateun nyang paléng deuh lam dum masyarakat ngön bansa-bansa nakeuh pileh keu dame ngön udep peuaseng droe.
hypothesis: Seulama thon 1920-an, sikap nyang meukuasa dari seubagian rayek warga dan bansa adalah pasifisme ngen isolasi.

source: After seeing the horrors and atrocities of war during World War I, nations desired to avoid such a situation again in the future.
reference: Aleuh guekalon peumandangan nyang yo ngön zalem nibak prang lam masa prang donya I, bansa-bansa ka geugesee keu peutheun keudaan lagѐe nyan lam watѐe nyang ukeu.
hypothesis: Óh ka lheueh jikalon keujadian-keujadian nyang keujadian bak watée Prang Donya I, bansa-bansa meuheuét that mangat hana teujadi lom keuadaan nyang lagée nyan bak masa ukeue.

source: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States of America to accept a job with the Edison Company in New York City.
reference: Lam thon 1884, Tesla geuminah u Amerika keu geuteurimong saboh buet nibak kilang Edison di Kuta New York.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1884, Tesla geupinah u Amerika Serikat untuk geuteurimong pekerjaan di Edison Company di New York City.

source: He arrived in the US with 4 cents to his name, a book of poetry, and a letter of recommendation from Charles Batchelor (his manager in his previous job) to Thomas Edison.
reference: Gobnyan teuka i Amerika ngön 4 sen peng ateueh nan gobnyan, saboh buku puisi, ngön saboh surat rekom nibak Charles Batchelor (manajer gobnyan nibak buet awai geuh) u Thomas Edison.
hypothesis: Jih troh u AS deungen 4 sen keu nan jih, saboh buku puisi, dan surat rekomendasi dari Charles Batchelor (manajer jih bak buet sigolom jih) keu Thomas Edison.

source: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.
reference: Cina masa jameun na saboh cara nyang khas keu peuleumah masa nyang meubeda; tiep masa nibak Cina atawa tiap keuluwarga nyang teungoh lam kuwasa nakeuh lam dinasti nyang jioh meupisah.
hypothesis: Cina kuno na cara unik untuk menunjukan periode watee yang berbeda; tiep tahap Cina atau tiep keluarga yang berkuasa adalah dinasti yang khas.

source: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.
reference: Nacit meuhapit lam tiep dinasti nyan saboh masa nyang hana timang ngön daerah-daerah nyang meupisah-pisah. Hai nyang paléng jituri lam masa nyoe nakeuh masa Lhee Boh Keurajen nyang na lam masa 60 thon meuhapit lam masa Han ngön masa Dinasti Jin.
hypothesis: Meunan cit antara tieb-tieb dinasti na masa nyang hana stabil nibak propinsi nyang teubagi. nyang paleng terkenal nibak periode nyoe adalah periode Tiga Kerajaan nyang berlangsung selama 60 thon antara Dinasti Han ngon Dinasti Jin.

source: During these periods fierce warfare took place between many nobles fighting for the throne.
reference: Lam watѐe masa nyoe prang nyang rayeuk nibak ramee ampon nyang geumeulhoe sabe keudro-droe keu mita teumpat duek keu raja.
hypothesis: Seulama periode nyo terjadi prang sengit antara le bangsawan yang meuprang untuk tahta.

source: The Three Kingdoms was one of the bloodiest eras in Ancient China’s history thousands of people died fighting to sit in the highest seat in the grand palace at Xi’an.
reference: Lhee Boh Keurajen nyan nakeuh saboh masa nyang paléng lee roe darah lam seujarah Cina Jameun meuribee droe ureueng matee keu mita teumpat duek lam teumpat duek paléng manyang lam meuligoe rayeuk I Xi’an.
hypothesis: Keurajeuën Lhee nakeuh saboh masa nyang paleng meudarah lam seujarah Cina Kuno. Ribe-ribe ureueng maté dalam prang keu duek bak kurusi nyang paleng manyang di meuligoe raya di Xi'an.

source: There are a lot of social and political effects such as the use of metric system, a shift from absolutism to republicanism, nationalism and the belief the country belongs to the people not to one sole ruler.
reference: Disinan le akibat sosial ngön politek lage lam geu ngui keu cara ukoe-meuukoe, meubah cara nibak seumike cara mutlak keu republik, peurasaan meubansa ngön pateh keu nanggroe nyang poejih nakeuh masyarakat ngön kon sidroe ureueng seubagoe nyang mat kuwasa.
hypothesis: Na le efek sosial ngen politik lage penggunaan sistem metrik, pergeseran dari absolutisme keu republikalisme, nasionalisme dan keyakinan bahwa nanggroe nyan milik rakyat dan kon sidroe penguasa.

source: Also after the Revolution occupations were open to all male applicants allowing the most ambitious and successful to succeed.
reference: Nacit oh leuh revolusi buet ube na ka jipuetaba u mandum ureueng agam nyang peureulee keu buet nyoe jipeuhah saboh luweng u tiep ureueung nyan paléng na meuheut ngön nyang paléng meuwasee keu leubeh meuwasee lom.
hypothesis: Meunan cit lheuh Revolusi pekerjaan terbuka keu mandum pelamar agam yang memungkinkan yang paleng ambisius dan sukses untuk berhasil.

source: Same goes for the military because instead of army rankings being based on class they were now based on cailaber.
reference: Sabancit na bak militer sabab nibak phon pangkat lam militer nyan jipeusadeu bak glah jino atranyan ka jipeusadeu bak soe nyang na teuleubeh.
hypothesis: Meunan cit untuk militer karena hana pangkat angkatan prang nyang geupeudong deungen kelas, jinoe geupeudong deungen cailaber.

source: The French Revolution also inspired many other repressed working class people of other country's to began their own revolutions.
reference: Revolusi Peurancih nyan na cit jibie inspirasi keu rame ureueng nyan udep lam buet nyang hek lam nanggroe luwa keu ureueng nyan geupeugöt revolusi cit.
hypothesis: Revolusi Prancis cit geu inspirasi le ureung laen yang dipeureksa dari kelas pekerja di nanggroe laen untuk memulai revolusi awak nyan.

source: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
reference: Muhammad nyang leubeuh meuheut geuh nibak hai-hai nyang di luwa udep nyang biyasa nyoe. Gobnyan kayem geuh lam guha nyang dudoe dituri deungön guha “Hira” di ateueh gunong “Nur” (cahya) keu teumpat meukalut.
hypothesis: Nabi Muhammad amat tertarik bak hai-hai nyang leubeh nibak udep donya nyoe. gobnyan biasa geujak u saboh guha nyang jeut keu Hira di Gunong Noor (cahaya) untuk merenung.

source: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.
reference: Gobnyan geudom lam guha, nyang gobnyan jeuetudep keu lam ladom watѐe, nyang bi gamba nyang jeulaih keu Muhammad neuk toe ngön roh.
hypothesis: guha nyan keudroe, nyang bertahan dari masa, geubri gambaran yang sangat nyata dari kecenderungan spiritual Muhammad.

source: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.
reference: Geuduek di ateueh saboh nibak bak gunong lam wilayah utara Mekah, guha nyan keubit meupisah nibak donya luwa.
hypothesis: Meureuhat di ateueh salah saboh gunong di utara Mekkah, guha nyan teutap terisolasi dari seutara donya.

source: In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation.
reference: Nyatajih, nyoe hana mudah keu tateume adakpi meunyö sidroe ureueng jituepue na guha nyan, guha nyoe keubit meupisah.
hypothesis: Bahkan, hana mudah untuk meurumpok bahkan meunyo sidroe ureung jiteupeue bahwa jih na.

source: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
reference: Hana meusapue nyang deuh seulaén langet nyang gleh, ceudah di ateueh ngön le gunong meulingka. Bacut hai nyang jeuet takalon ngön tadeungoe nibak dalam guha nyoe.
hypothesis: Hana sapeue pih nyang jeut ta kalon seulaen langet nyang gleh ngon indah di ateuh nyan ngon le gunong nyang na di seukeulileng nyan.

source: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.
reference: Piramida Raya i Giza nyankeuh saboh sagai nibak tujoh hai-hai nyang peugöt hireuen nyang mantong didong uroe nyoe.
hypothesis: Piramida rayek di Giza adalah saboh-saboh jih dari tujoh keajaiban nyang mantong teudong saat nyoe.

source: Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of many large pyramid structures built to honor dead Pharaoh.
reference: Dipeudong le Ureueng Meuseee bak abad keu lhee BCE, Piramida Raya nyankeuh saboh nibak jai geudoeng piramida nyang dipeugöt keu jitabek Firaun nyang ka mate.
hypothesis: Dipeudong le ureung Mesir bak abad keu lhee SM, Piramida Raya adalah salah saboh dari le struktur piramida rayek yang dibangun untuk menghormati Firaun yang ka mate.

source: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in the Egyptian Valley of the Dead contains several pyramids (of which the great pyramid is the largest), several small tombs, several temples, and the great Sphinx.
reference: Tanoh Manyang Giza, atawa "Lampoh Jeurat Giza" bak Panton Mate Ureueng Meuse nyan na padum boh piramida (teuma piramida raya nyan nyankeuh nyang paléng raya), padum boh jeurat ubeut, padum boh teumpat keuramat, ngön Sphinx nyang raya.
hypothesis: "Plateau Giza, atau "Necropolis Giza" di Lembah Mati di Mesir na padim boh piramida (yang piramida rayek adalah yang paleng rayek), padim boh kuburan ubit, padim boh kuil, ngen Sphinx rayek".

source: The great pyramid was created to honor the Pharaoh Khufu, and many of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members.
reference: Piramida raya nyan dipeugöt keu dihoreumat Firaun Khufu, ngön jai piramida-piramida nyang leubeh ubeut, jeurat-jeurat, ngön teumpat-teumpat keuramat nyang dipeugöt keu dihoreumat peurumoh Khufu ngön anggota wali karongjih.
hypothesis: Piramida rayek dipeuget untuk menghormati Firaun Khufu, ngen le piramida, kuburan, ngen kuil yeng lubeh ubit dipeuget untuk menghormati istri ngon anggota keluarga Khufu.

source: The "up bow" mark looks like a V and the "down bow mark" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side.
reference: Tanda "panah ateueh" deuh lagѐe saboh V ngön "tanda panah yup" lagѐe saboh krak atawa balok nyang gadoh gareh yupjih.
hypothesis: "Bukong ateuh" tanda nyan deuh jih lagee V dan "bukong ateuh" tanda nyan lagee staple atau kotak yang hana sisi bagian baroh jih.

source: Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow.
reference: Ateueh meukeusudjih gata suwah puphon bak pucok ngön teugon panahjih, ngön yup meukeuseudjih gata suwah puphon bak kot (teumpat nibak jaroe gata meumat panah) ngön meutarek panah.
hypothesis: Teungoh nyan meuarti awak nyan harus mulai dari ujong dan mendorong busur, dan u likot meuarti awak nyan harus mulai dari kodok (yang merupakan tempat jaroe awak nyan memegang busur) dan menarik busur.

source: An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive.
reference: Panah ateueh biasajih peugöt su yang leubeh halôh, teuma panah yup nyankeuh leubeh teuga ngön leubeh kreueh.
hypothesis: Su nyang meu-up-bow biasa jih meu-generasi suara nyang leubeh leumoh, seudangkan su nyang meu-down-bow leubeh teuga dan leubeh tegas.

source: Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected.
reference: Bek chok keu neu top bak tanda droe, tapi neuingat tanda meucetak nyang bungkok nyan na hideh keu sabab musik, teuma awak nyan biasajih suwah ditabek.
hypothesis: Rasakan bebas untuk meucetak tanda-tanda droeneuh, tapi ingat tanda-tanda pujoe nyang dicetak na untuk alasan musik, jadi awak nyan biasa jih harus dipeuhareum.

source: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women.
reference: Raja Louis XVI nyang teumakot, Ratu Marie Antoinette, duwa boh sinyak awak nyan nyang mantoeng ubeut (Marie Therese nyang 11 thon umu ngön Louis-Charles nyang peut thon umu) ngön syehdara inoeng Raja nyan, tuan Putroe Elizabeth, bak tanggai 6 Oktober 1789 geupaksa lom u Paris nibak Versailles lé saboh kawan ureueng inoeng pasai.
hypothesis: Raja Louis XVI nyang teumakot, Ratu Marie Antoinette dua droe aneuk muda jih (11 thon Marie Therese dan 4 thon Louis-Charles) dan syedara inong raja, Madame Elizabeth, bak 6 Oktober 1789 dipaksa lom u Paris dari Versailles le sekelompok ureung inong pasar.

source: In a carriage, they traveled back to Paris surrounded by a mob of people screaming and shouting threats against the King and Queen.
reference: Bak geurbong, awaknyan ijak lom u Paris ikeulileng le keulompok ureueng nyang geukrie-krie ngön geusurak geu ancam Raja ngön Ratu.
hypothesis: Lam saboh geuritan, awak nyan geuwoe u Paris di seukeulileng le ureung ramé nyang geulanteu ngon geutahkan raja ngon ratu.

source: The mob of people forced the King And Queen to have their carriage windows wide open.
reference: Kawan awaknyan ureueng ipaksa Raja ngön Ratu keu geupeuhah tingkap beurayeuk.
hypothesis: Rakyat nyang ramé nyan jipaksa Raja ngon Ratu keu geubuka tingkap geuritan jih.

source: At one point a member of the mob waved the head of a royal guard killed at Versailles in front of the terrified Queen.
reference: Bak saboh titek, sidroe anggouta ureueng ramee geudada ulee aneuk buah keurajaan nyang ka ipoeh i Versailles ikeu Ratu nyang geusuen.
hypothesis: Bak saboh watee sidroe anggota kerumunan nyan meubeuot ulée sidroe peungawai kerajaan nyang jipoh di Versailles di hadapan Ratu nyang teumakot.

source: The war expenditures of U.S. imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines were paid for by the Filipino people themselves.
reference: Ipeutubiet prang Imperialisme AS lam prang Filipina ibayeu le Filipina ureueng nyan keudroe.
hypothesis: Biaya prang imperialisme AS untuk penaklukan Filipina dibayeue le rakyat Filipina keudroe.

source: They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses.
reference: Awaknyan teupaksa ibayeu pajak bak razem colonial AS keu ibayeu ladom peng tubiet ngön bungoeng ipeuwajeb i layang ateueh nan pomeurentah Filipina roet rumoh peurbankan Wall Street.
hypothesis: Awak nyan dipaksa untuk jibayeue pajak keu rezim kolonial AS untuk meupeutanggung sebagian rayek pengeluaran dan bunga obligasi yang meuapung deungen nan pemerintah Filipina melalui perbankan Wall Street.

source: Of course, the superprofits derived from the protracted exploitation of the Filipino people would constitute the basic gains of U.S. imperialism.
reference: Nyan teuntee, laba rayeuk nyang geutumee nibak trep-trep eksploitasi keu ureueng Filipina nyankeuh laba asai Imperialisme AS.
hypothesis: Teuman, keuntungan super nyang ji hasilkan dari eksploitasi rakyat Filipina nyang treb-treb jeut keu keuntungan dasar imperialisme AS.

source: To understand the Templars one must understand the context that prompted the creation of the order.
reference: Keu tameuphom Templar, sidro-droe ureueng suwah geu meuphom pue nyang meudali nyang ipoek jeuet saboh atoeran.
hypothesis: Untuk meuphom kaum Templar, ureung nyan harus meuphom konteks yang geu peuget ordo nyan.

source: The age where the events took place is commonly referred as the High Middle Ages the period of European history in the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (AD 1000–1300).
reference: Bak jameun dipat keujadian nyan biyasa geukheun sebagoe Abad Peurteungahan Manyang, masa seujarah Eropa bak abad keu 11, 12, ngön 13 (1000-1300 M).
hypothesis: Jaman di pat kejadian nyan terjadi biasa jih dikhen sebagai Abad Pertengahan Tinggi periode seujarah Eropa bak abad keu-11, 12, ngen 13 (AD 10001300).

source: The High Middle Ages were preceded by the Early Middle Ages and followed by the Late Middle Ages, which by convention ends around 1500.
reference: Abad Peurteungahan Manyang ipuphon bak awai Abad Peurteungahan ngön iseutöt le Abad Peurteungahan Akhee, nyang meunurot konveksi seuleusoe sangkira thon 1500.
hypothesis: Abad Teungoh Teungoh di awai abad teungoh awai dan diikuti le abad teungoh akhe, yeng seucara konvensional berakhir sekitar thon 1500.

source: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology.
reference: Determinisme teknologi nakeuh istilah nyang mencakup meubagoe ide lam praktek, dari dorongan teknologi atawa keharusan teknologi trôh ban hareutoe nyang ketat bahwa teukeudi manusia idorong lé logika dasar nyang teuhubông deungön hukôm ilmiah ngön manifestasijih lam teknologi.
hypothesis: Determinisme teknologi adalah istilah yeng mencakup berbagai ide dalam praktek, dari dorongan teknologi atau imperatif teknologi untuk arti ketat bahwa nasib manusia didorong le logika yang mendasar yeng terkait deungen hukum ilmiah ngen manifestasi jih dalam teknologi.

source: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has "effects" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned.
reference: Sebagian rayek interpretasi determinisme teknologi teubagi u lam dua gagasan umum: nyang phôn, bahwa perkembangan teknologi nyan geuikôt jalan nyang sebagian rayek na di luwa pengarôh budaya atawa puliték. Ngön kedua, bahwa teknologi nibak giliranjih na "efek" nibak masyarakat nyang melekat secara sosial.
hypothesis: "Seubagian rayek interpretasi determinisme teknologi meubagi dua ide umum: bahwa perkembangan teknologi keudroe meuturot jalan yang leubèh luwah dari pengaruh budaya atau politik, dan bahwa teknologi seubagoe giliran na ""efek"" bak masyarakat nyang inheren, daripada kondisi sosial".

source: For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads.
reference: Keu contoh, ladom peugah bahwa kendaraan bermotor pasti mengarah nibak perkembangan jalan raya.
hypothesis: Miseu jih, sidroe jeut peugah bahwa mobil meuseuti meupeutarah keu pengembangan jalan raya.

source: However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.
reference: Tapi, jaringan jalan nasional h'an layak secara ekonomi hanya keu padum boh moto, jadi metode produksi barô ipeukeumang keu peukureueng biaya po moto.
hypothesis: Namun, jaringan jalan nasional hana ekonomis untuk hanya seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara ekonomi untuk seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara ekonomis untuk seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara ekonomis untuk seucara seucara seucara ekonomis untuk seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara ekonomis untuk seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara ekonomis untuk seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seucara seuc

source: Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies.
reference: Kepemilikan moto massal pih jeut keu seubab leubéh le insiden kecelakaan di jalan, nyang meuarah nibak teuneumèe teknik barô lam perawatan kesehatan keu peugöt tubôh nyang reulöh.
hypothesis: Keubutuhan mobil massal cit meupeuget tingkat kecelakaan di jalan raya leubeh rayek, yang meupeuget penemuan teknik baro lam perawatan kesehatan untuk meupeugét badan nyang rusak.

source: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.
reference: Romantisisme nakeuh peungaroh rayeuk bak determinisme budaya, nyang geucok le ureueng tuleh lagѐe Gothe, Fichte, ngön Schlegel.
hypothesis: Romantisisme na elemen determinisme budaya yang rayek, yang dijok dari penulis lage Goethe, Fichte, ngen Schlegel.

source: In the context of Romanticism, the geography molded individuals, and over time customs and culture related to that geography arose, and these, being in harmony with the place of the society, were better than arbitrarily imposed laws.
reference: Lam konteks Romantisisme, geografi geupeugoet sidroe ureueng, ngön kayem bak adat ngön budaya nyang meusangkôt ngön geografi nyan itubiet, ngön nyoe, saban-saban ngön teumpat ureueng ramee, leubeh get dari hukom yang jipaksa pakriban nyang galak.
hypothesis: Dalam konteks Romantisisme, geografi meu bentuk individu, dan seulama wate adat ngon budaya nyang berhubungan deungen geografi nyan meu timbul, dan nyoe, yang selaras deungen teumpat masyarakat, leubeh get dari hukom nyang dipeurintah seucara sewenang-wenang.

source: In the manner that Paris is known as the fashion capital of the contemporary world, Constantinople was regarded as the fashion capital of feudal Europe.
reference: Kareuna Paris jikeunai seubagoe ibu kota mode donya kontemporer, Konstantinopel jianggap seubagoe ibu kota mode Eropa feodal.
hypothesis: Seucara Paris dikenal seubagoe ibu kota mode donya kontemporer, Konstantinopel dianggap seubagoe ibu kota mode Eropa feodal.

source: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.
reference: Teumpat nyan jituri seubagoe pusat keumewahan mulai bak kira-kira 400 M ngon meulangsong sampoe kira-kira 1100 M.
hypothesis: Keumuliaan jih seubagoe pusat keukayaan dimulai bak thon 400 M dan berlangsung sampoe sekitar thon 1100 M

source: Its status declined during the twelfth century mainly due to the fact that Crusaders had returned bearing gifts such as silks and spices that were valued more than what Byzantine markets offered.
reference: Statusjih geutren seulama abad keudua blah teuutama kareuna fakta bahwa Teuntra Saleb kalheueh geuwoe deungon jime hadiah lagee sutra ngon rempah-rempah yang meunilai leubeh dari peu nyang jipeutaba le pasar Bizantium.
hypothesis: Status jih menurun seulama abad keu dua blaih terutama kareuna fakta bahwa tentara salib kalheuh geuwoe geuba hadiah lagee sutra ngen rempah-rempah yang dipeubangga leubeh le dari yang ditawarkan le pasar Bizantium.

source: It was at this time that the transfer of the title of Fashion Capital from Constantinople to Paris was made.
reference: Bak watee nyan keuh geupinah gelar Fashion Capital dari Konstantinopel keu Paris.
hypothesis: Bak masa nyan keuh titeleh Modhe dari Konstantinopel keu Paris dipeuget.

source: Gothic style peaked in the period between the 10th - 11th centuries and the 14th century.
reference: Aleh gaya Gothic ipeusapat bak masa antara abad keu 10-11 ngön abad keu-14.
hypothesis: Gaya Gotik meupeuteubiet bak periode antara abad keu-10 - 11 ngen abad keu-14.

source: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.
reference: Phon that bajee sep brat i peungaroh le Budaya Byzantium i timue.
hypothesis: Bak awai peunganggonan sangat dipengaruhi le budaya Bizantium di timu.

source: However, due to the slow communication channels, styles in the west could lag behind by 25 to 30 year.
reference: Beuranggandum, roet peugah haba nyang trep, gaya blah barat i tinggai 25 sampoe 30 thon.
hypothesis: Namun, kareuna saluran komunikasi yang lambat, gaya di barat jeut meutanggong 25 hingga 30 thon.

source: towards the end of the Middle Ages western Europe began to develop their own style. one of the biggest developments of the time as a result of the crusades people began to use buttons to fasten clothing.
reference: Karab akhee bak Abad Teungoh Eropa Barat ipuphon peukeumang aleh awaknyan. Salah saboh keumajuan rayek pada jameun nyan seubagoe sabab ureueng prang saleb geupuphon ngui boh tip keu geuganceng bajee geuh.
hypothesis: bak akhe abad pertengahan Eropa barat mulai mengembangkan gaya awak nyan. salah saboh perkembangan paleng rayek bak masa nyan seubagoe akibat dari prang salib ureung mulai dipakek tombol untuk meukat peukayan

source: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family.
reference: Peurtanian subsisten nakeuh buet meutani nyang ipubuet keu meuhase peunajoh siuroe-uroe beu sep keu tapeusep peu nyang ipeureule le ureueng meutani ngön keuluwarga si agam/si inoeng.
hypothesis: pertanian subsisten adalah pertanian yeng dilakukan untuk produksi makanan yeng cukup untuk memenuhi kebutuhan petani ngen keluarga jih.

source: Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield.
reference: Peurtanian subsisten nakeuh sistem peurtanian seudeurhana, kayemjih organik, nyang geungui bijeh asli dari kawasan eko nyang geukeubah ngön geupeusapat deungön rotasi tanaman atawa cara laén nyang seudeurhana keu meurumpok wase nyang get.
hypothesis: Pertanian subsisten adalah sistem sederhana, seureng organik, yeng meupakek benih yeng dipeuseulamat asli ekoregion dikombinasikan deungen rotasi tanaman atau teknik yeng relatif sederhana laen untuk memaksimalkan hasil.

source: Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.
reference: Seucara historis ladom peutani roh lam peurtanian subsisten ngön nyoe mantoeng na dumpat nanggroe nyang ka maju.
hypothesis: Seujarah jih sebagian rayek petani terlibat dalam pertanian subsisten dan nyoe manteng kasus di le nanggroe berkembang.

source: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.
reference: Subkultur geu peusaboh ureueng nyang saboh pham nyang meurasa droe geuh hana ipeurumeun le ureueng ramee ngön mungken awaknyan meungeumbangkan rasa taturie droe teuh.
hypothesis: Subkultur geupeusapat individu yang berpikiran sama yang merasa terlupakan oleh standar masyarakat dan memungkinkan awak nyan untuk mengembangkan rasa identitas.

source: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
reference: Subkultur jeuetkeu meubeda sabab umue, etnis, glah, teumpat, ngön/atawa jeuneh meunale keulompok.
hypothesis: Subkultur jeut meubeda kareuna umu, etnisitas, kelas, lokasi, ngen/atau jenis kelamin anggota.

source: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.
reference: Kualitah-kualitah nyang meupeuteunte saboh subkultur seubagoe nyang meubeda na keuh lagѐe basa, estetika, agama, politek, seksual, giografis, atawa meusapat sabab musabab.
hypothesis: Sifeut-sifeut nyang meupeutentei subbudaya seubagai yang berbeda jeut bahasa, estetika, agama, politik, seksual, geografis, atau kombinasi faktor.
