source: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.
reference: Keulompok subkultur kayem geutanda keulompok awaknyan rhoet peunungui aleh nyang khas ngön simbolis, nyang itamoeng meuneungui, peukateun, ngön cara tametutoe.
hypothesis: Anggota subkultur seureng geu tanda keanggotaan awak nyan melalui penggunaan gaya yang khas dan simbolis, yeng mencakup mode, mannerisme, ngen jargon.

source: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.
reference: Salah saboh cara nyang paléng umumjih jingui keu ilustrasi peunténg sosial na keuh deungön geupeuguna padum boh dalie aneuk miet nyang malang, rhot hana geupeureumeun, hana get naseb, atawa seungaja jipeuleceh, han geumaklumat le ureueng rayeuk oh ka rayeuk geuh.
hypothesis: Salah saboh metode nyang paleng umum dipakek untuk meuilustrasikan penteng sosial adalah meupeuget nibak padum-padum boh kasus yang hana meuuntung dari aneuk miet nyang, kareuna hana peduli, musibah, atau penyalahgunaan yang sengaja, hana disosialisasikan le ureung rayeuk seulama awak nyan rayeuk.

source: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.
reference: Padum droe aneuk miet jikheun "kleut" atawa juwah. Padum droe aneuk miet kleut jikuroeng le ureueng (biasajih le ureueng syikjih); lam padum boh dalie, aneuk nyoe hana ipeureumeun sabab ureueng syikjih han geutung reuloh utak atawa tuboh aneuk miet nyan.
hypothesis: Aneuk-aneuk nyan geuboh nan "beureupah" atawa liar. Padum-padum droe aneuk beureupah ka ji ikat le ureung (biasa jih ureung tuha droe jih); lam padum-padum boh kasus, aneuk nyan ji tinggai sabab ureung tuha hana jitem keu aneuk nyan nyang na cacat intelektual atawa fisik nyang brat.

source: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.
reference: Aneuk-aneuk kleut mungken na keunong peulecehan atawa teumakot aneuk miet segohlom ikubah atawa iplueng.
hypothesis: Aneuk-aneuk liar mungken ka keunong peugleh aneuk miet nyang brat atawa trauma sigohlom geutinggai atawa geuplueng.

source: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
reference: Na sangkira laén jipeurayeuk le meulatang; na padum droe sit ka udep i alam rimba keudroe ih.
hypothesis: Laen jih dikheun ka jipeulahé lé binatang; na cit nyang dikheun ka udeb di padang beulantara keudroe-droe.

source: When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans.
reference: Watѐe abeh ipeurayeuk le meulatang kon manusiya, aneuk miet kleut jipeudeuh peukateun (bak batah tuboh) karap mandumjih lagѐe saboh-saboh meulatang keumuemiet, lagѐe teumakot atawa hana peureumeun keu manusiya.
hypothesis: Wate ji peuhase le binatang yang hana manusia, aneuk liar geu peuleumah perilaku (dalam batas fisik) hampir mandum lagee binatang peurawatan tertentu, lage takot atau hana peduli keu manusia.

source: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond.
reference: Suementara meureunoe meudasai proyek suwah geupeuget meureunoe nyang leubeh mudah ngon leubeh lagak, ureueng peurancah meulangkah leubeh jioh.
hypothesis: Sementara pembelajaran berbasis proyek harus meumbuat belajar leubeh mudah dan leubeh menarik, perancah leubeh maju.

source: Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project.
reference: Peurancah kon keuh metode peumeureunoe meulaén soe tuloeng geutem keu tip ureueng nyang barô peungalaman geumeurunoe lagѐe geungui program komputer barô atawa puphon proyek barô.
hypothesis: Gerbang kon metode belajar tapi leubeh bantuan yang meujok dukungan keu individu yang meulanggeh pengalaman belajar baro lage meupakek program komputer baro atau mulai proyek baro

source: Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office.
reference: Peurancah jeuet lagѐe virtual ngön nyata, deungön kalimah laén, sidroe gure na keuh bentoek nibak peurancah teutapi meunan sit awak seupet kertah ubeut i Microsoft Office.
hypothesis: Scaffold jeut virtual dan nyata, deungon kata laen, sidroe guru adalah saboh bentuk perancah tapi meunan cit ureung ubit klip kertas di Microsoft Office.

source: Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
reference: Peurancah Virtual jipeutamong lam peurangkat lunak ngön jimeukusud neuk jimeutanyong, meulake, ngön meusurah prosedur nyang mungken payah keu aneuk sikula neuk peulakue sidroe ih.
hypothesis: Scaffold virtual ji internalisasi lam perangkat lunak dan ji maksud untuk ji tanyong, jipaksa, dan ji jelaskan prosedur yang mungken payah untuk di tangani le mahasiswa keudroe.

source: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.
reference: Aneuk miet jipeuduek bak Panti Asuhan sabab meubagoe daliee, nibak hana ureueng peureumeun, peulecahan, ngön bahpih jirampok.
hypothesis: Aneuk-aneuk dipeutamong u rumoh-rumoh asuh untuk meubagoe alasan, mulai dari hana dipeurati, keu peugleh, dan bahkan keu pemerasan.

source: No child should ever have to grow up in an environment that is not nurturing, caring, and educational, but they do.
reference: Hana aneuk miet nyang suwah rayeuk lam dairah droe ih nyang hana soe peulhara, peureumeun, ngoe jipeurunoe, ngön teutapih awak nyan peubuet.
hypothesis: Hana sidroe aneuk miet nyang haroh rayeuk lam lingkungan nyang hana dipeulara, peutimang, dan meupeurunoe, teuma awaknyan na.

source: We perceive the Foster Care System to be a safety zone for these children.
reference: Kamoe meukira Sistim Peungasuhan Aneuk miet seubagoe zona nyang sanyum keu aneuk miet nyoe.
hypothesis: Kamoe meucen bahwa Sistem Peulara Asli nakeuh saboh kawasan aman bagi aneuk miet nyoe.

source: Our foster care system is supposed to provide safe homes, loving caregivers, stable education, and reliable health care.
reference: Sistim Peungasuhan Aneuk miet kamoe suwah meupeusaneut rumoh nyang aman, peungasoh nyang geumaseh, peumeureunoe nyang get, ngön peurawat kesihatan nyang pah.
hypothesis: Sistem perawatan asuh geutanyoe haroh meujok rumoh aman, peungawas nyang sayang, pendidikan nyang stabil, dan perawatan kesehatan nyang teupat.

source: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.
reference: Peungasuhan anukmiet payah geupeumeusaneut mandum peu nyang peurle nyang kurueng nibak rumoh awak nyan sugohlom jiasuh.
hypothesis: Peulara aslineun dipakek untuk jibri mandum kebutuhan nyang kureung na di rumoh nyang awak nyan kaleuh jicok.

source: The Internet combines elements of both mass and interpersonal communication.
reference: Internet geugabong unsur-unsur komunikasi massa ngon interpersonal.
hypothesis: Internet meucampong elemen komunikasi massal ngon interpersonal.

source: The distinct characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of the uses and gratifications approach.
reference: Sipheuet nyang meubeda dari Internet meuakibat dimensi tambahan dalam hai pendekatan penggunaan ngon gratifikasi.
hypothesis: Karakteristik nyang meubeda dari Internet meupeutarah dimensi tambahan dalam hai pendekatan penggunaan ngen gratifikasi.

source: For example, “learning” and “socialization” are suggested as important motivations for Internet use (James et al., 1995).
reference: Miseuejih, “meurunoe” ngon “sosialisasi” jisaran seubagoe motivasi peunteng keu ngui Internet (James et al., 1995).
hypothesis: Miseu jih, "meurunoe" ngen "peuseulidek sosial" dipeutunyok seubagoe motivasi peunteng untuk penggunaan Internet (James et al., 1995).

source: “Personal involvement” and “continuing relationships” were also identified as new motivation aspects by Eighmey and McCord (1998) when they investigated audience reactions to websites.
reference: “Keterlibatan droe” ngon “hubongan nyang meulanjot” jipeutentee cit seubagoe aspek motivasi baro le Eighmey ngon McCord (1998) watee awaknyan jisudi reaksi peserta keu situs web.
hypothesis: implikasi pribadi ngen hubungan nyang terus-menerus cit diidentifikasi seubagai aspek motivasi baro le Eighmey ngen McCord (1998) wate awak nyan menyelidiki reaksi penonton keu situs web.

source: The use of video recording has led to important discoveries in the interpretation of micro-expressions, facial movements which last a few milliseconds.
reference: Peunungui reukaman video jeuet meuhase soe nyang tumee peunteng lam intepretasi ekpresi mikro, grak muka nyang meugrak padum milidetik.
hypothesis: Penggunaan rekaman video kaleuh meupeuget penemuan peunteng dalam interpretasi ekspresi mikro, gerakan wajah yang berlangsung padim droe milidetik.

source: In particular, it is claimed that one can detect whether a person is lying by interpreting micro-expressions correctly.
reference: Seucara khas, jicap bahwajih sidroe ureueng jeuet jitupue pue keuh sidroe ureueng meusulet deungön geutakse ekpresi mikro deungön beutôi.
hypothesis: Khusus jih, diklaim bahwa sidroe jeut geu teume peu ureung nyan dusta deungen geu interpretasi ekspresi mikro seucara beutoi.

source: Oliver Sacks, in his paper The President's Speech, indicated how people who are unable to understand speech because of brain damage are nevertheless able to assess sincerity accurately.
reference: Olver Sacks, lam makalahjih Ceuramah Presiden, jipeutunyok kiban ureueng nyang han meuphom tapeugah haba sabab reuloh utak teutap jeuet jinilai sep trang.
hypothesis: Oliver Sacks, lam makalah jih The President's Speech, dipeutunyok pakriban ureung nyang hana jeut meuphom bicara kareuna rusak otak teutapi mampu meunilai kejujuran seucara akurat.

source: He even suggests that such abilities in interpreting human behavior may be shared by animals such as domestic dogs.
reference: Gobnyan malah jibri peunutoh bahwasajih meuphom nyang lagѐe nyan lam meumakna peukateun manusiya na sit bak meulatang lagѐe asee teupeulhara.
hypothesis: Jih bahkan geu sarankan bahwa kemampuan lage nyan dalam geu interpretasi perilaku manusia mungken dibagi le binatang lagee anjing domestik.

source: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.
reference: Peunelitian abad keuduwa ploh ka geupeuleumah bahwa na duwa keulompok jeuneh genetik: teusom ngön nyata.
hypothesis: Penelitian abad keu-20 kaleuh dipeudeh bahwa na dua kumpulan variasi genetik: nyang teusöm ngon nyang geu ekpresikan.

source: Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation.
reference: Mutasi meutamah jeuneh genetik barô, ngön seleksi peugadoh nibak jeuneh meusapat nyang nyata.
hypothesis: Mutasi ji peutamah variasi genetik baro, ngen seleksi ji cabot dari kumpulan variasi nyang diungkapkan.

source: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
reference: Segregasi ngön rekombinasi meukacok jeuneh ukeu u likot antara duwa kulam deungön tiep generasi.
hypothesis: Segregasi ngen rekombinasi mengocok variasi maju ngon mundur antara dua kolam deungen tiep generasi.

source: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.
reference: Di luwa bak sabana, payah keu saboh primata deungön sistem ceurna lagee manusiya keu peupunoh masam-aminojih nibak sumber daya bak kayee nyang na teuseudiya.
hypothesis: Di luwa sabana, sulet keu primata deungen sistem pencernaan lage manusia untuk memenuhi kebutuhan asam amino jih dari sumber daya tanaman yang na.

source: Moreover, failure to do so has serious consequences: growth depression, malnutrition, and ultimately death.
reference: Seulaén nyan, hana wase keu peubuet na akibat gasui: depresi meutimoh, keureueng gizi, ngön akhejih matee.
hypothesis: Leubeh nibak nyan, hana meupubuet nyan na akibat nyang brat: depresi bak masa rayeuk, kekurangan gizi, dan akhé jih maté.

source: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.
reference: Sumber daya bak kayee nyang paléng mangat diteume nakeuh protein nyang teuseudiya bak ôn ngön kacang-kacang, tapi nyoe payah dicerna primata lagѐe geutanyoe kecuali miseu geutagun.
hypothesis: Sumber tanaman nyang paleng mudah ji akses adalah protein nyang ji akses lam daun dan kacang-kacangan, tapi nyoe payah untuk primata lagee geutanyoe untuk ji cerna kecuali ji masak.

source: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.
reference: Seubalekjih, umpeuen meulatang (sidom, kamue, boh) kön sagai mangat dicerna, tapi cit geusediya protein lam kadar nyang le nyang na mandum masam amino esensial.
hypothesis: Seubalek jih, makanan binatang (semut, rayek, telur) kon mantong mudah dicerna, tapi jih na protein nyang le nyang na mandum asam amino nyang peunteng.

source: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.
reference: Mandum hai geupeutimang, geutanyoe hana peureule hireuen miseu nek geutanyoe keudroe peuseuleuso "masalah protein" awak nyan deungön cara nyang saban lagѐe nyang dipuebuet simpanse di sabana uroe nyoe.
hypothesis: "Mengingat mandum nyan, geutanyoe hana harok jika nenek moyang geutanyoe keudroe dipeupot "masalah protein" jih deungen cara yang sama lagee yang dilakukan simpanse di padang pasi saat nyoe.

source: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).
reference: Peuputoh eh nakeuh proses meujaga deungön seungaja watѐe masa eh normal gata ngön eh padum watѐe oh lheueh nyan (10-60 meunet).
hypothesis: Gangguan tidur adalah proses untuk sengaja bangun selama periode tidur normal dan tertidur sesaat kemudian (1060 menit).

source: This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you.
reference: Nyoejeuet deungön mangat dipuebuet deungön geungui jeum alarm nyang hana su keu jiba gata u watѐe jaga adak hana beutôi-beutôi peubeudoh gata.
hypothesis: Nyo jeut ji lakukan deungon mudah deungon ji pakek jam alarm nyang relatif seungab untuk ji peutron awak nyan keu sadar tanpa ji peugoet awak nyan seucara lengkap.

source: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.
reference: Miseu gata meuteume droe neuato jeum dari phon lam teungeuet gata, nyanjeuet dipuduek bak kama laén, geupaksa gata keu tron nibak teumpat eh keu peumatee.
hypothesis: Meunyo gata teurasa tapeugadoh ulang jam bak watee gata teungoh teu éh, jam nyan jeut dipeuduek bak saboh sagoe ruangan, nyang teupeusabab gata teubiet nibak kama keu tapeupuih jam nyan.

source: Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.
reference: Pilehan ateueh asai-bioritme nyang laén jitamong lam buet jep ie caye (keu phon ie atawa te, nyang diteupeu cit seubagoe diuretik sigohlom eh, geupaksa sidroe ureueng jaga keu geu to ie iek.
hypothesis: Pilihan laen nyang berbasis bioritme termasok minum le cairan (khusus jih ie atau teh, diuretik yang dikenal) seugolom tidur, dipaksa sidroe untuk bangun untuk urin.

source: The amount of inner peace a person possesses correlates oppositely to the amount of tension in one’s body and spirit.
reference: Jumlah dame baten nyang na bak sidroe ureueng meubandeng meubalek deungön jumlah ceukang lam tuboh ngön baten sidroe ureueng.
hypothesis: Tingkat damai batin nyang dimiliki seseorang berkorelasi berlawanan deungen tingkatan ketegangan dalam tuboh dan roh seseorang.

source: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force present. Every person has the potential to find absolute peace and contentment.
reference: Maken diet ceukang, maken positif teuga udep nyang na. Tiep ureueng na potensi keu meuteume dame ngön pueh mutlak.
hypothesis: Seumantong hana teurasa teukeujot, seumaken le energi nyang positif.

source: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.
reference: Tiep ureueng jeuet geuteume trang baten. Saboh hai nyang peuhalang tujuan nyoe nakeuh ceukang ngön hai negatif geutanyoe keudroe.
hypothesis: Soe mantong jeut mencapai pencerahan. Nyang na meuhalang tujuan nyoe adalah ketegangan dan negatifitas tanyoe.

source: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.
reference: Agama Buddha Tibet nakeuh asai bak euleumee nyang geupeuruno le Buddha, tapi dipeluah nibak rauh gaseh Mahayana ngön le teknik nibak Yoga India.
hypothesis: Buddhisme Tibet didasarkan bak ajaran Buddha, tapi dipeuluahkan le jalan cinta Mahayana dan le teknik dari Yoga India.

source: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.
reference: Bak prinsipjih Agama Buddha Tibet nyan seuderhana that. Nyoe salah saboh nibak Yoga Kundalini, meditasi ngön rauh gaseh nyang geuuem mandum.
hypothesis: Padahai prinsip jih Buddhisme Tibet sederhana. jih terdiri dari Kundalini Yoga, meditasi dan jalan cinta yang mencakup mandum.

source: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.
reference: Deungön Yoga Kundalini, teunaga Kundalini (teunaga trang baten) nakeuh geubangket teuma postur yoga, latihan naphah, mantra, ngön visualisasi.
hypothesis: Deungen Kundalini Yoga energi Kundalini (energi pencerahan) dipeubeudôh melalui postur yoga, latihan pernapasan, mantra dan visualisasi.

source: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.
reference: Pusat meditasi nibak Tibet nakeuh Deity Yoga. Röt visualisasi nibak meubagoe dewa lhueng teunaga nyan jipeugleh, chakra jipeu aktif ngön keusadaran trang baten ka jipeugöt.
hypothesis: Pusat meditasi Tibet adalah Deity Yoga. meulalui visualisasi deity yang bermacam-macam saluran energi dipeugleh, chakra dipeugaktifkan dan kesadaran pencerahan dipeuget.

source: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.
reference: Jeurman nakeuh musoh sajan lam Prang Donya 2, nyang arah bak keureujasama antara Uni Soviet ngön Amerika Serikat. Deungön meuakhe prang meuhantan sistem, proses ngön budaya jeuet seubab nanggroe-nanggroe rhot.
hypothesis: Jerman adalah musoh umum lam Prang Donya II, nyang meupeuget kerjasama antara USSR ngon AS.

source: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.
reference: Deungön duwa thon meuakhe prang, euntee syarikat jinoe jeuet musoh ngön Prang Leupie ka jipuphon.
hypothesis: Deuh dua thon lheuh prang nyan, mantan sekutu jinoe ka jeut keu musoh dan Prang Dingin dimulai.

source: It was to last for the next 40 years and would be fought for real, by proxy armies, on battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.
reference: Nyan akan meulangsong lam 40 thon u keu ngön akan geupeujuang ngön nyata, le teuntra dari cabeung, bak wilayah prang nibak Afrika trôh u Asia, bak Afghanistan, Kuba, ngön le teumpat laén.
hypothesis: Jih akan berlangsung selama 40 thon ukeu dan akan di meuprang seucara nyata, le tentara proxy, di medan prang dari Afrika sampoe Asia, di Afghanistan, Kuba dan le teumpat laen jih.

source: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defense was already broken, and the only hope was to retreat and reorganise along the Romanian bridgehead.
reference: Lam 17 September 1939, petheuen Polandia ka reuloh, ngön saboh harapan nakeuh surot ngön geususon teuma lam sipanyang titie Rumania.
hypothesis: Bak 17 September 1939, pertahanan Polandia kaleuh dipeuglah, dan saboh-saboh jih harapan adalah untuk mundur dan meuuorganisasikan lom di seulatan kepala jembatan Rumania.

source: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.
reference: Beuranggandum, peugah nyoe jeuet useueng karap lam simalam, watѐe leubeh nibak 800.000 teuntra nibak Teuntra Mirah Uni Soviet jitamong ngön peugöt blah Belarusia ngön Ukraina oh lheueh geujak invasi wilayah timu Polandia nyang sakeue kanun Dame Riga, Pakta Hana-Agresi Soviet-Polandia, ngön kanun internasional laén, jeuet bilateral atawapih multilateral.
hypothesis: Namun, rencana-rencana nyan hana meuguna le bak saboh malam, wate leubeh dari 800.000 tentara dari Angkatan Darat Merah Uni Soviet jitamong dan geupeuget baroh-baroh Belarus dan Ukraina lheuh ji serang wilayah timu Polandia nyang melanggar Perjanjian Perdamaian Riga, Pakta Non-Agresi Soviet-Polandia, dan perjanjian internasional laen jih, bilateral dan multilateral.

source: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.
reference: Ngui kapai keu angkôt dabeuh trôh jinoe nakeuh cara paléng efisien keu peupinah ramѐ ureueng ngön dabeuh rhët laôt.
hypothesis: Geupeuguna kapai untuk geu angkot barang adalah cara nyang paleng efisien untuk geu angkot le ureung ngon barang di laot.

source: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.
reference: Buet angkatan laôt ngön cara tradisional peuteuntѐe bahwa nanggroe gata jeuet peutheun keu peupinah ureueng ngön dabeuh gata, sementara bak watѐe nyang saban, peukaru musôh gata keu jeuet peupinah ureueng ngön dabeuh.
hypothesis: Tugas angkatan laut secara tradisional adalah untuk memastikan bahwa nanggroe gata dipeutahan kemampuan untuk memindahkan rakyat dan barang-barang gata, seudangkan bak watee yang sama, mengganggu kemampuan musuh untuk memindahkan rakyat dan barang-barang jih.

source: One of the most noteworthy recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of WWII. The Americans were trying to move men and materials across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.
reference: Salah saboh tamse nyang paléng barô nyang paléng peunténg nibak nyoe nakeuh kampanye Atlantik Utara nibak WWII. Amerika geucuba keu peupinah ureueng ngön dabeuh rhët Samudra Atlantik keu tulông Inggreh.
hypothesis: Salah saboh contoh nyang paleng terkenal nibak nyoe adalah kampanye Atlantik Utara bak Prang Dunia II. Amerika mencoba untuk memindahkan manusia dan bahan-bahan di seulatan Samudra Atlantik untuk membantu Inggris.

source: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.
reference: Bak watѐe nyang sama, teuntra laôt Jerman, phôn jingui kapai seulam, useuha keu jipeudöng lalu lintah nyoe.
hypothesis: Bak watee yang sama, angkatan laut jerman, yang dipakek terutama U-boat, mencoba untuk peugadeh lalu lintas nyo.

source: Had the Allies failed, Germany probably would have been able to conquer Britain as it had the rest of Europe.
reference: Miseu seukutu-seukutu jih talô, Jeurman mungkén jeuet jitaklok Inggreh lagѐe hai nyan keuh mandum Eropa laén.
hypothesis: Meunyo sekutu gagal, Jerman mungken jeut meuhase meuhase Inggris lagee nyang ka jih peumeunang di Eropa.

source: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.
reference: Kamѐng deuh jih nyang keuphôn jipeuseuit nibak 10.000 thon nyang ka ulikôt bak gunoeng Zagros Iran.
hypothesis: Kaméng deuh jih phon that di peulieh kira-kira 10.000 thon nyang ka u likot di Gunong Zagros Iran.

source: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins.
reference: Budaya ngön suku jameun geupeuphôn kubah keu nak mudah meutume susu, bulѐe, sie ngön kulѐt.
hypothesis: Budaya ngen suku kuno mulai dipeulara untuk mudah akses susu, rambut, daging, ngen kulot.

source: Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.
reference: Kamѐng seuit umumjih jipeulhara lam kawan nyang meuwét-wét i buket atawa jipeurabee bak tempat laén, kayém jipeurabee lé awak peurabee Kamѐng nyan biyasajih aneuk miet atawa aneuk muda, hie lagѐe awak peurabee nyang kayém iturie. Cara peumrabee nyoe mantông jingui sampoe oh jinoe.
hypothesis: Kambing domestik biasa jih dipeulara lam kawanan nyang meuwot-wot di bukét atawa daerah padang naleueng laen, seureng dipeulara le tukang meurabe kambing nyang seureng jih aneuk miet atawa remaja, lage bak tukang meurabe nyang leubeh meusyeuhu.

source: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.
reference: Jalan geuritan jipeudoeng i Inggreh bak awai Abad keu-16.
hypothesis: Wagonway dibangun di Inggreh seugolom abad keu-16.

source: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.
reference: Adakpih jalan geuritan apui jipeugot nibak papeun kaye nyang meusambong, awak nyan jibi idin keu guda tarék awak nyan nak bagah troek nyang leubѐh rayeuk ngön tarék beuban nyang leubѐh rayeuk nibak rauh nyang bacut leubѐh gasa bak uroe nyan.
hypothesis: Meskipun jalur gerbong hanya terdiri dari papan kaye paralel, nyan memungkinkan guda yang menarik jih untuk mencapai kecepatan yeng lubeh rayek ngen menarik beban yeng lubeh rayek daripada di jalan yeng lubeh rugoe nibak uroe nyan.

source: Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top.
reference: Crossties jipeuturie sep awai keu ngön peutheun moto geurubak bak teumpat. Bahpih, bacut-bacut, jithee bahwa moto geurubak leubѐh get meuseu na ujoeng busoe diateueh jih.
hypothesis: Crossties dipeuturi seucara awai untuk dipeutahankan rel-rel nyan di teumpat jih. Namun, seucara bertahap, dipeuturi bahwa rel-rel akan leubeh efisien jika na sticky beuso di ateuh jih.

source: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.
reference: Nyoe jeuet geupeubuet langsông le ureueng ramee, tapih busoe wab leubѐh bagah thoe ruda kayee geurubak.
hypothesis: Nyoe jeut keu praktek umum, teutapi beuso nyan leubeh meupeuget meupeugöt bak roda kayee geuritan.

source: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.
reference: Akhéjih, ruda kayee jigantoe deungön ruda busoe. Bak thon 1767, rel busoe phôn jipeuturi.
hypothesis: Akhé jih, roda kaye geu ganti le roda beuso. Bak thon 1767, rel beuso phon geupeuturi.

source: The first known transportation was walking, humans began walking upright two million years ago with the emergence of Homo Erectus (meaning upright man).
reference: Transportai nyang keuphôn jituri na keuh jak ngön gaki, ureueng geu jak teudong dua juta thon nyang ka ulikot deungön na lahe Homo Erectus (meumakna ureueng teudong).
hypothesis: Transportasi phon nyang geuturi adalah berjalan, manusia mulai geujak tegak dua juta thon yang ka leupah deungen munculnya Homo Erectus (meuteume ureung tegak).

source: Their predecessors, the Australopithecus did not walk upright as habitually.
reference: Ureueng dile awak nyan, Australopithecus hana ijak teudong lage biasajih.
hypothesis: Aneuk nyang awai nibak awak nyan, Australopithecus hana geujak teudong lagee biasa.

source: Bipedal specializations are found in Australopithecus fossils from 4.2-3.9 million years ago, although Sahelanthropus may have walked on two legs as early as seven million years ago.
reference: Bipedal Spesial jiteume bak posil Australopithecus nibak 4,2-3,9 juta thon nyang ka ulikot, adakpih Sahelanthropus mungkén ka ijak deungön dua gaki nibak tujoeh juta thon nyang ka ulikot.
hypothesis: Spesialisasi bipeda di teume bak fosil Australopithecus dari 4,2-3,9 juta thon yang ka leupah, meskipun Sahelanthropus mungken geujak bak dua gaki seugolom tujoh juta thon nyang ka leupah.

source: We can start living more friendly to the environment, we can join to the environmental movement, and we can even be activists in order to reduce the future suffering in some degree.
reference: Tanyoepuphôn udep rumeh deungön teumpat tinggai, tanyoe jeuet meusapat deungön geurakan lingkungan, meusuejeuet sit tanyoebeujeuetkeu aktivis keu peukureung deurita bak masa ukeu bak tingkat meutente.
hypothesis: Geutanyoe jeut mulai udeb leubeh ramah lingkungan, jeut tamupakat ngon gerakan lingkungan, dan bahkan jeut keu aktivis untuk mengurangi penderitaan di masa ukeue seucara tertentu.

source: This is just like symptomatic treatment in many cases. However, if we do not only want a temporary solution, then we should find the root of the problems, and we should deactivate them.
reference: Nyoe lagѐe peukara ubat bak jai peukara, Beuranggandum, meuseu tanyoe hana galak teuh tapeuseuleusoe siat, makajih tanyoe wajeb ta seutot ukheu peukara, ngön tanyoe peureulee ta peumateejih.
hypothesis: Nyan lagee perawatan gejala dalam le kasus. tapi, jika geutanyoe hana hanya ingin solusi sementara, maka geutanyoe haroh meurumpok ngon punca masalah, dan geutanyoe haroh deactivate nyan.

source: It is obvious enough that the world has changed much because of humankind's scientific and technological advancements, and problems have become greater because of overpopulation and mankind's extravagant lifestyle.
reference: Sep deuh ka bahwasajih donya nyoe jai ka meuubah sabab maju ileume peungetahuan ngön tehnologi umat manusiya, ngön peukara leubѐh jai sabab leubѐh jai ka ureueng ngön aleh udep ureueng nyang eumpah ampeeh.
hypothesis: Hana mungken hana teubantah bahwa donya ka meu ubah le sabab kemajuan sains dan teknologi manusia, dan masalah-masalah jih meutamah parah sabab manusia ka leubèh le peunduduek dan udeb jih hana meuyuem.

source: After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap.
reference: watѐe kaleuh geuteurimong le Kongres oh tanggai 4 Juli, saboh kheuet kageuboh teken le Presiden Kongres John Hancock ngön Sekretaris Charles Thomson leuhnyan kirѐm geukirѐm u saboh keude salen nyang hana that jioh nibak sinan ata John Dunlap.
hypothesis: Lheuh diteken le Kongres bak 4 Juli, saboh rancangan nyang teutuleh ngon jaroe nyang ditandatangani le Presiden Kongres John Hancock dan Sekretaris Charles Thomson lheuh nyan ji kirem padum boh blok u toko percetakan John Dunlap.

source: Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as "Dunlap broadsides".
reference: watѐe malam nyan troh 150 sampoe 200 salen ka geupeuna, jino nyan kadituri seubagoe "Dunlap pamplet".
hypothesis: Seulama malam nyan antara 150 ngen 200 salinan dipeuget, jinoe diteupeu seubagoe "Dunlap broadsides".

source: The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8.
reference: Geubaca asoe dokumen dikeu ureueng rame keuphôn that dipeulaku le John Nixon bak lampoh keu Geudong Kemerdekaan bak tanggai 8 Juli.
hypothesis: Pembacaan publik phon dokumen nyan le John Nixon di halaman Independence Hall bak 8 Juli.

source: One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who had it read to his troops in New York on July 9. A copy reached London on August 10.
reference: Saboh ka geukirѐm u George Washington bak tanggai 6 Juli, nyang geubaca di keu pasukan teuntra gobnyan i New York watѐe tanggai 9 Jui. Saboh salen teuk troeh u London bak tanggai 10 Agustus.
hypothesis: Saboh surat nyan ji kirém keu George Washington bak tanggai 6 Juli, nyang geubaca keu pasukan jih di New York bak tanggai 9 Juli. Saboh surat nyan ji peutamong u London bak tanggai 10 Agustus.

source: The 25 Dunlap broadsides still known to exist are the oldest surviving copies of the document. The original handwritten copy has not survived.
reference: Ban 25 boh pamplet Dunlap nyang mantông na nyan keuh dokumen salen nyang paleng tuha nyang seulamat. Kheuet jaroe nyang aseuli salen phôn ka hana seulamat.
hypothesis: 25 boh bagian nyang mantong na di Dunlap na kheueh salinan nyang paleng tuha nyang na mantong na.

source: Many paleontologists today believe that one group of dinosaurs survived and is alive today. We call them birds.
reference: Rame ahli paleontologi uroenyoe nyang yakin saboh keulompok dinasaurus na nyang seulamat ngön udep sampoe uroenyoe. Geutanyoe tabi nan nyan cicem.
hypothesis: Le ahli paleontologi jinoe peucaya bahwa saboh kelompok dinosaurus nyang mantong udep dan jinoe.

source: Many people don't think about them as dinosaurs because they have feathers and can fly.
reference: Le ureueng nyang hana dipikee keu awaknyan seubagoe dinosaurus sabab awaknyan na bule ngön jeuet dipoe.
hypothesis: Le ureung hana geupike bak awaknyan seubagoe dinosaurus karena awak nyan na bulu dan jeut terbang.

source: But there are a lot of things about birds that still look like a dinosaur.
reference: Tapi le that hai teuntang cicem nyang mantông hie dengön dinosaurus.
hypothesis: Teuma na le hal bak cicem nyang mantong deuh jih lagee dinosaurus.

source: They have feet with scales and claws, they lay eggs, and they walk on their two back legs like a T-Rex.
reference: Cicem na gaki ngön sisek ngön gukee, jitoh boh, ngön jijak ngön duwa boh gateh lagѐe T-Rex.
hypothesis: Awaknyan na gaki deungon sisik ngon cakar, awaknyan jitöh boh, dan awaknyan jijak bak gaki likot jih lagee T-Rex.

source: Virtually all computers in use today are based on the manipulation of information which is coded in the form of binary numbers.
reference: Lam hakekatjih mandum komputer nyang dingui uroenyoe nakeuh asai nibak cara geu atoe informasi nyang di boh lam sandi lam rupa lumboi biner.
hypothesis: Seubagoe komputer nyang dipakek saat nyo didasarkan bak manipulasi informasi yeng dikode dalam bentuk bilangan biner.

source: A binary number can have only one of two values, i.e. 0 or 1, and these numbers are referred to as binary digits - or bits, to use computer jargon.
reference: Saboh lumboi biner nyan na duwa nibak saboh nilai, tamsejih 0 atawa 1, ngön lumboi nyoe dum dikheun sebagoe numboi biner – atawa bits, keujeuet takheun istilah komputer.
hypothesis: Saboh bilangan biner hanya jeut na salah saboh dari dua nilai, yaitu 0 atau 1, ngen angka-angka nyo dikhen digit biner - atau bit, untuk dipakek jargon komputer.

source: Internal poisoning may not be immediately apparent. Symptoms, such as vomiting are sufficiently general that an immediate diagnosis cannot be made.
reference: Tuba nyang keunong lam tuboh nyan han deuh sigra. Hai-hai nyang meuteuka, lage muntah nakeuh umumjih saboh hai keupariksa nyang bagah hanjeut tapeuna.
hypothesis: Zat peungasaman internal mungken hana langsong deuh. Gejala, lage muntah, cukup umum sampoe hana jeut geu diagnosis langsong.

source: The best indication of internal poisoning may be the presence of an open container of medication or toxic household chemicals.
reference: Hai nyang paleng meuteuka nibak tuba lam tuboh nakeuh na jiteume plok ubat nyang teuhah atawa racoen kimia lam rumoh.
hypothesis: Indikasi nyang paleng get keuhai keracunan internal mungken na bak wadah ubat nyang teuhah atawa bahan kimia rumoh tangga nyang toksik.

source: Check the label for specific first aid instructions for that specific poison.
reference: Neukaloen label keu cara tulong keu tuba khusoih nyan.
hypothesis: Periksa label untuk instruksi bantuan pertama khusus untuk racun tertentu nyan.

source: The term bug is used by entomologists in a formal sense for this group of insects.
reference: Istilah bug ingui lé ahli entomologi lam lingka formal keu kawan seureungga nyoë.
hypothesis: Istilah bug dipakek le ahli entomologi dalam arti formal untuk kelompok serangga nyo.

source: This term derives from ancient familiarity with Bed-bugs, which are insects highly adapted to parasitize humans.
reference: Istilah nyoë meuasai dari keakraban jameun deungön pijét, nyang meuhareutoë seureungga nyang that beradaptasi jeut keu parasit nibak manusia.
hypothesis: Istilah nyo meuasai dari ke familiaritas jameun deungen Bed-bug, yang merupakan serangga yang sangat teradaptasi untuk menginfeksi manusia.

source: Both Assassin-bugs and Bed-bugs are nidicolous, adapted to living in nest or housing of their host.
reference: Göt gutèë pembunuh atawa pit sama-sama nidicolous, meuadaptasi keu tinggai di sarang atawa peugöt rumoh di inangjih.
hypothesis: Mandua Assassin-bug ngon Bed-bug nyan nidicolous, diadaptasi untuk tinggai di sarang atau perumahan inang jih.

source: Across the United States of America, there are approximately 400,000 known cases of Multiple Sclerosis (MS), leaving it as the leading neurological disease in younger and middle aged adults.
reference: Bak Amerika Serikat, nakeuh leubѐh kureueng nibak 400.000 keujadian Multiple Sclerosis (MS), nyang peutinggai nyan keu saboh peunyaket saraf nibak aneuk muda ngön ureueng nyang karap tuha.
hypothesis: Di mandum Amerika Serikat, na kira-kira 400.000 kasus nyang teuntang Multiple Sclerosis (MS), sampoe jeut keu peunyaket neurologis utama bak ureung muda dan ureung rayeuk nyang umu teungeh.

source: MS is a disease that affects the central nervous system, which is made up of the brain, the spinal cord and the optic nerve.
reference: MS nyan keuh saboh peunyaket nyang keunong bak system saraf nyang diteungoh, nyang peuna keu utak, saraf bak tuleung rhueng ngön saraf mata.
hypothesis: MS adalah peunyaket nyang meupeungaroh sistem saraf pusat, nyang teupeuget dari uteuk, sumsum punggung dan saraf optik.

source: Research has found that females are two times more likely to have MS then males.
reference: Peuneulitian ka geuteume bahwasajih ureueng inong leubѐh mudah keunong MS duwa goe lipat nibak ureueng agam.
hypothesis: Penelitian ka meuteume bahwa ureung inong leubeh dua goe leubeh meupeunyakét MS nibak ureung agam.

source: A couple may decide it is not in their best interest, or in the interest of their child, to raise a baby.
reference: Saboh peudampeng geupeuputoh nyoe koen paleng meuheut, atawa lam meuheut aneuk awak nyan, keu peurayeuk aneuk.
hypothesis: Sidroe pasangan mungken teuputuskan bahwa hana keu keupeuntengan awaknyan keudroe, atawa keu keupeuntengan aneuëk awaknyan, meunyoe awaknyan jipeulahé sidroe aneuëk.

source: These couples may choose to make an adoption plan for their baby.
reference: Peudampeng nyoejeuet geupileh keu peugot saboh reuncana adopsi aneuk awak nyan.
hypothesis: Pasangan-pasangan nyan mungken geupiléh keu jipeulaku rencana adopsi keu aneuëk awaknyan.

source: In an adoption, the birth parents terminate their parental rights so that another couple may parent the child.
reference: Lam adopsi, ureueng chiek droe abeh hak seubagoe ureueng chiek sampoe peudampeng laen jeuet geuasuh aneuk nyan.
hypothesis: Lam adopsi, ureung tuha meujampu peugadeh hak ureung tuha jih mangat pasangan laen jeut keu ureung tuha aneuk nyan.

source: Science’s main goal is to figure out the way the world works through the scientific method. This method in fact guides most scientific research.
reference: Makeusud ilmee utama nakeuh neuk jiteupue cara donya keurija rhot cara alami. Deuh takaloen cara nyoe geupeumeuho bak peuneulitian ladom.
hypothesis: Tujuan utama sains adalah untuk meuteume cara donya bekerja melalui metode ilmiah. metode nyoe seujarah jih geu pimpin sebagian rayek penelitian ilmiah.

source: It isn’t alone though, experimentation, and an experiment is a test that is used to eliminate one or more of the possible hypotheses, asking questions, and making observations also guide scientific research.
reference: Kon nyan sagai, eksperimen, ngön saboh eksperimen nakeuh saboh ujoe cuba dingui keu peugadoh saboh atawa leubѐh nyang mungkén, geuteumanyong ngön geupeugot peungamatan cit geupeumeuho peunelitian alami.
hypothesis: Nyan kon sidroe, eksperimen, dan eksperimen adalah tes yeng dipakek untuk geu eliminasi saboh atau leubeh hipotesis yeng mungken, geu tanyong pertanyaan, ngen geu peuget pengamatan cit geu bimbing penelitian ilmiah.

source: Naturalists and philosophers focused on classical texts and, in particular, on the Bible in Latin.
reference: Naturalis ngön filusuf fokusjih bak tulesan jameun ngön, nyang meuteunte, bak Bible lamLaten.
hypothesis: Ahli alam ngon filsuf fokus bak teks klasik ngen, khusus jih, bak Alkitab lam bahasa Latin.

source: Accepted were Aristotle's views on all matters of science, including psychology.
reference: Diteurimong nakeuh peu nyang jipike Aristoteles bak mandum hai ilmee, jitamoeng cit pisikologi.
hypothesis: Pandangan Aristoteles tentang mandum masalah sains, termasuk psikologi, ditarima.

source: As knowledge of Greek declined, the West found itself cut off from its Greek philosophical and scientific roots.
reference: Watѐe eleumee bah ureueng Yunani jitulak, Barat meureumpok droejih putoh nibak ukheu filosofi ngön ilmiah Yunani.
hypothesis: Seubagoe pengetahuan Yunani menurun, Barat teutap terputus dari akar filsafat ngen ilmiah Yunani jih.

source: Many observed rhythms in physiology and behavior often crucially depend on the presence of endogenous cycles and their production through biological clocks.
reference: Le ritme nyang geukalon lam fisiologi ngön sifeut kayém meusangkot bak na siklus endogen ngön geupeugoet lom rot jeum biologis.
hypothesis: Le ritme nyang ji amati lam fisiologi ngon perilaku seureng that meugantung secara kritis bak na siklus endogen dan produksi jih melalui jam biologi.

source: Periodic rhythms, which are not simply responses to external periodic cues, have been documented for most living beings, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.
reference: Ritme periodik, nyang koen pah geusuot keu isyarat periodik iluwa, ka ireukam keu ladom makhlouk hudep, geutamoeng cit kumeun, kulat, bak kayee, ngön meulatang.
hypothesis: Rhythm periodik, yeng kon hanya tanggapan bak isyarat periodik eksternal, kaleuh didokumentasikan untuk seubagian rayek makhluk udep, termasok bakteri, jamur, tumbuhan, ngen binatang.

source: Biological clocks are self sustaining oscillators which will continue a period of free-running cycling even in the absence of external cues.
reference: Jeum biologis nakeuh osilator geualami droe nyang neuk geulanjut saboh masa nibak lheuh-plueng bahpih hana syarat diluwa.
hypothesis: Jam biologi adalah osilator nyang bertahan keudroe yang akan melanjutkan periode siklus bebas bahkan tanpa adanya isyarat eksternal.

source: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material.
reference: Ujoecuba Hershey ngön Chase nakeuh salah saboh peundapat meuceuhu DNA nyan nakeuh saboh materi genetik.
hypothesis: Eksperimen Hershey ngen Chase adalah salah saboh saran utama bahwa DNA adalah bahan genetik.

source: Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium.
reference: Hershey ngön Chase geungui fag, atawa virus, keu geutanoem DNA awak nyan lam kumeun.
hypothesis: Hershey ngen Chase dipakek fag, atau virus, untuk meupeutamong DNA awak nyan keudroe u dalam bakteri.

source: They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.
reference: Awak nyan geupubuet duwa ujoecuba geutanda DNA lam fag deungön fosfor radioaktif atawa protein nibak fag deungön sulfur radioaktif.
hypothesis: Awak nyan dipeuget dua eksperimen dipeutah tanda DNA lam phage deungen fosfor radioaktif atau protein phage deungen belerang radioaktif.

source: Mutations can have a variety of different effects depending on the type of mutation, the significance of the piece of genetic material affected and whether the cells affected are germ-line cells.
reference: Mutasijeuet na saboh jinѐh musabab meubeda meunuroet bak jinѐh mutasi, bagoe nyang peurteng nibak materi genetik jipeungaroh ngön pue sel nyang keunong nakeuh sel kumeun-gareh.
hypothesis: Mutasi jeut na meubagoe macam efek yang beda tergantung bak jenis mutasi, signifikansi bagian materi genetik yang terinfeksi dan peu keuh sel-sel yang terinfeksi adalah sel-sel germline.

source: Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children, while mutations elsewhere can cause cell-death or cancer.
reference: Sit mutasi bak sel kumeun-gareh jeuet geupeulewat keu aneuk, sangkira mutasi i teumpat laenjeuet keu sel-mate atawa kanker.
hypothesis: Hanya mutasi bak sel germinal yang jeut ji peutransmisikan bak aneuk miet, seudangkan mutasi di teumpat laen jeut menyebabkan kematian sel atau kanker.

source: Nature-based tourism attracts people interested in visiting natural areas for the purpose of enjoying the scenery, including plant and animal wildlife.
reference: Teumpat jak tamasya nyang meuheut ureueng keu geusaweu teumpat jak tamasya dengön niet peurasat peumandangan, teumasok bak seulaman ngön meulatang kleut.
hypothesis: Pariwisata berbasis alam menarik ureung yang tertarik untuk mengunjungi daerah alam untuk tujuan menikmati pemandangan, termasuk tumbuhan dan binatang liar.

source: Examples of on-site activities include hunting, fishing, photography, bird watching, and visiting parks and studying information about the ecosystem.
reference: Tamsejih buet siuroe –uroe bak droe teuh teumasok jak lam uteun, jak keumawe, jak cok gamba, jak tilek cicem, ngön jak saweu seulaman ngön jak seutot beurita bah ekosistem.
hypothesis: Contoh kegiatan di lokasi termasuk memungut, memungut ikan, memotret, memantau burung, dan mengunjungi taman dan mempelajari informasi tentang ekosistem.

source: An example is visiting, photographing, and learning about organgatuangs in Borneo.
reference: Saboh tamse nakeuh jak saweu, jak cok gamba, ngön jak meurunoe bah maw’ah i Kalimantan.
hypothesis: Contoh jih adalah tajak, meuu poto, dan meurunoe tentang organgatuang di Borneo.

source: Every morning, people leave small country towns in cars to go their workplace and are passed by others whose work destination is the place they have just left.
reference: Tiep beungoeh, ureueng-ureueng geukeubah gampong ngön moto geujak bak teumpat keureuja geuh ngön geulewat ureueng laen nyan niet geuh nyankeuh teumpat nyang baro siat nyoe geu keubah.
hypothesis: Tieb-tieb beungoh, ureung-ureung nyang tinggai kota-kota ubit di gampong nyan ngon mobil keu jak bak teumpat kerja awak nyan dan ji meulangkah le awak laen nyang tujuan kerja jih adalah teumpat awak nyan baroe tinggai.

source: In this dynamic transport shuttle everyone is somehow connected with, and supporting, a transport system based on private cars.
reference: Lam transportasi jak tueng jak intat nyang dinamis nyoe, tiep droe ureueng aleh kiban geupeugoet sinambong, ngön sapeu kheun, deungön sistim transportasi asaijih moto droe.
hypothesis: Lam angkutan shuttle dinamis nyo mandum ureung na hubongan, dan mendukung, sistem angkutan yang didasarkan bak mobil pribadi.

source: Science now indicates that this massive carbon economy has dislodged the biosphere from one of its stable states that has supported human evolution for the past two million years.
reference: Ilmee jinoe jipeutunyoek bahwasajih ekonomi karbon kop jai ka geucabot bak salah saboh keadaan nyang get nyang sapeu kheun ngön dukong ureueng-ureueng nibak duwa juta thon akhée.
hypothesis: Ilme jinoe dipeutunyok bahwa ekonomi karbon yang meukuasa nyo ka ji peuglah biosfer dari salah saboh keadaan stabil jih yang dipeu dukung evolusi manusia selama dua juta thon yang kalheuh.

source: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about transportation systems.
reference: Tiep-tiep ureueng sapeu kheun lam ureueng jai ngön geupakek sistim transportasi. Karab mandum ureueng geupeugah hai keu sistim transportasi.
hypothesis: Bandum ureung berpartisipasi dalam masyarakat dan meupakek sistem transportasi.

source: In developed countries you seldom hear similar levels of complaints about water quality or bridges falling down.
reference: Bak nanggroe nyang ka maju droe neuh jareung that neu deungoe keuluhan nyang lage nyan lage ie nyang get atawa reuloeh tutue.
hypothesis: Di nanggroe-nanggroe maju, gata jarang deungo keluhan nyang saban tentang kualitas ie atawa jembatan nyang reubah.

source: Why do transportation systems engender such complaints, why do they fail on a daily basis? Are transportation engineers just incompetent? Or is something more fundamental going on?
reference: Pakoen sistim transportasi itubiet kiban hai nyang lage nyan bagoe, pakoen awak nyan taloe tiep uroe? Peu insinyur trasnportasi nyan hana caroeng? Atawa asaijih na sipue-pue?
hypothesis: Pakon sistem transportasi meujampu keluhan lage nyan, pakon awak nyan gagal setiap uroe? Peu keuh insinyur transportasi hana kompeten? Atawa na sesuatu yang leubeh mendasar terjadi?

source: Traffic Flow is the study of the movement of individual drivers and vehicles between two points and the interactions they make with one another.
reference: Arah Lalu lintas nyankeuh saboh ilmee keu ureueng jak bak jalan ngön kandran nibak duwa titek ngön meupakat mandum.
hypothesis: Aliran lalu lintas adalah studi tentang gerakan supir dan kendaraan individu antara dua titek ngen interaksi yang di peuget antara saboh ngen laen.

source: Unfortunately, studying traffic flow is difficult because driver behavior cannot be predicted with one-hundred percent certainty.
reference: Sayang that, meurunoe arah lalu lintas nyan payah sabab buet ureueng mee moto hana tatuoh teubak seureutoh peursen.
hypothesis: sayang jih, meurunoe aliran lalu lintas sulet kareuna perilaku sopir hana jeut diprediksi deungen kepastian seratus persen.

source: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonably consistent range; thus, traffic streams tend to have some reasonable consistency and can be roughly represented mathematically.
reference: Meuuntong, ureueng mee moto kayem geupubeut teutap lam kategori nyang saban; makajih, arah lalu lintas kayem na keuteutapan nyang rap saban ngön seucara gasa jeuet tapeuleumah seucara matematek.
hypothesis: Seugala jih, sopir cenderung meupeuget lam jangkauan yang konsisten; sehingga, aliran lalu lintas cenderung na konsistensi yeng wajar dan jeut diwakili secara matematis.

source: To better represent traffic flow, relationships have been established between the three main characteristics: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) velocity.
reference: Keu tapeuleumah arah lalu lintas nyang leubѐh beutoi, kaleuh jipeugoet sinambong nibak lhee boh jinѐh nyang phôn-phôn that: (1) arah, (2) muatan, (3) keucepatan.
hypothesis: Untuk leubeh get meucen aliran lalu lintas, hubungan kaleuh dipeudeng antara lhee karakteristik utama: (1) aliran, (2) kepadatan, ngen (3) kecepatan.

source: These relationships help in planning, design, and operations of roadway facilities.
reference: Sinambong nyoe meubantu lam peureuncanaan, desain, ngön operasi fasilitas bak jalan rayek.
hypothesis: Hubungan nyo membantu dalam perencanaan, desain, ngen operasi fasilitas jalan raya.

source: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.
reference: Seureungga nyankeuh meulatang phôn that meunafah. Ngön jeuet ipoe mangat meubantu droe ih jihindar deungön musoh ngön meurumpok makanan ngön rakan nyang get.
hypothesis: Serangga adalah binatang phon nyang meulayang. Kemampuan terbang jih membantu awak nyan untuk leubeh mudah menghindari musoh dan leubeh efisien untuk mencari makanan dan pasangan.

source: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.
reference: Jai seureungga meuguna sabab sayeupjih jeuet jilipat u likot ban saboh tuboh.
hypothesis: Sebagian rayek serangga na keuntungan jeut meulinteh sayeueb jih di likot tuboh.

source: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.
reference: Nyoe ibi keu awak nyan sep jai teumpat ubeuet keu i musom nibak peumangsa.
hypothesis: Nyoe geubri keu awak nyan jeumeulah teumpat nyang leubeh luwah untuk teusöm nibak makhluk peurusak.

source: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.
reference: Uroe nyoe, saboh-sabohjih seureungga nyang hanjeuet i lipat sayeupjih nyankeuh langöng ngönden-den.
hypothesis: Jinoe, saboh-saboh jih serangga nyang hana jeut meulinteueng sayeueb jih adalah lalat naga dan lalat may.

source: Thousands of years ago, a man called Aristarchus said that the Solar System moved around the Sun.
reference: Meuribe thon nyang ka ulikot, sidroe ureueng agam nanjih Aristarchus geupeugah bahwasajih Tata Surya meugrak-grak iputa Mata Uroe.
hypothesis: Ribe thon nyang ka leupah, sidroe ureueng nyang nan jih Aristarchus geupeugah bahwa Tata Surya meugrak-grak seureuta Mata uroe.

source: Some people thought he was right but many people believed the opposite; that the Solar System moved around the Earth, including the Sun (and even the other stars).
reference: Padum droe ureueng geupike droegeuh beutoi tapih jai ureueng geupateh seubalekjih; Tata Surya nyan meugrak-grak iputa Bumoe, teumasok Mata Uroe (ngön bahpih bintang-bintang nyang laen).
hypothesis: Na ureung yang pike jih nyan beutoi tapi le ureung yang peucaya sebaliknya; bahwa Tata Surya bergerak mengelilingi Bumo, termasuk Mata uroe (dan bahkan bintang laen jih).

source: This seems sensible, because the Earth doesn't feel as if it's moving, does it?
reference: Nyoe sang itamoeng lam akai, sabab Bumoe hana ta thei meugrak-grak, koen?
hypothesis: Nyan deuh logik, kareuna bumoe hana deuh lagee jih meugrak, nyoe?

source: The Amazon River is the second longest and the biggest river on Earth. It carries more than 8 times as much water as the second biggest river.
reference: Krueng amazon nakeuh krueng paleng panyang ngön paleng rayek i donya. Jih jipeuilee ie leubeh dari 8 goe le dari krueng keudua nyang paleng rayek.
hypothesis: Krueng Amazon nakeuh krueng paleng panyang keudua ngon nyang paleng rayek di bumoe. Ie nyan na leubeh dari 8 kali leubeh le ie nibak krueng nyang paleng rayek keudua.

source: The Amazon is also the widest river on Earth, at times six miles wide.
reference: Krueng Amazon pih krueng paleng luwah i donya, na luwah meu nam mil.
hypothesis: Amazon cit krueng paleng luwah di bumoe, kadang-kadang luwah jih 6 mil.

source: A full 20 percent of the water that pours out of the planet's rivers into the oceans comes from the Amazon.
reference: 20 peureusen punoh ie nyang dilee lam krueng asaijih bak krueng Amazon.
hypothesis: 20 persen ie nyang ji ile dari krueng-krueng planet nyoe u laot teuka dari Amazon.

source: The main Amazon River is 6,387 km (3,980 miles). It collects water from thousands of smaller rivers.
reference: Krueng Amazon nyang utama nyankeuh 6.387 km (3.980 mil). Nyan dipeusapat ie dari meuribee krueng-krueng nyan leubѐh ubeut.
hypothesis: Krueng Amazon utama nyan panyang jih 6.387 km. Ié nyan ji kumpulkan dari meuribée krueng ubit.

source: Although pyramid-building in stone continued until the end of the Old Kingdom, the pyramids of Giza were never surpassed in their size and the technical excellence of their construction.
reference: Adakpih piramida nyang dipeudong ngön batee nyan mantông na sampoe akhé Keurajeuen Tuha, piramida-piramida bak Giza nyan han tom dikoh bak ukoran ngön hai teknisjih nyang jroh watѐe nyan dipeudong.
hypothesis: Meskipun bangunan piramida di batee terus sampoe akhe Kekaisaran Tua, piramida Giza hana pernah di atasi dalam ukuran dan keunggulan teknis konstruksi jih.

source: New Kingdom ancient Egyptians marvelled at their predecessors monuments, which were then well over a thousand year old.
reference: Keurajeuen Baro ureueng Meuse jameun dilee nyan teukeuch’ak bak monumen endatu awak nyan, nyang teutap got sampoe siribee thon leubѐh.
hypothesis: Ureueng Mesir kuno Keurajeuën Baro galak that bak monumen pendahulu awak nyan, yang bak wate nyan lebeh dari siribée thon.

source: Vatican City's population is around 800. It is the smallest independent country in the world and the country with the lowest population.
reference: Jumlah ureueng nyang tinggai bak Kuta Vatikan nyankeuh kureueng leubѐh 800. Nyankeuh nanggroe meurdehka nyang paleng ubeut i donya ngön nanggroe nyang paleng dit ureueng tinggai.
hypothesis: penduduk kota Vatikan sekitar 800. nyan adalah negara independen ter ubit di donya dan negara deungen populasi terendah.

source: Vatican City uses Italian in its legislation and official communications.
reference: Kuta Vatikan dingui Basa Itali lam kanun ngön lam buet peugah haba resmi awak nyan.
hypothesis: Kota Vatikan dipakek bahasa Italia lam undang-undang dan komunikasi resmi jih.

source: Italian is also the everyday language used by most of those who work in the state while Latin is often used in religious ceremonies.
reference: Basa Itali pih jeuet keu basa siuroe-uroe nyang dingui le dum ureueng nyang keureuja bak nanggroe nyan seudangkan Basa Laten kayém dingui bak acara-acara agama.
hypothesis: Italia cit bahasa sehari-hari yeng dipakek le sebagian rayek ureung yeng bekerja di negara sementara Latin seureng dipakek dalam upacara keagamaan.

source: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholic.
reference: Mandum ureueng nyang tinggai bak Kuta Vatikan nyan Katolik Roma.
hypothesis: Bandum warga Vatikan nakeuh Katolik Roma.

source: People have known about basic chemical elements such as gold, silver, and copper from antiquity, as these can all be discovered in nature in native form and are relatively simple to mine with primitive tools.
reference: Ureueng ka ditupeue teuntang punca zat-zat kimia lagѐe meuh, pirak, ngön teumaga dari jameun dilee, nyang nyoe jeuet diteumee bak alam lam beuntuk asaijih ngön biasajih mangat geukueh deungon peukakah-peukakah primitif.
hypothesis: Manusia kalheh meuphom tentang unsur kimia dasar lage méuh, perak, ngen tembaga dari jameun kuno, kareuna mandum nyoe jeut ditume lam alam lam bentuk asli ngen relatif mudah ditume deungen alat primitif.

source: Aristotle, a philosopher, theorised that everything is made up of a mixture of one or more of four elements. They were earth, water, air, and fire.
reference: Aristotle, sidroe ahli filsafat, geupeugot teori bahwasajih dumpeue nyan dipeugot dari saboh rampoe dari saboh atawa leubѐh dari peuet boh zat. Nyan nyankeuh tanoh, ie, udara, ngön apui.
hypothesis: Aristoteles, sidroe filsuf, geu teori bahwa mandum hai teupeuget nibak saboh atawa leubeh unsur nyang peuet: tanoh, ie, udara, dan apui.

source: This was more like the four states of matter (in the same order): solid, liquid, gas, and plasma, though he also theorised that they change into new substances to form what we see.
reference: Nyoe leubѐh lagѐe peuet boh sipheuet dari beunda (lam susonan nyang saban): kreueh, caye, gah, ngön plasma, adak gobnyan pih geupeugot teori bahwasajih nyan meugantoe jeuet keu asoe-asoe baro meubeuntuk sipeue-peue nyang takalon.
hypothesis: Nyo leubeh lagee peut keadaan materi (dalam urutan yang sama): padat, cair, gas, ngen plasma, meskipun jih cit mengteori bahwa awak nyan meubah jeut zat baro untuk meu bentuk yang tanyoe kalon.

source: Alloys are basically a mixture of two or more metals. Don't forget that there are many elements on the periodic table.
reference: Beuso nyang meujampu nyankeuh puncajih saboh rampoe dari duwa boh atawa leubѐh beuso. Bek tuwo bahwasajih jai that zat-zat bak meh periodik.
hypothesis: Paduan nyan seucara dasarnya adalah campuran dua atau leubeh logam. Bék lupa bahwa na le elemen bak tabel periodik.

source: Elements like calcium and potassium are considered metals. Of course, there are also metals like silver and gold.
reference: Zat-zat lagѐe kalsium ngön kalium nyan dikheun beuso. Nyan ka mupeue, na sit beuso lagѐe pirak ngon meuh.
hypothesis: Elemen lage kalsium ngen kalium dianggap logam. Teuman, na cit logam lage perak ngon méuh.

source: You can also have alloys that include small amounts of non-metallic elements like carbon.
reference: Gata jeuet sit neuteumee beuso nyang meujampu nyang roh zat-zat nyang koen beuso lam jumlah ubeut lagѐe karbon.
hypothesis: Meunan cit jeut na paduan yang na jumlah ubit unsur non-logam lagee karbon.

source: Everything in the Universe is made of matter. All matter is made of tiny particles called atoms.
reference: Mandum nyang na bak Alam Semesta nyan dipeugot dari zat. Mandum zat nyan dipeugot dari partikel ubeut nanjih atom.
hypothesis: Bandum nyang na di alam semesta nyan teupeuget dari materi. Bandum materi teupeuget dari partikel ubit nyang geukheun atom.

source: Atoms are so incredibly tiny that trillions of them could fit into the period at the end of this sentence.
reference: Atom nyan that brat ubeut nyang meutriliun awak nyan jeuet lot u dalam titek bak akhé kalimat nyoe.
hypothesis: Atom nyan that ubit sampoe trilyun-trilyun jih jeut keu lam titik di akhe kalimat nyoe.

source: Thus, the pencil was a good friend to many people when it came out.
reference: Dengön lagѐe nyoe, gense nyankeuh rakan nyang get keu ureueng rame watѐe jipeutubiet.
hypothesis: Jadi, pensil nyan merupakan sahabat nyang get keu le ureung watee dilumpoe.

source: Sadly, as newer methods of writing have emerged, the pencil has been relegated to lesser status and uses.
reference: Nyang seudehjih, sabab cara tuleh nyang baro ka jitubiet, gense jipeutron keu status sosial ngön manfaat nyang leubѐh jroh.
hypothesis: Seudangkan, seudeh jih, seucara baro-baro metode teunuléh ka deuh, pensil ka teu relegasi keu status dan penggunaan nyang leubeh rendah.

source: People now write messages on computer screens, never having to come close to a sharpener.
reference: Ureueng jinoe geutuleh peusan bak layeu komputer, hana suwah peutoe droe ngön cui gense.
hypothesis: Ureueng jinoe meutuleh pesan bak layar komputer, hana peureulee meusadeu deungen alat tajam.

source: One can only wonder what the keyboard will become when something newer comes along.
reference: Ureueng jeuet keu mumang jeuetkeu pue keyboard nyan meusapue hana jitubit.
hypothesis: Sidroe jeut hanya ta tanyong peu yang jeut keyboard watee na yang leubeh baro.

source: The fission bomb works on the principle that it takes energy to put together a nucleus with many protons and neutrons.
reference: Bom fisi jikeureuja meuasai bak prinsip bahwa jipeureulee keukuatan keu peusapat inti deungön proton ngön neutron.
hypothesis: Bom fisi bekerja bak prinsip bahwa jih perlee energi untuk meuseurta saboh inti deungen le proton ngen neutron.

source: Sort of like rolling a heavy cart up a hill. Splitting the nucleus up again then releases some of that energy.
reference: Lagѐe tagulong geuritan nyang geuhoen u ateuh buket. Geuplah nukleus lom teuma geupeuleuh ladom keukuatan nyan.
hypothesis: Lagee geutarek geuritan brat u ateuh buket, geuplah inti lom dan lheuh nyan geupeuleueh bacut energi nyan.

source: Some atoms have unstable nuclei which means that they tend to break apart with little or no nudging.
reference: Padum-padum boh atom na inti nyang hana timang nyang meumakna bahwa beukah bacut atawa hana suwah tatulak.
hypothesis: Padim boh atom na inti nyang hana stabil yang meuarti jih awak nyan cenderung dipeubeukah deungen bacut atau hana nudging.

source: The surface of the Moon is made of rocks and dust. The outer layer of the Moon is called the crust.
reference: Ateuh buleuen jipeugoet dari bate ngön abee. Lapeh iluwa buleuen jikheun krak.
hypothesis: Bumoe buleun teupeuget dari batee ngon abée. Lapeh lua buleun geukheun kerak.

source: The crust is about 70 km thick on the near side and 100 km thick on the far side.
reference: Krak jih teubai sangkira 70 km i bagian nyang toe ngön teubai 100 km i bagian nyang jiohjih.
hypothesis: Kulet nyan lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lubeh lu

source: It is thinner under the maria and thicker under the highlands.
reference: Leubѐh lipeh imiyup maria ngown leubѐh teubai imiyup dataran manyang.
hypothesis: Nyan leubeh tipis di miyueb maria dan leubeh tebel di miyueb daerah dataran tinggi.

source: There may be more maria on the near side because the crust is thinner. It was easier for lava to rise up to the surface.
reference: Mungkén na leubѐh jai maria bak arah toe sabab krakjih leubѐh lipeh. Laha leubѐh mudah jiek u ateuh tanoh.
hypothesis: Mungken na le maria di sagoe yang rab karena kerak jih leubeh tipis. leubeh mudah untuk lava untuk meuangkat u permukaan.

source: Content theories are centered on finding what makes people tick or appeals to them.
reference: Tiori kontent pusat jih bak jitume pue nyang peugoet ureueng meugrak atawa meutarékjih.
hypothesis: Teori konten dipeusat bak meuteume peue nyang peuget ureung nyan tertarik atau menarik bak awak nyan.

source: These theories suggest that people have certain needs and/or desires which have been internalized as they mature to adulthood.
reference: Tiori-tiori nyoe jipeutunyoek bahwa ureueng na peureulee ngön/atawa heut meuteunte nyang ka meuleukap bak droe watѐe awaknyan rayek sampoe tuha.
hypothesis: Teori nyo meupeutunyok bahwa manusia na kebutuhan dan/atau hajat tertentu yeng kaleuh ji internalisasi seulama awak nyan dewasa keu dewasa.

source: These theories look at what it is about certain people that make them want the things that they do and what things in their environment will make them do or not do certain things.
reference: Tiori-tiori nyoe jikaloen bak pue teuntang ureueng-ureueng meuteunte nyang peugoet awaknyan galak jipubuet hai-hai nyang awaknyan pubuet ngön hai-hai pue nyang mantông nyang i silingka awaknyan nyang neukpeugot awanyan pubuet atawa hana pubuet hai-hai meuteunte.
hypothesis: Teori nyo ji pandang peu yang na bak ureung tertentu yang jeut keu alasan awak nyan meucen hal yang awak nyan peuget dan peu yang na di lingkungan awak nyan yang jeut keu alasan awak nyan peuget atau hana peuget hal tertentu.

source: Two popular content theories are Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs Theory and Hertzberg's Two Factor Theory.
reference: Duwa boh tiori konten nyang ka meuceuhu nyankeuh tiori Hirarki neuhet Maslow ngön tiori duwa faktor Hertzberg.
hypothesis: Dua teori konten yeng populer adalah Teori Hierarki Kebutuhan Maslow ngen Teori Dua Faktor Hertzberg.

source: Generally speaking, two behaviors can emerge as managers begin to lead their former peers. One end of the spectrum is trying to remain “one of the guys” (or gals).
reference: Seucara umum, duwa boh peukateun jitubiet watѐe menejer geumulai pimpin ureueng keureuja nyang ilikot awaknyan. Salah saboh ujoeng spektrum jiujoe keu teutap jeuet keu salah sidroe ureueng agam” (atawa ureueng inoeng).
hypothesis: Secara umum, dua perilaku jeut muncul seulama manajer mulai memimpin mantan rekan-rekan mereka. saboh ujung spektrum nyoe mencoba untuk tetap menjadi salah satu dari guys (atau gals).

source: This type of manager has difficulty making unpopular decisions, performing disciplinary action, performance evaluations, assigning responsibility, and holding people accountable.
reference: Menejer tipe nyoe jirasa sosah peugot peunutoh nyang hana meuceuhu, geupubuet buet disiplin, evaluasi keureuja, jok tanggung jaweub ngön lakee tanggong jaweub ureueng.
hypothesis: Jenis manajer nyo na kesulitan untuk meucok keputusan yang hana populer, melakukan tindakan disiplin, evaluasi kinerja, menugaskan tanggung jawab, dan menahan orang untuk bertanggung jawab.

source: At the other end of the spectrum, one morphs into an unrecognizable individual that feels he or she must change everything the team has been doing and make it their own.
reference: Bak ujoeng laen spektrum, sidroe-droe ureueng meu ubah-ubahjeuet keu ureueng nyang hana jituri meurasa suwah jiubah mandum nyang ka jipeugot keulompok ngön jeuet peugot ata droeih.
hypothesis: Di ujong laen spektrum, sidroe meubah jeut keu individu yang hana jeut ta teupu yang merasa bahwa droe jih harus meu ubah mandum yang dilakukan tim dan jeut keu milik droe jih.

source: After all, the leader is ultimately responsible for the success and failure of the team.
reference: Adak meurangkaban, peupimpin bak seuneulheuh tanggong jaweub ateuh meuhase ngön hana meuhase keu keulompok.
hypothesis: Seubalek jih, pemimpin nyang bertanggung jawab keu keberhasilan dan kegagalan tim.

source: This behavior oftentimes results in rifts between the leaders and the rest of the team.
reference: Peukateun nyoe kayém meu akibat karu antara peumimpin ngön anggota keulompok tim laenjih.
hypothesis: Keulakuan nyo seureng meuakibat keu rift antara pemimpin ngon awak awak tim nyang laen.

source: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences.
reference: Keulompok Virtual na keuh standar utama nyang sama deungön keulompok konvensional, tapih na peubeda bacut.
hypothesis: Tim virtual dipeuget keu standar keunggulan yang sama lagee tim konvensional, teutapi na perbedaan halus.

source: Virtual team members often function as the point of contact for their immediate physical group.
reference: Anggota keulompok virtual kayém meufungsi sebagoe titek kontak keu keulompok fisik langsông awak nyan.
hypothesis: Anggota tim virtual seureng berfungsi seubagai titik kontak untuk kelompok fisik langsong awak nyan.

source: They often have more autonomy than conventional team members as their teams may meet according to varying time zones which may not be understood by their local management.
reference: Awak nyan kayém na leubѐh jai otonomi nibak anggota keulompok konvensional sabab keulompok awak nyan na meurumpok seusuai deungön zona watѐe nyang meubeda nyang mungkén han jimuphom le manajemen lokal awak nyan.
hypothesis: Awak nyan seureng na otonomi leubeh le dari anggota tim konvensional kareuna tim awak nyan jeut meusapat meunurot zona wate nyang meubeda nyang mungken hana meuphom le manajemen lokal awak nyan.

source: The presence of a true “invisible team” (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) is also a unique component of a virtual team.
reference: Wujud nyang nyata dari "keulompok hana deuh" nyang seubetoijih (Larson ngön LaFasto, 1989, p109) nyan keuh komponen unik nibak keulompok virtual sit.
hypothesis: Kehadiran tim nyata teu deuh (Larson ngen LaFasto, 1989, p109) cit merupakan komponen unik dari tim virtual.

source: The “invisible team” is the management team to which each of the members report. The invisible team sets the standards for each member.
reference: "Keulompok hana deuh" nyan keuh keulompok manajemen nyang maseng-maseng anggota peulapor. Keulompok hana deuh peuteutap standar keu tip anggota.
hypothesis: tim hana deuh adalah tim manajemen yang dipeutentee le masing-masing anggota. tim hana deuh dipeuteuteutab standar untuk tiep anggota.

source: Why would an organization want to go through the time consuming process of establishing a learning organization? One goal for putting organizational learning concepts into practice is innovation.

hypothesis: Pakon organisasi ingin melalui proses yang memakan waktu untuk membangun organisasi yang belajar? salah saboh tujuan untuk meutumeng konsep pembelajaran organisasi lam praktek adalah inovasi.

source: When all available resources are effectively used across the functional departments of an organization, creativity and ingenuity can transpire.
reference: watѐe hai-hai nyang peureulee beuna nyangengui ngön get meulingke ban saboh bahagian nyang udep dari saboh organisasi, daya cipta ngön hai nyang aseuli nyanjeuet keu buet.
hypothesis: Wate mandum sumber daya nyang na ji gunakan secara efektif di mandum jabatan fungsional organisasi, kreativitas dan kecerdasan jeut ji tampilkan.

source: As a result, the process of an organization working together to overcome an obstacle can lead to a new innovative process to serve the customer's need.

hypothesis: Akibat jih, proses organisasi yang bekerja sama untuk meukalahkan hambatan jeut meupeutarah bak proses inovatif baro untuk meupeutimang kebutuhan pelanggan.

source: Neurobiological data provide physical evidence for a theoretical approach to the investigation of cognition. Therefore it narrows the research area and makes it much more exact.

hypothesis: Hubungan antara patologi otak ngen perilaku geubantu ilmuwan lam penelitian awak nyan

reference: Nyoe ka diteupue nibak jameun koen bahawa meubeudaluka nyang keunong lam utak, trauma, luka, ngön tumor nyan na peungaroh keu peukateun ureueng ngön jeuet keu seubab bak fungsi mental.

source: This provides us with a lot of information and material to build simulation models which help us to understand processes in our mind.
reference: Nyoe keuh nyang geubrie keu geutanyoe jai that euleueme ngön meubago benda keujeuet tabangun saboh model keu peuleumah nyang akan geutulong geutanyoe bak ta meuphom akan pue nyang keujadian nyang na lam utak geutanyo.

source: Although AI has a strong connotation of science fiction, AI forms a very important branch of computer science, dealing with behavior, learning and intelligent adaptation in a machine.
reference: Adakpi AI nyan nah ai nyang kong lam euleume sains hayal, AI nyan jipeudong saboh cabeung lam euleume sains komputer, nyang meuhubong noen peukateun, meureuno ngön caroengjih saboh meusen lam adaptasi.

reference: Geumeusetot lam AI nyan na roh keu peuget meusen nyan beu jipubuet buet keu otomatis nyang peureulee keu peukaten nyang hayeu.
hypothesis: Penelitian lam AI melibatkan peuget meusen untuk meutomatisasi tugas yeng meumungken perilaku cerdas.

source: Examples include control, planning and scheduling, the ability to answer customer diagnoses and questions, as well as handwriting recognition, voice and face.
reference: Tamsejih na roh keu kontrol, reuncana ngön boh jadwal, jeuet keu i jaweub diagnosa ngön pertanyaan ureueng nyang geungui, lagѐe cit meuphom kheuet ngön jaro, su atawa wajah.
hypothesis: Contoh jih termasuk kontrol, perencanaan ngen jadwal, kemampuan untuk menjawab diagnosis ngen pertanyaan pelanggan, seurta pengenalan tulisan tangan, suara ngen wajah.

source: Such things have become separate disciplines, which focus on providing solutions to real life problems.
reference: Hai-hai lagѐe nyan kajeuet keu cabeung euleume nyang meubeda, lage takalon beu timang bak ta brie jawaban keu masalah nyang na lam udep.
hypothesis: Hal-hal lage nyan ka jeut disiplin yang terpisah, yang fokus bak meujok solusi untuk masalah udep nyata.

source: The AI ​​system is now often used in the fields of economics, medicine, engineering and the military, as has been built in several home computer and video game software applications.

hypothesis: Sistem AI jino seureng dipakek di bidang ekonomi, kedokteran, teknik ngen militer, lage yeng kaleuh dibangun di padum-padum boh aplikasi perangkat lunak komputer rumoh ngen video game.

source: Field trips are a large part of any classroom. Quite often a teacher would love to take her students places to which a bus trip is not an option.

hypothesis: Perjalanan lapangan adalah bagian rayeuk dari setiap kelas. Seucara seureng sidroe guru galak geuba murid jih u teumpat-teumpat nyang hana jeut ji jak ngon bus.

source: Technology offers the solution with virtual field trips. Students can look at museum artifacts, visit an aquarium, or admire beautiful art while sitting with their class.
reference: Tehnologi geupeutaba solusi deungon saweu lapangan virtual. Peulajarjeuet meukalon artefak meuseum artefak, saweu akuarium, atawa takjub keu seni nyang ceudah sira duek deungon tingkat awak nyan.
hypothesis: Teknologi na solusi deungen kunjungan lapangan virtual. Murit jeut melihat artefak museum, mengunjungi akuarium, atau mengagumi seni yang indah seulama duduk deungen kelas jih.

source: Sharing a field trip virtually is also a great way to reflect a on a trip and share experiences with future classes.
