hypothesis: Meubagi kunjungan lapangan secara virtual cit merupakan cara yang get untuk meupeutimbang saboh perjalanan dan meubagi pengalaman deungen kelas ukeu.

source: For example, each year students from Bennet School in North Carolina design a website about their trip to the State Capital, each year the website gets remodeled, but old versions are kept online to serve as a scrapbook.
reference: Miseujih, tip thon peulajar nibak Sikula Bennet bak Carolina Utara geupeugot saboh situs web teuntang saweu awak nyan u ibu kuta nanggroe, tip thon situs web jipeubaro teuma, tapih bagoe awai dikeubah seucara online keu jipeugot saboh kliping.
hypothesis: Miseu jih, tiep thon aneuk sikula dari Bennet School di North Carolina geu desain saboh website tentang perjalanan awak nyan u ibukota negara bagian, tiep thon website nyan ji renovasi, tapi versi jameun dipeutinggai bak internet untuk jeut keu album.

source: Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that.
reference: Blogjeuet cit geubantu meutamah get peulajar geuteumuleh. Seudangkan peulajar kayém peuphôn peungalaman blog awak nyan deungön tata basa ngön ejaan nyang beurangkaho, geujak ureueng kaloen umumjih meuubah nyan.
hypothesis: Blog jeut cit ji bantu mangat siswa jeut menulis leubeh get. seudangkan mahasiswa seureng mulai pengalaman blog jih deungen tata bahasa dan ejaan yang rapoh, kehadiran penonton biasa jih ji ubah nyan.

source: Since students are often the most critical audience, the blog writer begins to strive to improve writing to avoid criticism.
reference: watѐe peulajar kayém jeuet keu ureung kaloen paleng kritis, peunuleh blog mulai geumeurenoe keu meutamah get teumuleh bah hana jikritek.
hypothesis: Karena mahasiswa seureng jeut keu penonton nyang paleng kritis, penulis blog mulai berusaha untuk meningkatkan tulisan untuk menghindari kritik.

source: Also blogging "forces students to become more savvy about the world around them." The need to feed the interest of the audience inspires students to be clever and interesting (Toto, 2004).

hypothesis: Meunan cit ngeblog "meung paksa siswa untuk jeut leubeh cerdas tentang donya di seukitar jih". Kebutuhan untuk memicu minat penonton menginspirasi siswa untuk menjadi cerdas dan menarik (Toto, 2004).

source: Blogging is a tool that inspires collaboration, and encourages students to extend learning well beyond the traditional school day.

hypothesis: Blogging nakeuh saboh alat nyang geu inspirasi kolaborasi, dan geu dorong mahasiswa untuk geupanyang peungeurtian leubeh dari uroe sikula tradisional.

source: Appropriate use of blogs "can empower students to become more analytical and critical; through actively responding to Internet materials, students can define their positions in the context of others' writings as well as outline their own perspectives on particular issues (Oravec, 2002).

hypothesis: "Penggunaan blog nyang paih jeut dipeubiaya siswa untuk jeut leubeh analitis ngen kritis; melalui bereaksi aktif bak bahan Internet, siswa jeut meudefinisikan posisi awak nyan dalam konteks tulisan ureung laen seurta meupeutrang perspektif awak nyan keudroe tentang isu-isu tertentu" (Oravec, 2002).

hypothesis: Beuthat dalam meulanggeh ureung agam, dan hana teumakot keu teudong bak posisi gata (beda budaya atawa hana, nyan hana jeut keu ok!).

source: The modern city of Casablanca was founded by Berber fishermen in the 10th century BCE, and was used by the Phoenicians, Romans, and the Merenids as a strategic port called Anfa.
reference: Kuta nyang ka maju Casablanca geupeudoeng le ureueng meulaot Barber bak abad keu-10 SM, ngön geucok le Fanisia, Romawi, ngön Merenid seubagoe peulabuhan nyang pah teumpat nyang geukheun Anfa.
hypothesis: Banda Casablanca modern di peudong le neulayan Berber bak abad keu-10 SM, dan dipakek le Phoenician, Romawi, ngen Merenids seubagai pelabuhan strategis nyang dikhen Anfa.

source: The Portuguese destroyed it and rebuilt it under the name Casa Branca, only to abandon it after an earthquake in 1755.
reference: Portugis jipeuancoe ngön jipeudoeng lom nyan nanjih Casa Branca, sit keu jikubah lheueh geumpa bumoe thon 1755.
hypothesis: Portugis dipeubinasa ngen dipeudong lom deungen nan Casa Branca, hanya untuk dipeuleupah lheuh gempa bumoe bak thon 1755.

source: The Moroccan sultan rebuilt the city as Daru l-Badya and it was given the name Casablanca by Spanish traders who established trading bases there.
reference: Raja Maroko geupeudoeng lom kuta nyan sebagoe Daru I-Badya ngön geuboh nan Casablanca le ureueng Spanyol nyang meukat nyang geupeudoeng asai bloe publoe hinan.
hypothesis: Sultan Maroko geupeudong lom banda nyan seubagoe Daru l-Badya dan dijok nan Casablanca le ureung meukat Spanyol nyang geupeudong pangkalan dagang di sinan.

source: Casablanca is one of the least interesting places to shop in all of Morocco.
reference: Casablanca nyankeuh salah saboh teumpat nyang paleng lagak bak tajak meubloe ubena i Maroko.
hypothesis: Casablanca nakeuh salah saboh teumpat nyang paleng hana menarik untuk meukat di mandum Maroko.

source: Around the old Medina it's easy to find places selling traditional Moroccan goods, such as tagines, pottery, leather goods, hookahs, and a whole spectrum of geegaws, but it's all for the tourists.
reference: Silingka Madinah tuha, mangat tatumee teumpat-teumpat jipubloe dabeuh-dabeuh tradisiaonal Maroko, lagѐe tajin, tembikar, sibeurangkapue muasai kulet, hookah, ngön meubagoe jinѐh geegaw, tapih mandum keu jamѐe troek.
hypothesis: Di sekitar Medina tuha mudah untuk meurumpok teumpat yang meukat barang-barang tradisional Maroko, lage tagine, keramik, barang kulit, naraka, dan mandum macam geegaws, tapi mandum nyan untuk wisatawan.

source: Goma is a tourist city of the Democratic Republic of Congo in the extreme east near Rwanda.
reference: Goma nyan kuta urosan teumaca bak Nanggroe Republik Kongo bagian paleng timu toe ngon nanggroe Rwanda.
hypothesis: Goma nakeuh saboh banda wisata di Republik Demokratik Kongo di timu paleng rab Rwanda.

source: In 2002 Goma was destroyed by lava from the Nyiragongo volcano which buried most of the town’s streets, particularly the town centre.
reference: Bak thon 2002 Goma ka anco le larva gunong apui Nyiragongo watee ulak meuhamboe u taloe jalan leubeh lom bak pusat kuta.
hypothesis: Bak thon 2002 Goma dipeubinasa le lava dari gunung berapi Nyiragongo yang dipeubumi sebagian rayek jalan-jalan kota, terutama pusat kota.

source: While Goma is reasonably safe, any visits outside of Goma should be researched to understand the state of the fighting that persists in the North Kivu province.
reference: Adak pih Goma nyan sep aman, tiep-tiep ureueng kunjong di luwa Goma wajeb di seulidei keu meuphom nyang bahwa prang mantong na nibak provinsi Kivu blah Utara.
hypothesis: Meskipun Goma aman, mandum kunjungan di lua Goma harus diteumeung untuk meuphom keadaan pertempuran yang terus-menerus di provinsi Kivu Utara.

source: The city is also the base to climb the Nyiragongo volcano along with some of the cheapest Mountain Gorilla tracking in Africa.
reference: Kuta nyan nakeuh pih uram keu ek gunong apui Nyiragongo nyan ngon teumaca keu kalon Gorila Gunong dengon yum murah bak Afrika.
hypothesis: Banda nyoe cit keu pangkalan untuk geu peumeungkat bak gunung berapi Nyiragongo meusigoe deungen na padum-padum boh peunjeulajah Gorila Gunong nyang paleng murah di Afrika.

source: You can use boda-boda (motorcycle taxi) to get around Goma. The normal (local) price is ~500 Congolese Francs for the short ride.
reference: Droeneuh jeut neungui boda-boda (honda siwa) keu wet-wet lingka Goma. Biasa ongkohjih (lokal) 500 Francs Kongo miseue neuk jak nyang toe-toe.
hypothesis: Droeneuh jeut neu gunakan boda-boda (taksi motor) untuk neu jak-jak di sekitar Goma. Harga biasa (lokal) adalah ~ 500 frank Kongo untuk perjalanan pendek.

source: Combined with its relative inaccessibility, "Timbuktu" has come to be used as a metaphor for exotic, distant lands.
reference: Ijampue ngön bit hanjeuet jipeutubiet, "Timbuktu" ka jipeuguna seubagoe metafora keu nanggroe-nanggroe nyang jioh nyang ceudah lagoina.
hypothesis: Seucara relatif hana jeut ji akses, "Timbuktu" ka jeut dipakek seubagai metafora untuk nanggroe-nanggroe eksotik, yang jiôh.

source: Today, Timbuktu is an impoverished town, although its reputation makes it a tourist attraction, and it has an airport.
reference: Uroe nyoe, Timbuktu nakeuh kuta nyang gasien, adakpih martabatjih jeuet keu kuta seubagoe teumpat jak tamasya, ngön na saboh bandara.
hypothesis: Jinoe, Timbuktu nakeuh saboh banda nyang gasien, bah pih reputasi jih jeut keu daya tarik wisatawan, dan na bandara.

source: In 1990, it was added to the list of world heritage sites in danger, due to the threat of desert sands.
reference: Bak thon 1990, ka geutamah bak dafta situs waresan donya lam bahya, sabab ancaman cot meu anoe.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1990, jih ditamah lam daftar situs warisan donya nyang dalam bahaya, kareuna ancaman pasir padang pasi.

source: It was one of the major stops during Henry Louis Gates' PBS special Wonders of the African World.
reference: Nyankeuh salah saboh nyang phôn jitheun nibak Keuajaiban Meuteunte Donya Afrika Hery Luois Gate’PBS.
hypothesis: Nyan adalah salah saboh teumpat peuneugadeh utama seulama spesial PBS Henry Louis Gates Wonders of the African World.

source: The city is in stark contrast to the rest of the country's cities, because it has more of an Arabic flair than of an African.
reference: Kuta nyoe sep brat deuh deungön kuta-kuta nyang laenjih bak abad nyoe, sabab ureueng Arab leubѐh jai bakat nibak ureueng Afrika.
hypothesis: Banda nyoe meubeda ngon kota-kota di nanggroe nyan, kareuna leubeh na rasa Arab daripada Afrika.

source: The Kruger National Park (KNP) lies in the north-east of South Africa and runs along the border of Mozambique in the east, Zimbabwe in the north, and the southern border is the Crocodile River.
reference: Kruger National Park (KNP) i baroh-timue Afrika Tunoeng ngön meuhalak ubena ceu Mozambik blah timue, Zimbabwe na roet baroh, ngön bak ceu blah tunoeng nakeuh Krueng Buya.
hypothesis: Taman Nasional Kruger (KNP) teuduek di timu-laut Afrika Selatan dan meulalui bataih Mozambik di timu, Zimbabwe di utara, dan bataih selatan adalah Sungai Buaya.

source: The park covers 19,500 km² and is divided in 14 different ecozones, each supporting different wildlife.
reference: Keu seuneulheueh taman 19.500 km² ngön ibahgi keu 14 wilayah mangat takaloen nyang meuulaen, tiep-tiep droe sapue kheun keu meubagoe meulatang kleut nyan.
hypothesis: Taman nyan luwah jih 19.500 km2 dan dibagi jeut keu 14 ekozona yang berbeda, masing-masing mendukung binatang liar yang berbeda.

source: It is one of the main attractions of South Africa and it is considered the flagship of South African National Parks (SANParks).
reference: Nyan nakeuh saboh antara piyasan-piyasan nibak Afrika Tunoeng ngön nyan dikheun hai nyang teuleubѐh nibak Taman Nasional Afrika Tunoeng (SANParks).
hypothesis: Nyan salah saboh atraksi utama Afrika Selatan dan dianggap sebagai taman nasional Afrika Selatan (SANParks).

source: As with all South African National Parks, there are daily conservation and entry fees for the park.
reference: Deungon mandum Taman Nasional Afrika Tunoeng, nyan na buet keumiet siuroe-uroe ngön euungkoh tamoeng bak taman nyan.
hypothesis: Lagee mandum taman nasional Afrika Selatan, na biaya konservasi dan biaya masuk keu taman.

source: It may also be beneficial for one to buy a Wild Card, which provides entry to either selections of parks in South Africa or all of the South African National Parks.
reference: Nyan pih jeuet keu paidah keu sidroe ureueng nyang bloe saboh Keureutu Kleuet, nyan seudiya rauh tamong u pue keuh taman bak Afrika Tunoeng nyang ka geupileh atawa mandum Taman Nasional Afrika Tunoeng.
hypothesis: Nyo cit jeut keu manfaat bagi sidroe untuk meumungkenkan Wild Card, yeng meumungkenkan akses keu boh seleksi taman di Afrika Selatan atau mandum Taman Nasional Afrika Selatan.

source: Hong Kong Island gives the territory of Hong Kong its name and is the place that many tourists regard as the main focus.
reference: Pulo Hong Kong dibri dairah Hong Kong nyan nanjih ngön nyankeuh teumpat nyang jai turis peujeuet keu pusat nyang phôn.
hypothesis: Pulo Hong Kong geubri nan wilayah Hong Kong dan merupakan teumpat nyang dianggap le wisatawan seubagoe fokus utama.

source: The parade of buildings that make the Hong Kong skyline has been likened to a glittering bar chart that is made apparent by the presence of the waters of Victoria Harbour.
reference: Geudoeng-geudoeng nyang meubareh nyan peugot gareh langet Hong Kong nyan dipeusaban deungön gamba balok meucahya nyang dipeugot deuh deungon ie nyang troeh nibak Peulabohan Victoria.
hypothesis: Parade bangunan nyang meupeuget garis langit Hong Kong telah diumpamakan deungen grafik bar yeng meukilat yeng dipeuget nyata le kehadiran ie Victoria Harbour.

source: To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite.
reference: Keu meutumee peumandangan nyang paleng got bak Hong Kong, neuminah nibak Pulo ngön neujak u Kowloon blahdeh pasi.
hypothesis: Untuk mendapatkan pemandangan terbaik dari Hong Kong, tinggai pulau dan menuju ke tepi pantai Kowloon di seberang.

source: The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore.
reference: Nyang paleng jai nibak cara dipeugot dairah kuta Pulo Hong Kong nyang hayeu nyan nyankeuh dipeusapat deungon punoh bak tanoh nyang jireklamasi seupanyang pasi blah baroh.
hypothesis: Mayoritas rayek pembangunan perkotaan Pulau Hong Kong teutap meusak-sak bak tanoh nyang ji reup seureuta panté utara.

source: This is the place the British colonisers took as their own and so if you are looking for evidence of the territory's colonial past, this is a good place to start.
reference: Nyoe teumpat nyang peunjajah asai Inggreh cok seubagoe atra droe ngön meunyoe gata mita keu peuninggai jameun masa peunjajah, nyoekeuh saboh teumpat nyang got keu neupeuphôn.
hypothesis: Nyoe adalah teumpat peudududukan Inggris jeut keu milik awak nyan dan jika awak nyan teungoh mita bukti masa lalu kolonial wilayah nyan, nyoe adalah teumpat nyang get keu mulai.

source: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast.
reference: Sundarbans nakeuh dairah pasi bak bangka nyang paleng rayek i donya, meubeunteueng 80 km (50 mi) u dairah dalam Bangladesh ngön India dari pasi.
hypothesis: Sundarbans nakeuh pantôn mangrove nyang paléng rayek di donya, nyang meulinteh 80 km (50 mi) u wilayah Bangladesh ngon India.

source: The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park.
reference: Sundarbans ka dipeunyata keu Teumpat Wareh Donya UNESCO. Dairah uteun lam wilayah India nyan dikheun Taman Nasional Sundarbans.
hypothesis: Sundarbans ka geu peumaklum seubagoe situs warisan donya UNESCO. Bagian gle di dalam wilayah India nyan geuboh nan Taman Nasional Sundarbans.

source: The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain.
reference: Uteunjih nyan pih koen alue bakau sagai — nyan ditamong ladom dari rimba-rimba kha nyang tinggai nyang dilee dikhop tanoh luwah Gangetic.
hypothesis: Hutan nyan kon mantong paya mangrove meskipun  jih termasuk padum-padum boh bak nyang keuneulheueh tinggai dari hutan meukuasa yang pernah meucoblang dataran Gangetic.

source: The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas.
reference: Sundarbans dikhop saboh wilayah 3.850 km², sangkira sa per lhee nyan dikhop ngön ie/wilayah paya.
hypothesis: Sundarbans na luwah 3,850 km2, dari nyan sekitar lhee per lhee na di wilayah ie/padang.

source: Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
reference: Nibak thon 1966 Sundarbans jeuet keu saboh suaka keu meulatang juwah, ngön nyan keunira jinoe na 400 rimueng Royal Bengal ngön sangkira 30.000 rusa nyang deuh bak wilayah nyan.
hypothesis: Phon thon 1966, Sundarbans ka jeuet keu teumpat meulindong binatang bueh, dan diperkirakan bahwa jinoe na 400 harimau Bengal Raja dan kira-kira 30.000 rusa berbintik-bintik di daerah nyan.

source: Buses depart the inter-district bus station (across the river) throughout the day, though most, especially those heading to the east and Jakar/Bumthang leave between 06:30 and 07:30.
reference: Moto Bus dibungka tasiyon moto bes lingkeue dairah (meukoh krueng) seupanyang uroe, adak kayémjih, khususjih nyang meujak u timu ngön Jakar/Bumthang jipeuhah antara poh 06:30 ngön poh 07:30.
hypothesis: Bus meujak dari stasiun bus antar kabupaten (di seulatan krueng) sipanyang uroe, meskipun le, terutama yang meujak u timu dan Jakar/Bumthang meujak antara poh 06:30 dan 07:30.

source: As the inter-district buses are often full, it is advisable to purchase a ticket a few days in advance.
reference: Seubap moto bes lingkeue dairah nyan kayém peunoh, nyan dibrithee keu neubloe karcih bak padum uroe sigohlomjih.
hypothesis: Kareuna bus antar kabupaten seureng peunoh, leubeh get ta bloe tiket padum uroe sigolom.

source: Most districts are served by small Japanese Coaster Buses, which are comfortable and sturdy.
reference: Dum dairah-dairah nyan diseudiya Moto Bus Peluncur Jeupang, nyang sanyum ngön kong.
hypothesis: Sebagian rayek kabupaten di peuget oleh Bus Rel Jepang ubit, yeng nyaman ngen kuat.

source: Shared taxis are a quick and comfortable means to travel to nearby places, such as Paro (Nu 150) and Punakha (Nu 200).
reference: Moto taksi sajan nyankeuh saboh hai nyang bagah ngön sanyum keu jak u teumpat-teumpat lam seulingka, lagѐe Paro (Nu 150) ngön Punakha (Nu 200).
hypothesis: Taksi bersama adalah cara yeng bagah ngen nyaman untuk meujak ke teumpat-teumpat yeng rab, lage Paro (Nu 150) ngen Punakha (Nu 200).

source: The Oyapock River Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge. It spans the Oyapock River to link the cities of Oiapoque in Brazil and Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock in French Guiana.
reference: Tutue Krueng Oyapock nyankeuh tutue yang dipeudong ngoen taloe. Nyan di lingkeue krueng Oyapock meuhubong ngon kuta-kuta di Oipoque di Brazil ngon Saint-Georges de l’Oyapock di French Guiana.
hypothesis: Jembatan Krueng Oyapock nakeuh saboh jembatan nyang na bak Krueng Oyapock nyang meuhubông banda Oiapoque di Brasil ngon Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock di Guiana Prancis.

source: The two towers rise to a height of 83 meters, it's 378 meters long and it has two lanes of 3.50 m wide.
reference: Dua boh meunara manyang u ateuhjih 83 mete, panyang u sampengjih 378 mete ngon na dua boh rot nyang luwahjih 3.50 mete.
hypothesis: Dua meunara nyan manyang jih 83 meter, panyang jih 378 meter dan na dua jalur lebar jih 3,50 meter.

source: The vertical clearance under the bridge is 15 meters. Construction was completed in August 2011, it didn't open to traffic until March 2017.
reference: Ceue keu manyang di yup tutue nyan 15 mete. Buet peugot tutue nyan lheueh bak Agustus 2011, nyan han dibuka keu ureueng jak sampoe Maret 2017.
hypothesis: Jaroe nyang na di miyueb jrat nyan nakeuh 15 meter.

source: The bridge is scheduled to be fully operational in September 2017, when the Brazilian customs checkpoints are expected to be finished.
reference: Tutue nyan reuncanajih dibuka peunoh keu operational bak September 2017, watë teumpat-teumpat keu peutren dabeuh ureueng Brazil nyan ka lheueh dipeugot.
hypothesis: Jembatan nyan dijadwalkan akan beroperasi sepenuhnya bak September 2017, wate nyan pos pemeriksaan bea cukai Brasil diharap akan selesai.

source: The Guaraní were the most significant indigenous group inhabiting what is now Eastern Paraguay, living as semi-nomadic hunters who also practised subsistence agriculture.
reference: Guarani nyankeuh keulompok asai nyang paleng peunteng nyang jiduek bak teumpat nanjih jinoe Timu Paraguay, meuudep ban meupinah-pinah sira jak let meunatang meurunoe nyang geupubuet meugo keuudep cit.
hypothesis: Ureuëng Guaraní adalah kelompok pribumi nyang paleng peunteng yang tinggai di bagian timu Paraguay saat nyoe, udep seubagoe pemburu semi-nomad nyang cit geu praktikkan pertanian subsisten.

source: The Chaco region was home to other groups of indigenous tribes such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who survived by hunting, gathering and fishing.
reference: Dairah Chaco nyankeuh rumoh keu keulompok suku asai lagee Guaycuru ngoen Payagua, nyang udep deungon meuburu, meukumpoi ngoen keumawe.
hypothesis: Wilayah Chaco adalah rumoh keu kelompok-kelompok suku pribumi laen jih lagee Guaycurú ngen Payaguá, yang bertahan dari perburuan, pengumpulan dan memancing.

source: In the 16th century Paraguay, formerly called "The Giant Province of the Indies", was born as a result of the encounter of Spanish conquerors with the native indigenous groups.
reference: Lam abad keu-16 Paraguay, sigohlomjih dikheuen "Provinsi Raya Nyang Jiduek le Ureueng India", nyan lahe dari hase peukara peunjajah Spanyol deungon keulompok asai nyang disinan.
hypothesis: Bak abad keu-16, Paraguay, nyang sigolom jih dikhen "Provinsi Raksasa di India", lahé akibat meurumpok jih peumeurèntah Spanyol ngen kelompok pribumi asli.

source: The Spaniards started the colonization period which lasted for three centuries.
reference: Bansa Spanyol geupuphon watë meujajah nyang trepjih sampoe lhee abad.
hypothesis: Ureueng Spanyol mulai periode kolonialisasi yeng berlangsung selama lhee abad.

source: Since the foundation of Asunción in 1537, Paraguay has managed to keep a lot of its indigenous character and identity.
reference: Watë dipeudong Asunción bak thon 1537, Paraguay jeuet dipeutheun dum peurangeui ureueng asai ngoen identitahjih.
hypothesis: Seujak dasai Asunción bak thon 1537, Paraguay kaleuh dipeuteun le karakter dan identitas pribumi jih.

source: Argentina is well known for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.
reference: Argentina nyan got dituri seubap na salah saboh tim polo ngoen peumeu’en nyang paleng got i dônya.
hypothesis: Argentina terkenal karena na salah saboh tim polo ngon pemain terbaik di donya.

source: The largest tournament of the year takes place in December at the polo fields in Las Cañitas.
reference: Turnamen sithon sigo nyang paleng rayeuk dipeugot lam buleuen Desember bak lapangan polo i Las Cañitas.
hypothesis: Turnamen paleng rayek thon nyan terjadi bak buleuen Desember di lapangan polo di Las Cañitas.

source: Smaller tournaments and matches can also be seen here at other times of the year.
reference: Turnamen ngoen acara tadong nyang leubeh ubeut jeuet sit neukalon hinoe bak laen watë lam saboh thon.
hypothesis: Turnamen dan pertandingan yeng lubeh ubit jeut ditonton di sinoe bak wate laen thon.

source: For news on tournaments and where to buy tickets for polo matches, check Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
reference: Keu haba teuntang turnamen ngoen pat dipubloe tiket keu acara tadong polo, neukalon bak Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
hypothesis: Untuk berita tentang turnamen dan teumpat bloe tiket untuk pertandingan polo, lihat Asociación Argentina de Polo.

source: The official Falklands currency is the Falkland pound (FKP) whose value is set equivalent to that of one British pound (GBP).
reference: Mata peng resmi Falklands nyankeuh Falkland pound (FKP) nyang yumjih dipeugot saban lagee sa Inggris pound (GBP).
hypothesis: Mata uang resmi Falklands adalah pound Falkland (FKP) yang nilai jih dipeuteutapkan sama deungen pound Britania (GBP).

source: Money can be exchanged at the only bank in the islands which is located in Stanley across from the FIC West store.
reference: Peng jeuet dituka bak saboh beng sagai lam pulo nyan nyang teumpatjih di Stanley blahdeh toko FIC West.
hypothesis: Uang jeut ji tuker bak saboh-saboh jih bank di pulo-pulo nyang na di Stanley di seberang toko FIC Barat.

source: British pounds will generally be accepted anywhere in the islands and within Stanley credit cards and United States dollars are also often accepted.
reference: Inggris pounds umumjih diteurimong dumpat lam pulo ngoen dalam keureutu kredit Stanley ngoen Amerika Serikat dollar pih kayem diteurimong.
hypothesis: Pound Inggris umum jih ditarima di mandum pulau dan dalam kartu kredit Stanley dan dolar Amerika Serikat cit seureng ditarima.

source: On the outlying islands credit cards will probably not be accepted, although British and United States currency may be taken; check with the owners in advance to determine what is an acceptable payment method.
reference: Bak pulo-pulo nyang jeuoh mungken keureutu kredit han diteurimong, adakpih Inggris ngoen mata peng Ameurika Seurikat nyang dicok; neupareksa deungon po geuh dilee keu peuteuntee peue cara bayeue nyang diteurimong.
hypothesis: Di pulo-pulo nyang jiôh hana mungken akan ditarima kartu kredit, meskipun mata uang Inggris ngon Amerika Serikat mungken diterimeng; periksa deungen pemilik awai untuk meuteume metode pembayaran nyang geuteurimong.

source: It is nearly impossible to exchange Falklands currency outside of the islands, so exchange money prior to leaving the islands.
reference: Nyan karap han mungken keu neutuka mata peng Falklands di luwa pulo, jadi neutuka peng nyan sigohlom neujak dari pulo.
hypothesis: Nyan hampir hana mungken untuk meubah mata uang Falklands di lua pulo, jadi meubah uang seugolom meu tinggai pulau.

source: Since Montevideo is south of the Equator, it is summer there when it's winter in the Northern Hemisphere and vice versa.
reference: Seubap Montevideo nyan blah tunong dari Equator, hinan musem seuuem watë musem leupie bak Wilayah Utara Bumoe ngoen seubalekjih.
hypothesis: Kareuna Montevideo di selatan khatulistiwa, nyan musim panas di sinan watee nyan musim dingin di belahan bumi utara dan seubalek jih.

source: Montevideo is in the subtropics; in the summer months, temperatures above +30°C are common.
reference: Montevideo nyan lam subtropik; lam buleuen-buleuen musem seuuem, temperature hinan biasajih di ateueh +30°C.
hypothesis: Montevideo na di subtropis; bak buleun musim panas, suhu di ateuh +30°C biasa.

source: The winter can be deceptively chilly: temperatures rarely go below freezing, but the wind and humidity combine to make it feel colder than what the thermometer says.
reference: Musem leupie biasajih leubeh leupie dari nyang ta rasa: temperatures han kayem di yup leupie that, tapi angen ngoen angen juem meugabong nyang peugot nyan leubeh leupie nibak peue nyang dipeuleumah bak termometer.
hypothesis: Musim dingin jeut keu dingin yang mengkhianat: suhu jarang meujulang di bawah titik beku, tapi angen dan kelembaban bergabung untuk membuat terasa lebeh dingin dari yang dikatakan termometer.

source: There are no particular "rainy" and "dry" seasons: the amount of rain stays roughly the same throughout the year.
reference: Hana musem "ujen" ngoen "tho" nyang ka teuntee: jumlah ujeuen kira-kira teutap saban seupanyang thon.
hypothesis: Hana musem "hujan" ngen "gleh" khusus: jumlah ujeuen teutap kira-kira sama seulama thon.

source: Though many of the animals in the park are used to seeing humans, the wildlife is nonetheless wild and should not be fed or disturbed.

hypothesis: Apia didegakan bak thon 1850-an dan ka jeut keu ibu kota resmi Samoa sejak thon 1959.

source: Tamaki Drive beaches are on the Waitemata Harbour, in the upmarket suburbs of Mission Bay and St Heliers in Central Auckland.
reference: Pante Tamaki Drive na di Pelabuhan Waitemata, di bineh kuta glah ateueh Mission Bay ngon St Heliers di Auckland Teungoh.
hypothesis: Pantai Tamaki Drive na di Pelabuhan Waitemata, di pinggiran kota mewah Mission Bay dan St Heliers di pusat Auckland.

source: These are sometimes-crowded family beaches with a good range of shops lining the shore. Swimming is safe.
reference: Nyoe nakeuh pante keluarga nyang teukadang rame nacit meubagoe toko nyang meubanja di bineh pante. Meulango pih aman.

reference: Ie mabok lokal phôn nakeuh 'Number One', Nyoe kon saboh ie mabok kompleks, tapih meusenang ngoen phui. Ie mabok lokal laen jiboh nan "Manta".

source: There are many French wines to be had, but the New Zealand and Australian wines might travel better.
reference: Na le boh ie anggo Peuranceh nyang jeuet meuteume, tapi ata Seulandia Baro ngoen Australi mungken leubeh mangat.
hypothesis: Na le anggur Prancis nyang jeut ta pajoh, tapi anggur Selandia Baru ngon Australia mungken leubeh get.

source: The local tap water is perfectly safe to drink, but bottled water is easy to find if you are fearful.
reference: Ie kran lokal nakeuh aman keu geujep. Tapi ie lam botol mudah meurumpok miseu gata yo.
hypothesis: Ié keran lokal that aman untuk diminum, teuma ié nyang na lam botol mudah meurumpok meunyoe gata teumakot.

source: For Australians, the idea of 'flat white' coffee is foreign. A short black is 'espresso', cappuccino comes heaped high with cream (not froth), and tea is served without milk.
reference: Keu ureueng Australi, ide kupi 'flat white' nakeuh aseng. Kupi pancong nakeuh 'espresso', cappuccino dipeugot deungon krim di ateuh (kon busa), ngon te dipeugot hana susu.
hypothesis: Untuk orang Australia, ide kopi 'puteh datar' nyan asing. kopi itam pendek nyan 'espresso', cappuccino nyan di peuget le krim (bukan busa), dan teh jih di jok hana susu.

source: The hot chocolate is up to Belgian standards. Fruit juices are pricey but excellent.
reference: Coklat suum nakeuh standar bak Belgia. Jus boh kayee meuhai tapi leubeh get.
hypothesis: Coklat nyang seu-uem nyan sesuai standar Belgia. Jus boh-boh jih meuhareuga tapi get that.

source: Many trips to the reef are made all year around, and injuries due to any of these causes on the reef are rare.
reference: Lee peurjalanan keu terumbu kareung dipeugot tip thon, ngoen ceudera keu salah saboh peunyebab nibak teurumbu kareung jareueng.
hypothesis: Le perjalanan ke karang dipeuget seulama thon, dan luka karena salah saboh dari penyebab nyo bak karang jarang.

source: Still, take advice from authorities, obey all signs, and pay close attention to safety warnings.
reference: Mantong, neu ikot saran nibak pomeurintah, beu tapateh mandum tanda, ngoen takalon peuringatan beuseulamat.
hypothesis: Teuma, deungoe naseuhat nibak peumeurintah, taát keu mandum tanda, dan peurati that peuingat keuhai keselamatan.

source: Box jellyfish occur near beaches and near river estuaries from October to April north of 1770. They can occasionally be found outside these times.
reference: Kotak ubur-ubur hudep toe bineh laot ngoen bineh krueng nibak Oktober keu April bak baroh nibak 1770. Awak nyan kadang-kadang jeuet ta meurumpok dilua watë nyan.
hypothesis: ubur-ubur kotak nyan na di teungeh pantai dan di teungeh muara krueng dari Oktober sampoe April utara thon 1770.

source: Sharks do exist, however they rarely attack humans. Most sharks are scared of humans and would swim away.
reference: Eungkotyee cit na, adakpih awak nyan jareung ipoh manusia. Lee eungkot yee yoe keu manusia ngoen keuneuk meulangu jioh.
hypothesis: Hieng nyan na, tapi jarang that ji serang manusia. Kebanyakan hieng takot manusia dan akan ji berenang.

source: Saltwater Crocodiles do not actively live in the ocean, their primary habitat is in river estuaries north from Rockhampton.
reference: Buya ie masen hana sereng udep di laot, teumpat hudep phôn awak nyan nakeuh bak muara krueng baroh nibak Rockhampton.
hypothesis: Buaya ie sira hana aktif tinggai di laot, habitat utama jih di muara krueng di utara Rockhampton.

source: Booking in advance gives the traveller peace of mind that they will have somewhere to sleep once they arrive at their destination.
reference: Dipeusan diphon dile geujok keutenangan ulee bak jamee awak nyan na teumpat eh watë awak nyan sampoe bak meulangkah.
hypothesis: Meuseudia leubeh awai geubri keu ureueng meujak nyan keuamanan pikiran bahwa awaknyan na teumpat éh óh ka trok bak teumpat tujuan.

source: Travel agents often have deals with specific hotels, although you may find it possible to book other forms of accommodation, like camping grounds, through a travel agent.
reference: Agen peurjalanan kayem na keuseupakatan deungoen hotel meuteunte, adakpih gata mungken jeuet jipeusan akomodasi laen, lage teumpat meukemah, rot agen peurjalanan.
hypothesis: Agen perjalanan seureng na kesepakatan deungen hotel tertentu, meskipun awak jeut meurumpok mungken untuk memesan bentuk akomodasi laen, lage lapangan berkemah, melalui agen perjalanan.

source: Travel agents usually offer packages that include breakfast, transportation arrangements to/from the airport or even combined flight and hotel packages.

hypothesis: Agen perjalanan biasa jih na paket yang mencakup sarapan, pengaturan transportasi ke/dari bandara atau bahkan paket penerbangan dan hotel yang tergabung.

reference: Awak nyan pih jeuet geutheun peusan keu gata miseu gata peurlee watë keu seumike teuntang geupeutaba atawa peungadaan dokumen laen keu tujuan gata (tamsejih visa).

source: Any amendments or requests though should be coursed through the travel agent first and not directly with the hotel.
reference: Tip peurubahan atawa geulake adakpih seharusjih liwat agen peurjalanan phôn-phôn ngoen hana langsong bak hotel.
hypothesis: Meunye perubahan atau permintaan harus di kirim melalui agen perjalanan phon dan hana langsong bak hotel.

hypothesis: Untuk padum-padum boh festival, mayoritas rayek peungikut festival musik geupileh untuk berkemah di lokasi, dan sebagian rayek peungikut menganggap jih bagian penting dari pengalaman.

hypothesis: Meunyoe droeneuh keuneuk teukeujot, droeneuh harôh teulakee awai mangat jeuet neucok teumpat peudong khimah nyang teukeujot ngon musik.

hypothesis: Padum-padum boh festival na daerah berkemah khusus untuk keluarga deungen aneuk miet ubit.

reference: Awak nyan biasajih na makanan khusus, ie jep ngoen ipeutaba piasan, keu jamee nak nyaman geuh, ngoen keu jaga awak nyan bak premis.
hypothesis: Awak nyan biasa jih na makanan, minuman ngen tawaran hiburan khusus, untuk dipeujaga tamu lam suasana yang get, ngen dipeujaga awak nyan di premis.

hypothesis: Seulama badai salju, salju nyang cukop le sampoe gata ka teutap jeut rhot lam watee nyang paneuk.

reference: Nibak seulaen nyan, cuwaca sijuek ngoen meusalju nyan hai biasa bak le nanggroe-nanggroe, ngoen keundaraan bak jalan jeuet di jak biasajih hana gangguan lam sithon peunoh.

source: Safaris are perhaps the greatest tourism draw in Africa and the highlight for many visitors.
reference: Jak meu safari nyankeuh mungken hai nyang paleng le meukawot wisatawan u Afrika ngoen jeuet keu peunanda keu ramee peungunjong.
hypothesis: Safari mungken atraksi wisata nyang paleng rayek di Afrika dan keujadian nyang paleng peunteng bagi le pengunjung.

source: The term safari in popular use refers to overland travel to view the stunning African wildlife, particularly on savanna.
reference: Istilah safari nyan kayem geu kheun keu rujukan keu jak meu’en meukalon Afrika tutong nyang lagak nyan, teuleubeh lom keu wilayah savanna.
hypothesis: Istilah safari lam penggunaan populer meupeuturi keu perjalanan darat untuk melihat binatang liar Afrika yang menakjubkan, terutama di sabana.

source: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach closely to cars and standard equipment will allow good viewing.
reference: Ladom meunatang, lagee gajah danjeurapah, galak diputoe u moto ngoen na alat nyang standar ka jeuet keu geutanyoe jeuet takalon peumandangan nyang lagak.
hypothesis: Padim boh binatang, lage gajah ngen jerapah, cenderung mendekati mobil dan peralatan standar akan memungkinkan penglihatan yang get.

source: Lions, cheetahs and leopards are sometimes shy and you will see them better with binoculars.
reference: Singa, citah ngön rimueng kadang malee ngön gata jeuet neukalon meunatang nyan dum leubeh jeulaih ngön teropong.
hypothesis: Singa, cheetah dan macan tutul kadang-kadang pemalu dan awak nyan akan leubeh get kalon jih deungen teropong.

source: A walking safari (also called a "bush walk", "hiking safari", or going "footing") consists of hiking, either for a few hours or several days.
reference: Jak meusafari (kadang dikheun seubagoe "jak lam beulueka", "jak jioh meusafari", atawa jak "ngoen tapak") nyang na roeh jak jioh, jeuet padum jeuem atawa padum uroe.
hypothesis: Safari berjalan (juga dikhen "jalan-jalan semak", "safari hiking", atau "meujak") terdiri dari peungembara, seulama padum-padum jam atawa padum-padum uroe.

source: The Paralympics will take place from 24 August to 5 September 2021. Some events will be held in other locations throughout Japan.
reference: Paralimpik nak dimeu’en dari 24 Agustus sampoe 5 September 2021. Ladom lumba nak dimeu’en di ube na dairah-dairah laen nyang na di Jepang.
hypothesis: Paralimpiade akan di peugot bak 24 Agustus sampoe 5 September 2021. Padum-padum boh acara akan di peugot bak teumpat laen di seukitaran Jepang.

source: Tokyo will be the only Asian city to have hosted two summer Olympics, having hosted the games in 1964.
reference: Tokyo nak jeuet keu saboh-sabohjih kuta di Asia nyang ka dipeugot duwa go summer Olimpiade, keuneulheueh dipeugot lumba inan nyankeuh bak thon 1964.
hypothesis: Tokyo jeut keu kota Asia tunggai nyang ka meuseulob dua Olimpiade musim panas, ka meuseulob lam thon 1964.

source: If you booked your flights and accommodation for 2020 before the postponement was announced, you may have a tricky situation.
reference: Meunyo gata neu pesan tiket kapai pho ngoen akomodasi keu 2020 sigohlom watë tunda nyan dibrithee, gata mungken na bak saboh keadaan nyang sosah.
hypothesis: Meunyo droeneuh ka neu book penerbangan dan akomodasi keu thon 2020 sigohlom ditanda tangguhan, droeneuh mungken na situasi nyang payah.

source: Cancellation policies vary, but as of late March most coronavirus-based cancellation policies don't extend to July 2020, when the Olympics had been scheduled.
reference: Aturan peubatai nyan na macam-macam, tapi bak akhe buleuen Maret dum aturan nyang peubatai seubap virus corona nyan han dipeupanyang sampoe Juli 2020, watë Olimpiade nyan ka di boh jadwal.
hypothesis: Kebijakan peubateu nyan meubeda, tapi bak akhe buleun Maret, seubagian rayek kebijakan peubateu nyang na bak koronavirus hana meuluah sampoe Juli 2020, wate Olimpiade ka dipeuteuntée.

source: It's expected that most event tickets will cost between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000, with typical tickets costing around ¥7,000.
reference: Jeuet ta kira bahwasajih dum yum tiket keu acara nyan antara ¥2,500 ngoen ¥130,000, ngôn nyang biasajih yum tiket nyan ¥7,000.
hypothesis: Diharapkan tiket acara nyan akan meubiaya antara ¥2,500 sampoe ¥130,000, deungon tiket biasa jih meubiaya sekitar ¥7,000.

source: Ironing damp clothes can help them dry. Many hotels have an iron and ironing board available for loan, even if one is not present in the room.
reference: Neugeusok bajee nyang juem jeuet peugot nyan tho. Le hotel nyang na geusok ngoen papeun geusok nyang dipeusewa, meuseuki hana meusaboh pih dipuduek lam kama.
hypothesis: Meulapék peukayan nyang basah jeut membantu awak nyan meugleh. le hotel na meupeugleh dan papan meulapék nyang jeut dipinjam, bahkan meunyoe hana saboh di kamar.

source: If an iron isn't available, or if you don't fancy wearing ironed socks, then you can try using a hairdryer, if available.
reference: Meunyo meusaboh geusok hana disinan, atawa meunyo gata hana biasa bak neusok kawoh gaki nyang meugeusok, nyan jeuet gata cuba ngoenpeutho ok (hairdryer), meunyo na teuseudiya.
hypothesis: Meunye hana alat keu meugeusok, atau meunyo hana galak pake kaus kaki yang ka meugeusok, maka jeut neu coba pakek alat keu meugeusok rambut, meunyo na.

source: Be careful not to allow fabric to become too hot (which can cause shrinkage, or in extreme cases, scorch).
reference: Beutegoh mangat ija lipeh bek jeuet seuuem that (nyang jeuet keu seubap baje susot, atawa lam keujadian nyang brat, tutong).
hypothesis: Jaga mangat ija hana jeut keu brat that (nyang jeut menyebabkan menyusut, atau dalam kasus ekstrim, terbakar).

source: There are different ways of purifying water, some more effective against specific threats.
reference: Na le macam cara nyang meubeda keu ta peugleh ie, ladom meuhase keu lawan sipeue-peue peunyaket.
hypothesis: Na cara yang berbeda untuk peugleh ie, na yang leubeh efektif terhadap ancaman tertentu.

source: In some areas boiling water for a minute is enough, in others several minutes are needed.
reference: Lam ladom dairah peuseuuem ie lam seuminet nyan kasep, lam ladom dairah laen peureulee padum-padum minet.
hypothesis: Di padum-padum boh daerah, meuboh ie seulama si menit nyan cukup, di daerah laen, padum-padum boh menit nyan peurle.

source: Filters vary in effectiveness, and should you have a concern, then you should consider buying your water in a sealed bottle from a reputable company.
reference: Peusareng nyan na macam-macam lam hai toh nyang leubeh meuhase, ngoen gata beu neupike keunan, oh lheueh nyan gata beu neupike keu neubloe ie lam kaca nyang meutop rapat dari pabrek nyang ka dituri.
hypothesis: Filter meubeda efektifitas jih, dan jika gata na kekhawatiran, maka gata haroh meupike keu meuli ie lam botol nyang teu tutup dari perusahaan nyang meusyeuhu.

source: Travellers may encounter animal pests that they are not familiar with in their home regions.
reference: Ureueng nyang jak kunjong nyan mungken meurumpok ngoen binatang hama nyang awak nyan hana dituri lom bak dairah asai awak nyan.
hypothesis: Peuneureksa jeut meurumpok ngon hama binatang nyang hana biasa di daerah awak nyan.

source: Pests can spoil food, cause irritation, or in a worse case cause allergic reactions, spread venom, or transmit infections.
reference: Hama jeuet peureuloh peunajoh, peugot gatai, atawa nyang leubeh brat lom peugot wap gatai-gatai, meusipreuek bisa, atawa meukumeun.
hypothesis: Hama jeut jipeurusak makanan, jipeuteuka iritasi, atawa lam kasus nyang leubeh parah jeut jipeuteuka reaksi alergi, jipeutren racun, atawa jipeutaba infeksi.

source: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.
reference: Peunyaket nyang meujangket nyan, atawa meunatang nyang meupaloe nyang jeuet peuluka atawa jikapeulut atawa jipoh matee ureueng ngoen jipaksa, biasajih han ditamoeng lam keulompok hama.
hypothesis: Peunyakét nyang meupeunyakét keudroe, atawa binatang-binatang berbahaya nyang jeut meupeukaru atawa jipoh mate manusia ngon paksa, biasa jih hana dianggap hama.

source: Duty free shopping is the opportunity to buy goods exempted from taxes and excises at certain locations.
reference: Beulanja pree nyankeuh ruweung neubloe barang nyang han keunong wase ngoen cukai bak saboh-saboh teumpat.
hypothesis: Meuligoe bebas bea adalah kesempatan untuk meumungken barang-barang yang dibebaskan dari pajak dan accises di lokasi tertentu.

source: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.
reference: Jamee nyang geusaweu u nanggroe deungon wase nyang brat kadang jeuet geukeubah jai peng, phôn that bak dabeuh lagee ie mabok ngôn bakong.
hypothesis: Peuneujak nyang meuarah u nanggroe-nanggroe ngon pajak nyang brat kadang-kadang jeut geupeuseumeung le dana, terutama bak produk lagee minuman beralkohol ngon tembakau.

source: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
reference: Gareh toe-toe titek Marison ngoen Fairmont jipeuleumah nyang paleng meunantang bak Kuebeu-Jalan Rayeuk Pittsburgh, kayem leupah u dairah uteuen nyang jioh.
hypothesis: Bagian antara Point Marion ngen Fairmont na kondisi meubacut pih payah bak jalan raya Buffalo-Pittsburgh, seureng meulalui daerah uteun yang terisolasi.

source: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
reference: Meunyoe gata hana kayem neume moto bak jalan gampong, beutathee lam pikeran droeneuh: jalan nyang ubeut, ngoen tikongan tajam jai that.
hypothesis: Meunyo droeneuh hana biasa neu-ek bak jalan gampong, jaga-jaga: pantang nyang curam, jalur nyang sampiek, ngon kurva tajam leubeh le.

source: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
reference: Ceu bagah diplueng moto nyang dipeudeuh nyan meudum trep that nibak bagoe sigohlomjih ngoen nyang ‘oh lheueh nyan — biasajih 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — ngoen beubrat tapateh keu awakjih nyan leubeh peunteng nibak buet laen.
hypothesis: Batesan kecepatan nyang dipeutubit leubèh rôh nibak bagian-bagian seugolom ngon seulanjut jih  biasa jih 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h)  ngon patuh nyang ketat bak jih leubeh peunteng daripada yang laen.

source: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
reference: Adakpih, bingoeng, layanan talipun biyasa hinoe leubeh teuga, dibandeng teumpat laen seupanyang jalan, tamsejih Uteun Rimba Pennsylvania.
hypothesis: Namun, yang menarik, layanan telepon seluler leubeh kuat di sini daripada di seureuta bagian laen dari rute, miseu jih Pennsylvania Wilds.

source: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.
reference: Peunajoh kueh asai Jerman nyan cukop mangat, ngoen nyang na di Bavaria, ladom meumacam rasa ngoen meumacam bagoe, rap saban lagee jiran awaknyan nyang na i tunoeng, Austria.
hypothesis: Kue Jerman cukop get, dan di Bavaria, cukop kaya dan meubagoe rupa, mirip ngon nyang di jiran selatan, Austria.

source: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.
reference: Peunajoh kueh dari boh kayee nyan ka jeuet keu hai nyang lazem, ngon boh apel nyang ditaguen lam peunajoh kueh lam sithon punoeh, ngon boh ceri ngon boh plum na deuh ta kaloen watee musem seuuem.
hypothesis: Kue boh-boh biasa, deungen apel yang dipeutah keu kue sepanjang thon, ngen ceri ngon prune yang muncul seulama musim panas.

source: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.
reference: Jai ureueng Jeurman nyang tot peunajoh kuweh na cit geuboh kacang almond, kacang hazelnut, ngon meubagoe kacang dari bak kayee nyang laen. Peunajoh kuweh nyang dituri nyan kayem mangat dipajoh sira ngon tajep saboh glah ie kupi nyang kreuh.
hypothesis: Le barang-barang nyang dipeuget di Jerman na cit almond, kacang hazel, ngon kacang-kacangan la'en. kue nyang populer seureng that cocok deungon saboh cangkir kopi nyang teuga.

source: If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.
reference: Meunnyoe gata hawa keu peunajoh kue kreuh nyang mangat rasa, Aci neu ujoe rasa nyang na i dairah nyang dikheun Berliner, Pfannkuchen atawa Krapfen.
hypothesis: Meunyo droeneuh keuneuk bacut kue-kue ubit tapi kaya, coba nyang tergantung bak wilayah nyan geukheun Berliner, Pfannkuchen atawa Krapfen.

source: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.
reference: Peunajoh kari nyang na keuh saboh teumon bu dari meubagoe oen kayee ngoen dabeuh maguen, geujampu ngoen eungkot sie atawa gulee.
hypothesis: Kari nakeuh saboh hidangan nyang geupeuget dari ramuan ngon rempah-rempah, meusigoe ngon asoe atawa sayuran.

source: A curry can be either "dry" or "wet" depending on the amount of liquid.
reference: Peunajoh kari nyan na nyang "tho" atawa "meukuwah" nyan dipeuteunte ile dum na jai ie.
hypothesis: Kari jeut "garing" atau "basah" tergantung bak jumlah cairan.

source: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.
reference: Dairah nyang meugampong i bahgian India Utara ngoen Pakistan, yogurt nyan lazem diboih lam peunajoh kari, i India Tunong ngoen ladom daerah pantee i bahgian beunua, ie santan lazem di boih lam atra nyan.
hypothesis: Di wilayah pedalaman India Utara ngon Pakistan, yoghurt biasa dipakek dalam kari; di India Selatan ngon padum-padum boh wilayah pesisir di benua bagian baroh, susu kelapa biasa dipakek.

source: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.
reference: Ngoen 17.000 pulo nyang jeuet tapileh, Peunajoh Indonesia nyan lagee ban tamselan payong nyang khop wilayah nyang luwah that nibak meubagoe macam peunajoh nyang jeuet ta tumee ban saboh nanggroe.
hypothesis: Deungen 17.000 pulo untuk geupileh, makanan Indonesia adalah istilah yang mencakup berbagai macam masakan regional yang teutap di seluruh negara.

source: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.
reference: Tapih, meunyoe hana ta nilai leubeh jioh, tamselan nyan jeuet keu diboih makna peunajoh nyang troh nibak wilayah bahgian teungoh ngoen timue pulo Jawa sagai.
hypothesis: Tapi, jika dipakek tanpa kualifikasi laen, istilah nyan cenderung meuarti makanan yang asai jih dari bagian teungeh dan timu pulau utama Jawa.

source: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
reference: Jinoe dum pat na ban mandum pulo, Peunajoh ureueng Jawa nyan na saboh peukateun nyang deuh nibak cara geuboh dabeuh magun nyang seudang, dabeuh magun nyang paleng jai geu boih le ureueng Jawa na keuh boh kacang tanoh, campli, saka (teuleubeh lom saka boh u Jawa) ngoen meubagoe debeuh magun nyang meubhee harom.
hypothesis: Jinoe ka le that ji ateuh di mandum Nusantara, masakan Jawa na meubagoe macam hidangan nyang biasa ji peugala, nyang paleng lejih ji peugala nakeuh kacang, cabe, gula (khusus jih gula kelapa) dan meubagoe macam bumbu.

source: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
reference: Sanggrudi nyan na keuh ngoen puduek tapak gaki sidroe ureueng nyang ek guda nyang na di miyup ban duwa blah teumpat duek ateuh guda.
hypothesis: Stirrup adalah dukungan untuk gaki peungendara yang meugantung di dua blah pelunggu.

source: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
reference: Atra duwa nyan jeuet keuh sabagoe peukakah keu peuaman ureueng nyang ek guda tapi jeuet cit keu meupaloe kareuna mungken gaki ureueng nyang ek guda jeuet meusangkot lam atra duwa nyan.
hypothesis: Awak nyan meujok stabilitas nyang leubeh rayek keu pengendara teutapi jeut na masalah keselamatan kareuna potensi gaki pengendara untuk nyangkut di dalam jih.

source: If a rider is thrown from a horse but has a foot caught in the stirrup, they could be dragged if the horse runs away. To minimize this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.
reference: Meunyoe sidroe ureueng nyang ek guda nyan rhot dari guda tapih siblah gaki gobnyan mantoeng meusangkot lam sanggrudi, ureueng nyan meubahue ateuh tanoh meunyoe guda teuga diplung. Keu tatheun bahya nyan, ladom cara keu peuaman droe jeuet ta cok seugohlom nyan.
hypothesis: Meunyoe sidroe nyang giduek di ateueh guda nyan jitron, teuma gaki jih keunong bak tungkat, awaknyan hase ji tarek meunyoe guda nyan jiplueng.

source: First, most riders wear riding boots with a heel and a smooth, quite narrow, sole.
reference: Keuphôn, dum ureueng nyang ek guda suwah sok sipatu nyang na tumet ngoen tapak sipatu nyang haloh, ubit bacut.
hypothesis: Phon-phon that, le ureung tunggang tunggang tunggang meungui sepatu tunggang tunggang nyang na tumpat dan seuleng jih lipeh dan cukop sampiek.

source: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.
reference: Lheuhnyan, ladom teumpat duek ateuh guda, teuleubeh lom teumpat duek Inggreh, na kayee keu peuaman nyang jeuet di peu rhot taloe teumpat meusangkot sanggrudi meunyoe meutarek u likot watë rhot ureueng nyang ba guda.
hypothesis: Lheuh nyan, padum-padum boh jok, terutama jok Inggris, na palang keselamatan yeng memungkinkan kulit tongkat untuk rhot dari jok jika ditarik mundur le peungendara yang rhot.

source: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.
reference: Jeureulong Cochamó - saboh teumpat ek cot numboi sa nyang na di Chili dituri cit ngoen nan Yosemite di Ameurika Tunong, ngoen meubagoe binteh ngoen kareung dari granit.
hypothesis: Lembah Cochamó - tujuan pendakian utama Chili, nyang dikenal sebagai Yosemite Amerika Selatan, deungen meubagoe macam tembok granit rayeuk ngen tebing.

source: Summits include breath-taking views from peaks. Climbers from all parts of the world are continually establishing new routes amongst its endless potential of walls.
reference: Puncak na peumandangan nyang lagak dari ateuh. Ureueng nyang ek cot nyang teuka dari meubagoe bahgian bumoe tiep sabee na geupeuna jalan baro u meubagoe binteh nyang hana akhe nyan.
hypothesis: Puncak nyan na pemandangan yang meugeumbira dari puncak nyan. peunjat dari mandum bagian donya terus-menerus dipeuget rute-rute baro di antara potensi yang hana putôh-putôh dari binteng jih.

source: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
reference: Ulahraga salju u arah troen buket, nyang na keuh ski ngon seluncoe salju, nyan keuh ulahraga nyang jituri nyang na roh meuluncoe u arah miyup i tanoeh nyang meutop ngon salju ngon ski atawa ngon seuluncoe salju nyang meusangkot ngon gaki gata.
hypothesis: Olahraga salju turun, yeng termasuk ski ngen snowboarding, adalah olahraga populer yeng melibatkan meluncur ke bawah medan yang tertutup salju deungen ski atau snowboard yeng terpasang bak gaki gata.

source: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
reference: Meu’en ski na keuh keu tujuan utama dari jak meu’en nyang rame ureueng galak, kadang na jiboh nan seubagoe "ureueng nyang udep keu ski", nyang ka geu peugoet reuncana jak watë pre keu meu’en ski bak saboh teumpat meuteunte.
hypothesis: "Skiing" adalah kegiatan wisata utama deungen le peuncinta, kadang-kadang dikhen "ski bum", yang merencanakan mandum liburan seputar ski di lokasi tertentu.

source: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
reference: Asai dari ski nyan ka tuha that — gamba nyan jigamba i guha geu peugah nibak ureueng nyang meu’en ski dari jameun ka trep that 5000 BC!
hypothesis: Ide ski nyan jameun that  lukisan gua yang meupeudeh ureung ski meuulang bak 5000 SM!

source: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
reference: Ski u arah tron buket seubagoe saboh ulahraga ka mulai na paleng kureung wateë abad keu-17, ngon wateë 1861 teumpat keu meu’en ski nyang keu-phôn that i buka le ureueng Norwegia di Australia.
hypothesis: Ski turun sebagai olahraga mulai dari abad keu-17, dan bak thon 1861 klub ski rekreasi phon dipeubuka le Norwegia di Australia.

source: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.
reference: Meuba tah raya sira meu’en ski: Buet nyoe jeuet cit dikheun ski u alam luwa, ski sira jak jioh atawa ski sira ek gunong.
hypothesis: Backpacking ngen ski: Kegiatan nyo cit dikhen backcountry ski, ski touring atau ski hiking.

source: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.
reference: Nyoe meusangkot tapih hana roeh ngôn jak jioh ski aleh alpine atawa jak ek gunong, nyang keuneuleuh nyoe ipubuet i wilayah tanoh nyang meureuleueng ngoen peureulee keu alat ski ngoen sipatu nyang kreuh.
hypothesis: Nyan berhubungan deungen tapi biasa jih hana melibatkan ski style alpine atau menara, yang terakhir dilakukan di medan curam dan meumungken ski dan sepatu yang leubeh kaku.

source: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.
reference: Neupikee mantoeng rauh jak ski nyang saban cit lagee jalan jak ek gunong.
hypothesis: Anggap rute ski lagee rute peunjelajah yang serupa.

source: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.
reference: Lam watë nyang get gata keuneuk troh u teumpat nyang leubeh jioh lom nibak neujak ngoen tapak – tapi jareung that gata keuneuk troh bagah lagee tajak ngoen ski i alam luwa ngoen hana tah geuhon sajan watë i jalan nyang biyasa.
hypothesis: Lam kondisi nyang get awak nyan jeut meucuroh jarak yang leubeh rayek daripada berjalan  tapi hanya seucara langka awak nyan akan meuhase kecepatan ski lintas darat tanpa tas ransel yang brat di trek yang dipeurele.

source: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
reference: Eropa nakeuh saboh benua nyang relatif ubeut teutapi deungoen le nanggroe meurdehka. Jimiyub keadaan normal, meujak-jak rhot padum boh nanggroe wajeb liwat aplikasi visa ngoen geupareksa paspor padum go.
hypothesis: Eropa adalah benua yang relatif ubit tapi na le nanggroe independen. lam keadaan biasa, meupeuget perjalanan melalui le nanggroe akan harus melalui aplikasi visa dan kontrol paspor berkali-kali.

source: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
reference: Wilayah Schengen, adak pih, keureuja karab lage saboh nanggroe lam geuhormati nyoe.
hypothesis: Namun, zona Schengen, meubuet bacut lagee saboh nanggroe dalam hal nyo.

source: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
reference: Watë gata tinggai lam wilayah nyoe, gata biasajih jeuet liwat peurbatasan hana jak rhot poh peupareksa paspor dile.
hypothesis: Seulama awak nyan tinggai di zona nyo, awak nyan umum jih jeut meulinteung bataih tanpa melalui pos pemeriksaan paspor lom.

source: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
reference: Lage nyan cit, na poe visa Schengen, gata hana peurlee ngui visa keu maseng-maseng nanggroe anggota Schengen, jeuet keubah watë, peng ngoen beureukas.
hypothesis: Demikian pula, deungen na visa Schengen, droeneuh hana perlee untuk melamar visa keu tiep-tiep nanggroe anggota Schengen secara terpisah, sehingga menghemat waktu, uang ngen dokumen.

source: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
reference: Hana difinisi umum keu bagoe dabeuh-dabeuh nyang jipeugoet dikheun keu dabeuh antik. Ladom agen pajak geuteutapkan dabeuh nyang sep brat trep ka dari 100 thon seubagoe dabeuh antik.
hypothesis: Hana definisi universal untuk barang-barang yang diproduksi adalah barang antik. Na beberapa lembaga pajak yang mendefinisikan barang yang leubeh tuha dari 100 thon sebagai barang antik.

source: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.
reference: Difinisi nyan nakeuh meubagoe macam meuhubong ngôn wilayah, nibak ceu umu mungken paneuk that i teumpat – teumpat lage Ameurika Tunong dari i Ierupa.
hypothesis: Definisi na variasi geografis, di pat batas umu mungken leubeh pendek di teumpat-teumpat lagee Amerika Utara daripada di Eropa.

source: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.
reference: Buet jaroe jeuet jikheun seubagoe dabeuh antik, adakpi atranyan leubeh ban na nibak peuneugot ureueng ramee nyang sama hi.
hypothesis: Produk kerajinan jeut didefinisikan seubagai barang antik, meskipun jih leubeh muda dari barang-barang yang sama yang diproduksi secara massal.

source: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.
reference: Peularha rusa nyan keuh cara mita raseuki i seulingka ureueng Sámi ngoen budaya seulingka bloe meubloe nyankeuh cara mita raseuki peunteng sit keu ureueng ramee ngoen pangkat laen.
hypothesis: Perkebunan rusa adalah penghidupan yang peunteng di kalangan Sami dan budaya yang mengelilingi perdagangan nyoe peunteng cit untuk ureung yang na profesi laen.

source: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.
reference: Bahpih seucara tradisional, adakpi, hana mandum ureueng Sámi rhoh lam peularha rusa lam jumlah nyang jai, tapih udep ngoen geukeumawe, jak lam uteun ngoen seujeunehjih, na rusa na ladom nyang jai meunatang teumarek.
hypothesis: Bahkan secara tradisional, hana mandum Sami yang terlibat dalam pengolah rusa skala rayek, tapi udep dari memancing, berburu dan serupa, yang memiliki rusa sebagian besar sebagai hewan tarik.

source: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.
reference: Uroe nyoe jai ureueng Sámi keureuja bak bloe peubloe nyang moderen. Ureueng jak tamasya nyankeuh wase nyang peuteng i Sámi.
hypothesis: Jinoe le ureung Sami yang bekerja bak bidang modern. Pariwisata adalah pendapatan yang peunteng di Sápmi, daerah Sami.

source: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.
reference: Bahpih nyan jai jiboh, keu phôn that bak kalangan non-Romani, kata "gipsi" kayem jianggap teupeh kareuna meusapatjih ngoen nilai hana get ngoen pandangan nyang hana trang keu awak Romani.
hypothesis: Meskipun jih ji pakek le, terutama di kalangan non-Roma, kata "Gypsy" seureng dianggap ofensif karena hubongan jih deungen stereotip negatif dan persepsi yang hana akurat tentang orang Roma.

source: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected.
reference: Meunyoe nanggroe nyang droeneuh jak saweu tundok keu haba peuingat bak rauh, asuransi keusihatan peurjalanan droeneuh mungken teupeungaroh bak asuransi peubateu peurjalanan droeneuh.
hypothesis: Meunye nanggroe nyang awak nyan akan jak jeut keu subjek nasehat perjalanan, asuransi kesehatan perjalanan atau asuransi pembatalan perjalanan awak nyan jeut terpengaruh.

source: You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens.
reference: Droeneuh mungken jeuet sit neuteumanyoeng deungoen saran pomeurintah selaen droe teuh, tapih saranjih nyankeuh nyang jirancang keu ureueng gampongjih.
hypothesis: Mungken awak nyan cit keuneuk konsultasi nasehat dari pemerintah laen dari awak nyan, teutapi nasehat awak nyan ditujukan keu warga awak nyan.

source: As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs.
reference: Lage saboh miseu, awak nanggroe Ameurika i timu teungoeh mungken geuhadapi keuadaan nyang meubeda nibak ureueng Eropa ngoen ureueng Arab.
hypothesis: Seubagai saboh contoh, warga Amerika di Timur Tengah mungken meukalee situasi yang beda dari Eropa atau Arab.

source: Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country.
reference: Nasihat nakeuh saboh ceurita tuet bak keuadaan politek i saboh nanggroe.
hypothesis: Nasehat nyan cuma saboh ringkasan singkat dari situasi politik di saboh nanggroe.

source: The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
reference: Tampilan nyang jiseudiya kayem sigoe ble, umum ngoen jipeupah jeuet keu haba nyang leubeh trang jiseudiya bak teumpat laen.
hypothesis: Pandangan nyang di peutunyok seureng that hana teuliti, umum dan terlalu disederhanakan dibandingkan ngen informasi nyang leubeh rinci nyang na di teumpat laen.

source: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.
reference: Cuwaca brok nyankeuh istilah umum keu tip fenomena cuwaca nyang meupaloe nyang teubit sabap reulhoh, keubit peugabuk dum ureueng, atawa gadoh nyawoeng ureueng.
hypothesis: Cuaca parah adalah istilah umum untuk fenomena cuaca berbahaya yang berpotensi meupeunaca kerusakan, gangguan sosial yang serius, atau kehilangan nyawa manusia.

source: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
reference: Cuwaca hana get keu neukjeuet dumpat lam dônya, ngoen meubagoe jeuneh, nyan jeuet meusangkot bak geografi, topografi, ngoen keuadaan atmosfir.
hypothesis: Cuaca parah jeut terjadi di mana-mana di donya, dan na macam jih, yeng jeut tergantung bak geografi, topografi, ngen kondisi atmosfer.

source: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.
reference: Angen bade, ujeun eh, ujeun raya, ngoen tutoeng uteun sabap cuwaca hana get, lage bade geulanteu, angen topan, angen puteng beuliyong, ngoen angen meuputa.
hypothesis: Angen teuga, ujeuen es, ujeuen leubèh, ngon kebakaran uteuen nakeuh bentuk ngon efek cuaca parah, lage badai awan, tornado, air terjun, ngon siklon.

source: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.
reference: Fenomena cuwaca hana get ngoen teumpat teumasok bade salju, bade-bade salju, bade eh, ngoen bade abee.
hypothesis: Fenomena cuaca parah regional ngen musem termasuk badai salju, badai salju, badai es, ngen badai abée.

source: Travellers are strongly advised to be aware of any risk of severe weather affecting their area as they may affect any travel plans.
reference: Ureueng jak tamasya sep brat geubi nasihat beu teugoh that meuresiko cuwaca hana get nyang meupeungaroh teumpat awak nyan kareuna jeuet keu mepeungaroh dumpue peurjalanan.
hypothesis: Peuneureksa dipeugah beu beu sadar keu resiko cuaca parah yang meupeungaroh bak wilayah awak nyan karena jeut meupeungaroh rencana perjalanan.

source: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training.
reference: Sibeurangkasoe nyang keuneuk saweu u nanggroe nyang ka jianggap teumpat meuprang suwah meutume peulatihan profisional.
hypothesis: Soe mantong nyang peugabong keu jijak u saboh nanggroe nyang jeut dianggap sebagai daerah prang haroh meujampu pelatihan profesional.

source: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.
reference: Seutot bak internet keu 'Meurunoe bak teumpat nyang na musoh' mungken jibi alamat peurusahaan lam wilayah droe.
hypothesis: Pencarian internet untuk 'kursus lingkungan bermusuhan' mungken akan geubri alamat perusahaan lokal.

source: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.
reference: Jak meurunoe biasajih neuk teumasok ban mandum peukara nyang jipeugah hinoe ngoen abeh mandum, biasajih ngoen peungalaman pubuet langsong.
hypothesis: Kursus biasa jih akan mencakup mandum isu nyang dibahas di sini deungen leubeh rinci, biasa jih deungen pengalaman praktis.

source: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.
reference: Jak meurunoe biasajih teumasok 2-5 uroe ngoen roh meu’en droe, jai soe tuloeng bak phôn ngoen meurunoe seunjata.
hypothesis: Kursus biasa jih akan dari 2-5 uroe dan akan melibatkan peran, le bantuan phon dan kadang latihan senjata.

source: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
reference: Buku ngoen majalah nyang meusangkot ngoen udep uteuen beulantara nyankeuh hai ladem, tapi publikasi nyang meusangkot bacut ngoen wilayah prang.
hypothesis: Buku ngon majalah nyang meuhubông ngon keumanusiaan di padang beulantara kayém that, teuma hana le publikasi nyang meuhubông ngon daerah-daerah nyang na lam prang.

source: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
reference: Ureueng tamasya nyang niet geuneuk operasi meunale iluwa nanggroe suwah geu peuteunte bahwasajih awaknyan jiba beureukah nyang geuakui keu peurjalanan woe.
hypothesis: Peusawat nyang peugalak operasi peubah jenis kelamin di lua nanggroe harus memastikan awak nyan geuba dokumen nyang sah untuk perjalanan woe.

source: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
reference: Geutem pomeurentah peutubiet paspor ngoen jeuneh keulamin nynag hana geuseubot (X) atawa beureukah jipeubaro nak saban ngoen nan nyang galak geuh ngoen meubagoe jeuneh keulamin.
hypothesis: Keukeuheundak pemerintah untuk meutuleh paspor deungen jenis kelamin hana dikhen (X) atau dokumen yang dipeuupdate untuk meucocok deungen nan dan jenis kelamin yang di inginkan bervariasi.

source: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
reference: Geutem poemeurentah luwa keu geupeuyum buereukah-beureukah nyan sit sep meumacam bagoe.
hypothesis: Keukeuheundak pemerintah lua nanggroe untuk menghormati dokumen nyoe sama deungen bervariasi.

source: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.
reference: Taseutoet bak pos peumeuriksaan keuamanan pih meutamah brat gabuek bak lheuh 11 September, masa 2001.
hypothesis: Pencarian di pos pemeriksaan keamanan cit ka jeut lubeh meuluah bak masa lheuh 11 September 2001.

source: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
reference: Ureueng transgender Lheuh-Operasi jeuet han jiharap keu leupah peumindai deungoen privasi ngoen matabat awaknyan keunong.
hypothesis: Ureueng transgender nyang ka teutap hana haroh ta harapkan jeut ji lewatkan bak scanner nyan seulaen privasi dan martabat jih hana meulangga.

source: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
reference: Ie meuguloeng nyankeuh riyeuk meuhambo i bineh pasi, kayem i ateuh bate kareung atawa ngoen seujeunehjih.
hypothesis: Arus rip adalah aliran yang kembali dari ombak yang pecah dari pantai, seureng di terumbu karang atau yang serupa.

source: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
reference: Kareuna topologi imiyup ie, ilee ie meuriwang le bak padit boh bahgian nyang lhok, ngoen ilee ie nyang sep bagah u ie nyang lhok mungken asai phôn jisinan.
hypothesis: Kareuna topologi di baroh ie aliran pengembalian terkonsentrasi di padim boh bagian yang leubeh lhok, dan arus nyang bagah u ie lhok jeut terbentuk di sinan.

source: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
reference: Dum ureueng meuninggai kareuna hek meulangue geutheun ie, nyang mungken mustahe.
hypothesis: Le that ureuëng meuninggai akibat leumoh bak meucuba meulangoe u likot, nyang mungken hana mungken.

source: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
reference: Lam sigra lheuh tatubiet nibak ie, tameulangue kop payah dari biasajih.
hypothesis: Meunan gata teubiet dari arus, meulambong lom hana leubeh sulet nibak biasa.

source: Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.
reference: Ci neujak u arah bak saboh teumpat dipat gata han le roeh lam nyan atawa, meugantong bak keuahlian gata ngoen pue gata peuratie, gata mungken neupreh jituloeng.
hypothesis: Coba tujuan bak teumpat awak nyan hana jidrob lom atau, tergantung bak keahlian awak nyan dan peu awak nyan kaleuh dituri, awak nyan mungken ingin menunggu penyelamatan.

source: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.
reference: Teukeujot aleuh geutamong teuma leubeh bagah teujadi dari teukeujot budaya (hana had buleun phon), leubeh trep ngoh leubeh brat.
hypothesis: Keujadian shock re-entry leubeh awai dari shock budaya (hana leubeh le fase bulan madu), leubeh treb, dan jeut leubeh parah.

source: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
reference: Awak galak jak nyang na watee mangat geupeusaban droegeuh ngon adat baro meujan-jan payah that roh geupeusaban droe ngon budaya droegeuh.
hypothesis: Ureuëng nyang jijak u nanggroe laén, nyang hana payah meu-ubah keulayi ngon budaya nanggroe nyan, kadang-kadang hana mudah meu-ubah keulayi ngon budaya nanggroe jih.

source: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
reference: Watee woe u rumoh lheuh geuduek iluwa nanggroe, droe neuh ka neu peubiasa droe ngon adat baro ngon gadoh adat droe neuh dari nanggroe asai.
hypothesis: Watee neuwoe u rumoh lheuh tinggai di lua nanggroe, droeneuh ka meu adaptasi ngon budaya baroe dan ka gadôh padum-padum kebiasaan droeneuh dari budaya droeneuh.

source: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
reference: Watee dron neuh phon trok u luwa nanggroe, ureueng mungken saba ngon meuphom, awaknyan jitupeue awak galak jak bak nanggroe baro peureule peusaban droe.
hypothesis: Bak watée gata phon-phon that tajak u nanggroe aséng, ureuëng-ureuëng nyan mungken saba dan muphom, sabab awaknyan jiteupeue bahwa ureuëng nyang teungoh jijak u nanggroe barô nyan harôh jimeuubah.

source: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
reference: Ureueng mungken hana geutupeue bahwa saba ngon meuphom nyan peureulee keu awak galak jak-jak nyang woe u rumoh.
hypothesis: Ureuëng-ureuëng mungken hana jimeuharab bahwa saba ngon meuphom cit peurle keu ureueng meujak woe.

source: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
reference: Su meulagu ngoen cahya piramida nyankeuh saboh hai nyang sep lagak bak teumpat nyan keu aneuk miet.
hypothesis: Piramida suara ngon cahaya adalah salah saboh hal nyang paleng menarik di daerah nyan untuk aneuk miet.

source: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
reference: Gata jeut taeu piramida nyan lam seupôt ngön lam seungap sigohlom piasan nyan dipuphôn.
hypothesis: Droeneuh jeut neukalon piramida lam seupôt dan droeneuh jeut neukalon lam diam sigohlom acara dimulai.

source: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
reference: Biasajih gata sabèe tadeungoe su ureueng meukunjông ngön ureueng meukat. Calitra su ngön calitra cahya nyan lagèe saboh buku calitra.
hypothesis: biasa jih tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep tiep

source: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
reference: Sphinx nyan dipeujeut keu layeu di likôt ngön keu nyang peugah saboh calitra nyang panyang.
hypothesis: Sphinx dipeuduek seubagai latar belakang dan narator saboh kisah panyang.

source: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
reference: Gamba-gamba dipeudeuh bak piramida nyan, ngön piramida-piramida laén dipeuhu cahya.
hypothesis: Adehan nyan ditampilkan bak piramida ngon piramida yang berbeda dipeutrang.

source: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
reference: Pulo Shetland Seulatan, nyang diteumèe bak thôn 1819, diakui lé padum boh nanggroe, pulo nyan na paléng lë markah teuntra, deungön nam blah nyang manteng aktif lam thôn 2020.
hypothesis: Pulo-pulo Shetland Selatan, yeng diteume bak thon 1819, diklaim le padum-padum boh nanggroe ngen na base paleng rayek, deungen nam blah aktif bak thon 2020.

source: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
reference: Pulo nyan meuleueng 120 km u baroh di ujông. Nyang paléng rayek nakeuh Pulo King George deungön pemukiman Villa Las Estrellas.
hypothesis: Keulaue nyoe na di utara pulo pulo nyoe 120 km. Keulaue nyang paleng rayek nakeuh Pulo Raja George ngon gampông Villa Las Estrellas.

source: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
reference: Pulo nyang laén nakeuh Pulo Livingston, ngön pulo Deception nyang ile kaldera dari gunong meuapui yang manteng aktif, atranyan peugot peulabohan deuh lagak.
hypothesis: Laen jih termasuk Pulau Livingston, ngen Kebohongan di pat kaldera yang karam dari gunung berapi yang mantong aktif jeut keu pelabuhan alam yang spektakuler.

source: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
