reference: Ellsworth Land nakeuh dairah blah tunong ujông tanjong, diceue lé Laôt Bellingshausen.
hypothesis: Tanoh Ellsworth nakeuh wilayah di tunong Semenanjung, nyang ji batas le La'ot Bellingshausen.

source: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
reference: Gunong-gunong bak wilayah tanjong disinoe meusapat jeut keu tanoh manyang, ‘oh lheueh nyan meusapat lom jeut keu 360 km rante gunong Ellsworth, diplah lé Glacier Minnesota.
hypothesis: Gunong-gunong di Semenanjung di sini meugabong ke dalam dataran tinggi, kemudian meu-tumeung lom untuk meupeuget rante 360 km Gunong-gunong Ellsworth, dipeucrebre le gletser Minnesota.

source: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
reference: Dairah blah baroh atawa Sentinel Range na gunong nyang paléng manyang di Antartika, nanjih Vinson Massif, manyang puncakjih Gunong Vinson 4892 m.
hypothesis: Bagian utara atawa Sentinel Range na gunong-gunong paleng manyang di Antartika, Vinson Massif, nyang meupeukrueng bak manyang 4892 m Gunung Vinson.

source: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
reference: Bak teumpat nyang jioh, hana jangkauan télépon, saboh télépon sateulit mungkén jeut keu pilehan gata.
hypothesis: Di teumpat-teumpat nyang jiôh, hana na jangkauan telepon seluler, telepon satelit mungken saboh-saboh jih pilihan gata.

source: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
reference: Saboh télépon sateulit umumjih kon saboh geulantoe keu télépon seluler, gata suah na i luwa deungön pandangan nyang trang mangat jeut peugot saboh panggelan télépon.
hypothesis: Telepon satelit umum jih hana jeut keu pengganti untuk telepon seluler, karena awak nyan harus di lua ruangan deungen garis pandang yang jelas keu satelit untuk meutuleh telepon.

source: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.
reference: Layanan nyoe leubéh kayem dingui lé meulayeu, teumasok kapai peusiar, ngön ekspedisi nyang peurlèe data dari jioh ngön peurlèe su.
hypothesis: Layanan nyoe seureng dipakek le pelayaran, termasuk peurahô rekreasi, seurta ekspedisi nyang na data jarak jauh dan kebutuhan suara.

source: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.
reference: Layanan télépon lokal gata seharohjih jeut dijok haba bah meusambông keu layanan nyoe.
hypothesis: Penyedia layanan telepon lokal awak nyan haroh jeut jibri informasi leubeh lanjut tentang cara meugabong ke layanan nyo.

source: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
reference: Hai nyang ka mulai di turi sabagoe saboh pilihan bagi nyang meu rencana dalam sithôn nakeuh jak travel sira jak meuruno.
hypothesis: Pilihan nyang leubeh populer untuk ureung nyang peurancang thon cuko adalah untuk meulangkah dan meurunoe.

source: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
reference: Nyoe leubéh lom di turi lé awak nyang barô tamat sikula, jeuet keu urueng nyan untuk cok watèe keu sithôn sigolom jak tameng universitas, tanpa harus peutinggai peundidekan.
hypothesis: Nyo terutama populer di kalangan ureung yang kalheuh sekolah, memungkinkan awak nyan untuk meupeuglah sithon seugolom universitas, tanpa mengkompromikan pendidikan awak nyan.

source: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
reference: Dalam le kasus, tadaftar untuk sithôn jak sikula u luwa naggroe jeuet meutamah kesempatan bagi droeteuh untuk tapinah sikula nyang leubéh hayeu lom di nanggroe droe.
hypothesis: Lam le kasus, meutuleh bak kursus gap year di lua nanggroe jeut beutoi-beutoi meningkatkan kesempatan awak untuk pindah ke pendidikan tinggi di nanggroe awak.

source: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
reference: Biasajih akan na biaya peundidekan untuk ta daftar program-program peundidekan nyan.
hypothesis: Biasa jih akan na biaya kuliah untuk terdaftar bak program pendidikan nyo.

source: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
reference: Finlandia nakeuh tujuan meupeuraho yang lagak. “Nanggroe Siribee Dano” cit na meuribee pulo, di dano ngon di kepulauan peusise.
hypothesis: Finlandia adalah tujuan peunumpang nyang hebat. "Tanoh siribée danau" na meuribée pulo cit, di danau ngon di nusantara panté.

source: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
reference: Di pulo-pulo ngon dano droen hana peurele kapai peusiar.
hypothesis: Di nusantara dan danau awak nyan hana perle kapal pesiar.

source: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
reference: Bah pih kepulauan peusiser ngon danau nyang paleng rayek memang cukop rayek keu kapai peusiar toh mantong, peuraho nyang leubeh ubit atawa bahkan kayak peureulee peungalaman yang meubeda.
hypothesis: Meskipun kepulauan pesisir ngen danau rayek memang cukup rayek untuk peurahô, peurahô ubit atawa bahkan kayak na pengalaman yang beda.

source: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
reference: Meupeuraho nakeuh hobi nasional di Finlandia, deungon saboh peuraho keu tiep tujoh atau lapan ureueng.
hypothesis: Meulayeue nakeuh saboh hobi nasional di Finlandia, deungen saboh peurahô keu tiep tujoh atawa lapan droe.

source: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
reference: Nyoe cocok deungon Norwegia, Swedia ngon Selandia Baro, teutapi sibalekjih cukop unik (miseujih di Belanda angka jih sa bandeng peut ploh).
hypothesis: Nyoe di peusaho le Norwegia, Swedia ngen Selandia Baru, teutapi laen jih unik (misaljih di Beulanda angka nyoe adalah saboh sampoe peuet ploh).

source: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
reference: Le dari kapai-kapai pesiar mewah Baltic Cruises dipiyoh dalam watèe nyang trep di St. Petersburg, Russia.
hypothesis: Le that kruis nyang na di Baltik na tinggai di St. Petersburg, Rusia.

source: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
reference: Nyoe berarti droeneuh jeuet neukunjông kuta nyang meusejarah lam padup uroe sira neuwo ngön neueh dalam kapai watèe malam.
hypothesis: Nyoe berarti awak jeut tajak ke kota bersejarah selama dua uroe penuh seulama woe dan ji éh di kapai malam.

source: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
reference: Meunyoe droeneuh neu tingoh u darat deungön paket piknik dari kapai droeneuh hana peureulèe lé keu visa nyang laén (mulai thôn 2009).
hypothesis: Meunyo droeneuh hanya jak u darat ngen menggunakan kunjungan di ateueh kapai, droeneuh hana perlee visa yang terpisah (seujak thon 2009).

source: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
reference: Ladom kapai pesiar na dipeuroh Berlin, German dalam brosur-brosur. Lage nyang deuh neu kalen dari map nyang na di ateuh Berlin nyan hana toe meubacut pih deungön laôt ngön jak meukeunjong u kutanyan hana roeh dalam biaya sewa kapai pesiar.
hypothesis: Na padum-padum boh kruis nyang na di brochure nyan na Berlin, Jerman. lage nyang jeut neukiraju bak peuta di ateuh, Berlin hana to ngon laot dan kunjungan u kota nyan hana termasuk dalam harga kruis.

source: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.
reference: Jak travel deungön kapai phe jeuet keu saboh pengalaman nyang geu takot lé ureueng dari mandum umu ngön kalangan, leubéh khusus lom bagi ureueng nyang sigohlomjih han tom geu jak deungön kapai phe atawa nyang na pengalaman akan keujadian nyang geu peugot ureueng nyan ye.
hypothesis: Meugeurjalan ngon pesawat jeut keu pengalaman nyang teumakot keu ureung dari mandum umu dan latar belakang, terutama jika awak nyan gohlom pernah terbang seugolom nyan atau ka mengalami kejadian traumatis.

source: It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have.
reference: Nyan nakeuh saboh hai nyang hana peureulèe malèe teuh, nyan hana meubeda deungön hai-hai nyang biasa di takot lé ureueng ngön nyang di peujioh nyang ramé ureueng rasa.
hypothesis: Nyan hana sapeue yang harus di hina: nyan hana beda dari rasa teumakot pribadi dan hana galak keu hal-hal laen yang na le that ureung.

source: For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.
reference: Keu ladom ureueng, peumahaman akan hai tentang kiban cara kapai phe nyan di phe ngön peue nyang roh watèe kapai nyan di phe mungkén akan jeut keu saboh cara ureueng nyan geu lawan ye nyang meu dasar bak hai nyang hana ta teupue ngön nyang hanjeut ta kendali.
hypothesis: Bagi padum-padum droe, meuphom bacut tentang pakriban pesawat meubuet dan peu nyang teujadi seulama meulayang jeut membantu keu meukalahkan rasa teumakot nyang didasarkan bak nyang hana jituri atawa bak hana jeut ji kontrol.

source: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair.
reference: Perusahaan-perusahaan intat barang nyan got that dibayeue untuk intat barang beu bagah. Kayem that, watèe nyan utama that untuk dokumen bisnis, barang meukat atawa bahan-bahan nyang peureulèe keu peuget barang.
hypothesis: Perusahaan kurir dipeubayeue get untuk peutaba barang seucara bagah. seureng, wate sangat peunteng deungen dokumen bisnis, barang dagangan atau suku cadang untuk perbaikan nyang mendesak.

source: On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem.
reference: Keu ladom arah jak, perusahaan nyang leubéh rayek na kapai phe khusus atra awak nyan, tapi keu ladom arah jak nyang laén ngön ladom peurusahaan nyang ubeut na masalah disinan.
hypothesis: Bak padum-padum boh rute, perusahaan rayek na pesawat jih keudroe, teutapi untuk rute laen ngen perusahaan ubit na masalah.

source: If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs.
reference: Meunyoe awak nyan di kirem barang deungön kapai phe, bak ladom arah jak mungkén trok sampoe meu uroe-uroe keu jipeutreun barang ngön buet adat.
hypothesis: Meunyoe barang-barang nyan ji kirém ngon barang udara, bak padum-padum boh rot mungken treb jih padum-padum uroe sigohlom barang nyan ji peuleuh barang dan ji peujak lam bea cukai.

source: The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
reference: Saboh-saboh jih cara bah jeut leubéh bagah bak takirem nyankeuh deungön di cek barang. Aturan maskapai han jeut di kirem barang lé awak nyan meunyoe hana peunumpang, nyan keuh nyan saat droenueh neu tamong.
hypothesis: Nyang jeut keu cara nyang leubeh bagah adalah ta kirem nyan seubagoe barang nyang ka teurekam.

source: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).
reference: Cara nyang jeulah beujeut teureubang di glah phon atawa glah bisnis nyan keuh beujai tapeutubit peng keu hak istimewa nyan (atawa, leubeh get lom talakee peurusahaan droeneuh peubut keu gata).
hypothesis: Cara nyang jeulaih keu meulayang di kelas phon atawa bisnis adalah keu meutanggong jaweueb saboh beulanja nyang le keu hak istimewa nyan (atawa, leubeh get lom, peuget perusahaan gata untuk meutanggong jaweueb keu gata).

source: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!
reference: Tapi, nyoe hana murah : lagee lam sigra, droeneuh jeuet neuharap bayeu peuet go lipat dari yum ekonomi biasajih keu glah bisnis, ngon siblah go u glah phon.
hypothesis: Namun, nyoe hana murah: seubagai aturan jempol, awak jeut ta harapkan untuk membayar hingga peuet kali tarif ekonomi biasa untuk bisnis, ngen sebelas kali untuk kelas phon!

source: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.
reference: Seucara umum jih, hana meuguna tamita kureueng yum bangku glah bisnis atawa glah phon nibak penerbangan lansong poe dari A u B.
hypothesis: Seucara umum, hana guna bahkan untuk mita diskon untuk bisnis atau kursi kelas phon bak penerbangan langsung dari A keu B.

source: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
reference: Maskapai kapai teureubang get that itupeue nyang bahwa na sekelompok khusus dari peunumpang kapai nyang tem bayeu meuhai keu meuteumee hak istemewa keu meurumpok teumpat duek nyang bagah ngon mangat, deungon yum nyang sesuai.
hypothesis: Maskapai sadar that bahwa na kelompok inti tertentu dari peungungunggang nyang bersedia membayar dolar utama untuk hak istimewa untuk mencapai tempat yang cepat dan nyaman, dan biaya sesuai.

source: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.
reference: Ibukuta Moldova nakeuh Chisinau. Basa daerahjih nyan keuh Rumania. Tapi jai nyang peugahba basa Rusia.
hypothesis: Nang nanggroe Moldova nakeuh Chişinău. Bahsa lokaljih nakeuh basa Rumania, teutapi basa Rusia kayém geungui.

source: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.
reference: Moldova nyan keuh saboh reupublik multi-etnis nyang ka sep jra dari komplik etnis.
hypothesis: Moldova adalah republik multi-etnis nyang ka menderita konflik etnis.

source: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.
reference: Nibak thôn 1994, komplik nyoe keuh na peumbeuntukan reupublik Transnistria nyang i proklamirkan keudroejih hideh di Moldova bahgian timu, ka na peumeuritahan droe ngön peng droe tapi hana jiakuai lé nangroe-nanggroe yang na lam PBB.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1994, konflik nyo meuakibatkeue peuneudikan Republik Transnistria nyang geupeunan droe jih di Moldova timu, yeng na pemerintah dan mata uang jih keudroe teutapi hana diakui le nanggroe anggota PBB.

source: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.
reference: Sinambong ekonomi ka geupeugot lom antara dua boh bahgian Moldova adak pih keuseupakatan hana meuhasé.
hypothesis: Hubongan ekonomi ka dipeudeng lom antara dua bagian Moldova nyan meskipun gagal lam negosiasi politik.

source: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
reference: Pang ule agama di Moldova nyan keuh agama kristen ortodoks.
hypothesis: Agama nyang paleng rayeuk di Moldova na kheueh Kristen Ortodoks.

source: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.
reference: Izmir nakeuh kuta keu lhèe paléng rayek di Turki deungön mandum ureueng 3,7 juta, peulabuhan keudua paléng rayek lheuh Instanbul ngön pusat trasnportasi nyang get.
hypothesis: Izmir adalah kota paleng rayek keu lhee di Turki deungen populasi sekitar 3,7 juta, pelabuhan paleng rayek keudua lheh Istanbul, ngen pusat transportasi nyang that get.

source: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.
reference: Masa dilèe Smyrna kuta jameun, jinoe ka moderen, ka maju, kajeut keu pusat komersial, ka jiato peurdagangan rayek ngön jilingka lé gunong gunong.
hypothesis: Yoh masa ilée banda Smyrna kuno, jinoe na kheueh pusat komersial nyang modern, maju, dan rame, teuduek di seukeulileng teluk nyang rayeuk dan jikeulileng lé gunong-gunong.

source: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.
reference: Jalan rayek nyang luah, rumoh binteh kaca ngön pusat beulanja moderen nyang dipungui deungön ubong mirah, pasai abad keu-18, seumeujid tuha ngön geureja, adak pih kuta nyoe keuadaanjih lebeh teurasa Eropa Mediterranean daripada meuTurki.
hypothesis: Boulevards luah, bangunan kaca dan pusat perbelanjaan modern meucangkok deungen atap ubin merah tradisional, pasar abad keu-18, dan masjid ngon gereja tuha, meskipun kota nyoe na suasana Eropa Mediterania leubeh dari Turki tradisional.

source: The village of Haldarsvík offer views of the nearby island Eysturoy and has an unusual octagonal church.
reference: Gampong Hardarsvik deuh peumandangan toe pulo Eysturoy ngön saboh geureja lapan boh sagoe nyang langka.
hypothesis: Desa Haldarsvík na pemandangan pulau Eysturoy di teukeutika nyan dan na saboh geurija segi lapan yang hana biasa.

source: In the churchyard, there are interesting marble sculptures of doves over some tombs.
reference: Bak leun geureja, hinan na patong mirahpati marmar nyang lagak diateuh padit padum boh kubu.
hypothesis: Di kubu, na patung marmer nyang menarik dari cicem mirah pati di ateuh padum-padum boh kubu.

source: It's worth half an hour to stroll about the intriguing village.
reference: Beuna watèe meu siteungoeh jeum meunyoe tasaweu bak gampong lagak nyan.
hypothesis: Nyan layak sijeumpoe watee untuk geujak-jak di gampong nyang menarik.

source: To the north and within easy reach is the romantic and fascinating town of Sintra and which was made famous to foreigners after a glowing account of its splendours recorded by Lord Byron.
reference: U bahgian baroh ngön mangat ta jangkau nyan keuh kuta Sintra nyang lagak ngön meunawan até ngön nyan keuh meusyeuhu bak ureueng luwa lhueh akun nyang meucahya meugah nyan jipeugot lé Lord Byron.
hypothesis: Di utara ngon mudah ji peuget na kota Sintra nyang romantis ngon menarik dan nyang meusyeuhu keu ureung lua nanggroe lheuh laporan yang meucahya tentang keindahan jih yang dicatat le Lord Byron.

source: Scotturb Bus 403 travels regularly to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.
reference: Scotturb Bus 403 dijak sabèe u Sintra, didong di Capo da Raca.
hypothesis: Scotturb Bus 403 meupeujak secara teratur u Sintra, meupeudong di Cabo da Roca.

source: Also to the north visit the great Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), a place of worldwide famous Marian apparitions.
reference: Na sit u baroh jak saweu teumpat suci ureueng inong Fatima (kuil), deuh takalon Mariah nyang meusyehu ban sigom dônya.
hypothesis: Meunan cit di utara jak kunjungi Kuil rayeuk Our Lady of Fatima (Kuil), saboh teumpat penampakan Marian nyang meusyeuhu di mandum donya.

source: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
reference: Neu ingat bahawasanjih droe neuh neujak kalon kubu ureueng ramé, lage situs nyang karap hana ék takira keu sibahgian rayek ureung di dônya.
hypothesis: Harap ingat bahwa awak nyoe seucara peunteng ka tajak bak saboh kuburan massal, seurta saboh teumpat nyang na makna nyang hana hase teubataih keu sebagian rayek populasi donya.

source: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
reference: Hinan manteng na padit droe ureung inong ngön ureung agam nyang udép nyang seulamat sampoe jinoe, ngön na padum droe ureueng-ureung nyang geu gaseh ka dipoh atawa geukeurija sampoe matèe geuh hinan, yahudi ngön kon yahudi saban.
hypothesis: Na le ureung agam ngon inong nyang mantong udep nyang seulamat dari masa awaknyan di sinoe, dan le lom nyang na ureung nyang ta cinta nyang jipoh mate atawa bekerja sampoe mate di sinan, Yahudi ngon kon Yahudi.

source: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
reference: Neutulông jaga situs nyan ngön harkat, martabat ngön hormat. Bèk neumeuayang tentang Holokaus atawa Nazi.
hypothesis: Neulakee bak teumpat nyan deungon martabat, hormat dan hormat nyang patot.

source: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
reference: Bèk peureuloh situs deungön taboh tanda atawa ta ceu-ceu grafiti lam peuneuduek.
hypothesis: Bék peugadoh situs ngen meucanda atawa meucula grafiti bak struktur.

source: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.
reference: Basa reusmi Barcelona nyan keuh basa catalan ngön basa Spanyol. Sang ladom na nyang brat galak meututo basa catalan, ladom jai nyang meuphom basa nyan, ngön karab mandum ureueng geuteupue basa Spanyol.
hypothesis: Bahsa resminya Barcelona nakeuh Catalan ngon Spanyol. Kira-kira siteungoh leubeh galak peugah Catalan, mayoritas rayeuk meuphom jih, dan seucara praktis mandum ureueng meutume bahasa Spanyol.

source: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
reference: Adakpih, ladom jai tanda dipeutunyok lam basa catalan sabab nyan ka jiteutapkan lé hukôm seubagoe basa reusmi nyang keu phôn.
hypothesis: Namun, seubagian rayek tanda hanya ditanda bak bahasa Catalan kareuna nyan dipeuteutapkan le undang-undang seubagai bahasa resmi phon.

source: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
reference: Basa Spanyol pih jai jipaké bak angkotan umum ngön fasilitas nyang laén sit.
hypothesis: Teuma, basa Spanyol cit ji pakek bak angkutan umum ngon fasilitas laen jih.

source: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
reference: Peungumuman bak Metro sabèe jipeugoet lam basa Catalan, tapi na gangguan nyang hana ireuncanakan lé sistem otomatih jitamong dumpue basa lage basa spanyol, basa Inggreh, basa Prancis, basa Arab ngön basa Jeupang.
hypothesis: Pengumuman biasa di Metro hanya di peuget lam bahasa Catalan, teutapi gangguan yang hana direncanakan di peugah le sistem otomatis lam meubagoe macam bahasa termasuk Spanyol, Inggris, Prancis, Arab dan Jepang.

source: Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant.
reference: Ureueng Paris na wibawa seubagoe ureueng nyang, egosentris, gasa, ngön teukaboe.
hypothesis: Ureueng Paris na reputasi keu droejih nyang egois, hana sopan dan sombong.

source: While this is often only an inaccurate stereotype, the best way to get along in Paris still is to be on your best behavior, acting like someone who is "bien élevé" (well brought up). It will make getting about considerably easier.
reference: Seumeuntara nyoe kayem sit na saboh peunilaian nyang hana akurat, cara nyang get nak bèk karu di Paris nyan keuh beu get akai, ta pubuet lage sidroe ureung "bien eleve" (jipeurayek deungön get). Nyan keuh nyan nyang peugot peurjalanan nyang jioh jeut keu mudah.
hypothesis: Meskipun nyoe seureng jih hanya stereotip nyang hana teupat, cara nyang paleng get keu meupeurab di Paris teutap adalah meupeuget perilaku nyang paleng get, meupeuget lagee sidroe nyang "bien élevé" (meuteumei) nyan akan meupeuget meupeuget meupeuget meupeuget lebeh mudah.

source: Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies.
reference: Urueng luwa Paris lam sigra seumeungeup meunyoe ta peuleumah padit-padit boh asai keusopanan.
hypothesis: Keudeh luwa Paris nyang teukeujot akan bagaih meunyum meunyoe gata peuleumah sopan santun.

source: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.
reference: Taman nasional danou Plitvice uteun nyang leuhu, keu phôn that deungön pasi, bak-bak ceumara, nyang deuh meujampue vegetasi Alpin ngön Mediterania.
hypothesis: Taman nasional Danau Plitvice lebeh lebeh kayee, terutama deungen pohon beech, cemara, ngen pohon cemara, ngen na campuran vegetasi Alpen ngen Mediterania.

source: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.
reference: Nyan na komunitah bak kayèe meubagoe rupa sabab jangkauan iklim mikro, tanoh nyang meubeda, ngön meubagoe tingkatan.
hypothesis: Jih na variasi komunitas tanaman yeng luah, kareuna jangkauan mikroklimat jih, tanoh yeng meubeda ngen tingkat ketinggian yeng meubeda.

source: The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species.
reference: Wilayah nyan sit na rumoh keu meubagoe meulatang ngön ticem.
hypothesis: Wilayah nyoe cit na meubagoe macam spesies binatang ngon cicem.

source: Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
reference: Fauna langka lagèe cagee Eropa wareuna coklat, seurigala, kleung, jampok, lynx, miong garong, ngön capercaillie ta tumèe hinan, ngön mandum jeuneh nyang leubéh umum
hypothesis: Fauna langka lage beruang coklat eropa, srigala, elang, lalat, lynx, kucing liar dan capercaillie jeut ditumeng di sinan, seulaen le spesies yang leubeh umum

source: While visiting the monasteries, women are required to wear skirts covering the knees and have their shoulders covered, too.
reference: Watèe jak kalon biara, ureung inong diyue sok rok nyang teutop tuot ngön teutop baho sit.
hypothesis: Wate ji kunjungi biara, ureung inong dipaksa untuk geungui rok yang jitôb lutot dan na bahu yang jitôb cit.

source: Most of the monasteries do provide wraps for women who come unprepared, but if you bring your own, especially one with bright colors, you'll get a smile from the monk or nun at the entrance.
reference: Ladom jai awak biara sit jipeusiap ija keu ureueng inong nyang jak hana peursiapan, tapi meunyoe neumè keudroe, nyang wareuna nyang trang, droeneuh dipeukhem lé biksu atawa biksuni bak pinto tamong.
hypothesis: Le that biara na peungikat keu ureung inong nyang hana teulaksana, tapi meunyoe droeneuh neuba keudroe, terutama nyang na warna meukilat, droeneuh akan neumeumeumeungem nibak biksu atawa biarawan bak pintoe.

source: Along the same line, men are required to wear trousers covering the knees.
reference: Meunan sit sama, ureueng agam diyue sok siluweu panyang beu teutop tuot.
hypothesis: Seulaen jih, ureung agam dijak peungui celana yang teutôb lutot.

source: This too can be borrowed from the stock at the entrance but that clothing isn't washed after every user so you may not feel comfortable wearing these skirts. One size fits all for men!
reference: Nyoe pih jeut neulake siat bak pinto tamong, tapi bajèe hana dirah lheuh padit-padit droe ureung sok sampoe droe neuh mungkén meurasa hana mangat neu sok rok nyan. Saboh ukuran jeut sok keu mandum ureung agam!
hypothesis: Nyoe cit jeut neupileh bak stok bak babah pintoe tapi peukayan nyan hana ji rhah lheuh ji pakek mandum jadi awak nyoe mungken hana nyaman dipakek rok nyoe. saboh ukuran cocok mandum untuk ureung agam!

source: Majorcan cuisine, like that of similar zones in the Mediterranean, is based on bread, vegetables and meat (specially pork), and uses olive oil throughout.
reference: Masakan Majorcan, lage daerah nyang saban di Mediterania, asai jih ruti, gule, ngön sie (khusus jih sie bui) ngön iboh minyeuk zaitun bak mandum bahgian jih.
hypothesis: Masakan Mallorca, lage yang na di zona yang sama di Mediterania, didasarkan bak ruti, sayuran dan daging (khusus jih daging babi), dan menggunakan minyak zaitun secara keseluruhan.

source: A simple popular dinner, especially during the summer, is the Pa amb Oli: Bread with olive oil, tomato, and any available condiments such as cheese, tunafish, etc.
reference: Pajoh bu malam nyang seudeurhana ngön paléng geuturi, khusohjih watèe musem suum, nyan keuh Pa amb Oli, ruti ngön minyeuk zaitun, boh tomat ngön bumbue pue-pue nyang na lage keju, eungkot tuna atawa nyan laén.
hypothesis: Saboh makanan biasa, terutama bak musim panas, adalah Pa amb Oli: Roti deungen minyeuk zaiton, tomat, dan bumbu-bumbu nyang na lage keju, ikan tuna, dll.

source: All nouns, alongside the word Sie for you, always begin with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.
reference: Mandum kata benda, asai sajan kata Sie keu droe neuh, sabèe jimulai deungön huruh rayek, bahpih bak teungoh-teungoh kalimat.
hypothesis: Bandum nan, di likot kata Sie keu droeneuh, sabe dimulai deungen huruf kapital, bahkan di teungoh kalimat.

source: This is an important way to distinguish between some verbs and objects.
reference: Nyoe keuh cara penteng keu peubeda antara padum boh kata keureja ngön objek.
hypothesis: Nyo adalah cara peunteng untuk meubeda antara padim boh kata kerja ngen objek.

source: It also arguably makes reading easier, though writing is somewhat complicated by the need to find out whether a verb or adjective is used in a substantivized form.
reference: Hai nyan keuh jeut takhen nyang peugot meubaca leubéh mangat, bahpih teumuleh bacut payah sabab peureulé ta tupeue pue nyan kata keureja atawa kata sipheut nyan jipaké lam beuntok kata nyang seubetoijih.
hypothesis: Nyo cit jeut dipeugah jeut dipeuget baca leubeh mudah, meskipun menulis agak rumit karena peurlee untuk meuteume peu kata kerja atau kata sifat dipakek dalam bentuk substansi.

source: Pronunciation is relatively easy in Italian since most words are pronounced exactly how they are written
reference: Peulafai basa Italia leubéh mudah sabab jai kata nyang jikhen hie lage deungön nyang jituleh
hypothesis: Pengucapan relatif mudah lam bahasa Italia kareuna le kata yang di ucapkan persis lagee yang di tuleh

source: The main letters to watch out for are c and g, since their pronunciation varies based on the following vowel.
reference: Huruh nyang beu meuleuhen-luehen c ngön g, sabab peulafai huruh nyan meumacam bagoe kiban huruh vokal aleuhjih.
hypothesis: Huruf utama yang harus diperhatikan adalah c ngen g, kareuna pengucapan jih bervariasi berdasarkan vokal yang di ikot.

source: Also, make sure to pronounce r and rr differently: caro means dear, whereas carro means chariot.
reference: Pih, buena tapeuteuntèe keu peulafai r ngön rr deungön cara meubeda: caro meumakna gaseh, meusu carro meumakna moto.
hypothesis: Meunan cit, pastikan untuk meupeugah r ngen rr beda: caro meuarti sayang, sedangkan carro meuarti geuritan.

source: Persian has a relatively easy and mostly regular grammar.
reference: Basa Persia leubéh mudah ngön bacut meuatô.
hypothesis: Bahasa Persia na tata bahasa nyang relatif mudah dan seubagian rayek biasa.

source: Therefore, reading this grammar primer would help you learn much about Persian grammar and understand phrases better.
reference: Leubéh nibak nyan, deungön tabaca buku tata basa nyoe meubantu droeneuh meurunoe tata basa Persia ngön meuphom kata leubéh get.
hypothesis: Oleh karena nyan, baca buku dasar tata bahasa nyoe akan membantu gata keu meutume le tentang tata bahasa Persia dan leubeh meuphom kalimat.

source: Needless to say, if you know a Romance language, it will be easier for you to learn Portuguese.
reference: Tentejih, meunyoe droeneuh meuphom basa Roman, nyan jeut leubéh mudah keu droeneuh nemeurunoe basa Portugis.
hypothesis: Hana peureulée tapeugah, meunyoe gata na pengetahuan basa Romance, nyan leubeh mudah keu gata keu gata meurunoe basa Portugis.

source: However, people who know a little Spanish may hastily conclude that Portuguese is close enough that it need not be studied separately.
reference: Adak pih, ramé ureueng nyang meuphom bacut basa Spayol mengken jipiké basa Portugis sep hie deungön basa nyan sampoe hana peurlèe lé meurunoe meupisah.
hypothesis: Teuma, ureuëng nyang bacut that jiteupeu basa Spanyol mungken deungon bagaih-bagaih jipeuphon peugah bahwa basa Portugis nyan hana peureulée teumeurunoe keudroe.

source: Pre-modern observatories are usually obsolete today, and remain as museums, or sites of education.
reference: Obeservatorium seugohlom moderen nyan biasajih ka meujameun jinoe, ngön teutap seubagoe museum atawa situs peudidek.
hypothesis: Observatorium pra-modern biasa jih hana le meuguna saat nyo, ngen teutap seubagoe museum, atau teumpat pendidikan.

source: As light pollution in their heyday was not the kind of problem it is today, they are usually located in cities or at campuses, easier to reach than those built in modern times.
reference: Sabab wab brok cahya bak masa jaya nyan kon jeuneh peukara jinoe, wab brok nyan biasajih di kuta-kuta atawa kampus-kampus, leubéh mangat meutume nibak ta peudong bak jameun jinoe.
hypothesis: Kareuna polusi cahaya bak masa keujayaan awak nyan hana masalah lagee saat nyoe, awak nyan biasa jih na di kota atau di kampus, leubeh mudah ji akses daripada yang dibangun bak masa modern.

source: Most modern research telescopes are enormous facilities in remote areas with favorable atmospheric conditions.
reference: Jai teleskop peuneuliti moderen nyan keuh teumpat nyang rayek bak dairah-dairah deungön keuadaan cuwaca nyang get.
hypothesis: Sebagian rayek teleskop penelitian modern adalah fasilitas rayek di daerah terpencil deungen kondisi atmosfer nyang meubajikan.

source: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.
reference: Bungong Ceri, jikheun seubagoe hanami, nyan kajeut keu bahgian nibak reusam Jeupang nibak trep abad keu 8.
hypothesis: Meungieng bungong ceri, nyang dikenal seubagoe hanami, ka jeut keu bagian dari budaya Jepang seujak abad keu-8.

source: The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice.
reference: Konsep nyan trok nibak Cina, bungong plum seubagoe bungong teulebeh.
hypothesis: Konsep nyan teuka dari Cina di pat bungong prune adalah bungong nyang geupileh.

source: In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.
reference: Di Jeupang, Khanduri-khanduri bungong ceri keu phôn geupeugot lé Raja-raja keu droegeuh ngön keu ureueng-ureueng teupandang bak meuligoe.
hypothesis: Di Jepang, pesta bunga ceri phon dipeuget le kaisar hanya untuk droe jih dan anggota aristokrasi laen di sekitar Istana Kaisar.

source: Plants look their best when in a natural environment, so resist the temptation to remove even "just one" specimen.
reference: Seulaman takalon leubéh get watèe di lingkungan, jadi leubéh itheun godaan keu peugadoh nyan keuh “saboh sagai" jeuneh.
hypothesis: Tanaman deuh jih paleng get meunyoe lam lingkungan alami, jadi lawan godaan keu tapeuteubiet bahkan "saboh mantong" spesimen.

source: If visiting a formally arranged garden, collecting "specimens" is also going to get you ejected, without discussion.
reference: Miseu tajak kalon saboh lampoh geupeugot, peusapat "spesimen" jeut dipubuet gata dipeuteubit, hana jimeuduk.
hypothesis: Meunye tajak taman yang dipeurenah secara formal, meukumplot "spesimen" cit akan jeut keu alasan awak nyan ji peulheuh, hana diskusi.

source: Singapore is generally an extremely safe place to be and very easy to navigate, and you can buy almost anything after arriving.
reference: Singapura bak umumjih nakeuh teumpat nyang aman keu tajak kalon ngön mudah that takalon arah, ngön gata jeut bloe karap mandum watèe troh.
hypothesis: Singapura umum jih merupakan teumpat nyang aman dan mudah untuk di peuget, dan awak jeut neubloe mandum barang lheuh troh.

source: But being placed in the "high tropics" just a few degrees north of equator you will need to deal with both heat (always) and strong sun (when the sky is clear, more rarely).
reference: Tapi kareuna diduk di "tropis manyang" padum deurajat sagai di baroh khatulistiwa gata payah tatheun suum (sabèe) ngön mata uroe tarek (watèe langet trang, leubéh jareung).
hypothesis: "Tapi dipeuduek di daerah tropis tinggi" hanya padum derajat utara khatulistiwa, awak nyan haroh meuprang deungen hawa panas (seugala-galom) ngen sinar mata uroe nyang teuga (meunyoe langet jih gleh, leubeh jarang).

source: There are also a few buses going north to Hebron, the traditional burial place of the Biblical patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and their wives.
reference: Na cit padum boh bus dijak u baroh u Hebron, teumpat kubu tradisional ureueng Alkitab Abraham, Ishak, Yakub, ngön peureumoh ureungnyan.
hypothesis: Na cit padum boh beus nyang jak u utara u Hebron, teumpat teukubu tradisional indatu Alkitab, Nabi Ibrahim, Nabi Ishaq, Nabi Yakub, dan peurumoh-peurumoh awaknyan.

source: Check that the bus you are thinking of taking goes into Hebron and not just to the nearby Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.
reference: Tapeuteuntèe bus nyang keuneuk gata ék u Herbon ngön kon, toe that deungön peumukiman Yahudi Kiryat Arba.
hypothesis: Periksa bahwa beus nyang gata pike keu gata jak u Hebron dan kon keutapi keulayi keulayi keulayi keulayi keulayi keulayi keulayi keulayi keulayi Yahudi Kiryat Arba.

source: Inland waterways can be a good theme to base a holiday around.
reference: Peurairan peudalaman jeut keu tema nyang get keu asai jak meuramien.
hypothesis: Jalur ie pedalaman jeut keu tema yang get untuk dipeudong liburan di sekitar jih.

source: For example visiting castles in the Loire Valley, the Rhine valley or taking a cruise to interesting cites on the Danube or boating along the Erie Canal.
reference: Miseujih tajak kalon kastil di Panton Loire, Panton Rhine, atawa meulaôt u teumpat-teumpat nyang get di Danube atawa ék jaloe ban saboh Kanal Erie.
hypothesis: Miseu jih jak ke kastil di Loire Valley, Rhine Valley atau jak peusawat ke kota-kota yang menarik di Danube atau meulayeue di sepanjang Erie Canal.

source: They also define routes for popular hiking and cycling trails.
reference: Awak nyan pih geupegah rute meusyeuhu jak deungön aki ngön ék itangen.
hypothesis: Awak nyan cit meupeutente rute untuk jalan raya populer dan jalur bersepeda.

source: Christmas is one of the most important holidays of Christianity, and is celebrated as the birthday of Jesus.
reference: Natal nakeuh salah saboh uroe raya peunteng keu ureueng kristen, geurayakan sebagoe uroe lahèe Yesus.
hypothesis: Natal adalah salah saboh uroe raya nyang paleng peunteng bak agama Kristen, dan dipeurayaan seubagai uroe lahir Isa.

source: Many of the traditions surrounding the holiday have been adopted also by non-believers in Christian countries and non-Christians around the world.
reference: Na padum boh tradisi di seulingka liburan nyan jitirèe ureueng non-Kristen di nanggroe-nanggroe Kristen ngön ureung non-Kristen ban sigom dônya.
hypothesis: Le tradisi nyang na di seukeulileng uroe raya nyoe kaleuh ji adopsi cit le ureung nyang hana meuiman di nanggroe-nanggroe Kristen dan ureung nyang hana Kristen di seukitar donya.

source: There's a tradition to pass the Easter night awake at some exposed point to see the sunrise.
reference: Na tradisi keu peu leupah malam Paskah deungön meujaga bak padum boh titek teuhah keneuk kalon mata uroe teubit.
hypothesis: Na tradisi untuk meupeutubiet malam Paskah beu teungeut bak saboh teumpat nyang teuhah keu neukalon mata uroe jiteubiet.

source: There are of course Christian theological explanations for this tradition, but it may well be a pre-Christian Spring and Fertility ritual.
reference: Teuntèe na peunjelasan teologis kristen keu tradisi nyoe, tapi nyoe jeut keu musem seumi Pra-Kristen ngön ritual keusuburan.
hypothesis: Na penjelasan teologis Kristen untuk tradisi nyoe, tapi mungken nyoe ritual Musim Semi dan Keberhasilan pra-Kristen.

source: More traditional churches often hold an Easter Vigil on Saturday night during the Easter weekend, with the congregations often breaking into celebration at the stroke of midnight to celebrate Christ's resurrection.
reference: Geureja-geureja nyang leubéh tradisional kayem geupeugöt malam Paskah nibak Sabtu malam bak akhe peukan Paskah, deungön jamaat kayem peumeuriah peurayaan bak teungoh malam keu geurayakan keubangkitan Kristus.
hypothesis: Geurusi nyang leubeh tradisional seureng meujalankan Easter Vigil bak malam Sabtu seulama akhir pekan Paskah, deungen jemaat seureng meujalankan perayaan bak teungoh malam untuk meupeurayaan kebangkitan Almaseh.

source: All animals that originally arrived in the islands came here either by swimming, flying or floating.
reference: Mandum meulatang nyang phônjih troh u pulo-pulo jak keuno deungön meulangue, dipo atawa meuapong.
hypothesis: Bandum binatang nyang awai teuka u pulo-pulo nyan teuka keunoe meunyo meulayeue, meulayang atawa meulayang.

source: Due to the long distance from the continent mammals were unable to make the journey making the giant tortoise the primary grazing animal in the Galapagos.
reference: Sabab jarak nyang jioh dari beunua, mamalia han jeut dijak makajih baneng raksasa jeut keu meulatang geumbala nyang phôn di Galapagos.
hypothesis: Kareuna jarak jih rayek dari benua mamalia hana jeut meujak meujampu nyang jeut keu penyu raksasa binatang penggembala utama di Galapagos.

source: Since the arrival of man to the Galapagos, many mammals have been introduced including goats, horses, cows, rats, cats and dogs.
reference: Seujak dijak ureung u Galapagos, lë mamalia ka geupeuturi teumasok kameng, guda, leumo, tikoh, miong, ngön asèe.
hypothesis: Seujak teuka manusia u Galapagos, le mamalia kaleuh ji peuturi termasuk kambing, guda, sapi, tikus, kucing dan anjing.

source: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic areas in the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun doesn't rise above the horizon.
reference: Miseu gata jak u daerah Arktik atawa Antartika bak musem leupie ka tarasa malam kutub, nyang meumakna matauroe hana diteubit di ateuh cakrawala.
hypothesis: Meunyo droeneuh tajak u daerah Arktik atawa Antartika bak musem leupie, droeneuh akan ta alami malam kutub, yang meuarti uroe hana jiteubiet di ateuh cakrawala.

source: This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock.
reference: Nyoe nakeuh keusempatan nyang get kalon Aurora borealis, kareuna langet ka supot sabèe.
hypothesis: Nyo na kesempatan yang get untuk melihat Aurora borealis, karena langet akan gelap seutiap uroe.

source: As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.
reference: Kareuna daerah nyoe jareung na peunduduk, polusi hana jeut keu masalah, gata jeut mangat bak mata teuh deuh bintang-bintang.
hypothesis: Kareuna daerah-daerah nyan hana le penduduk, ngen polusi cahaya deungen nyan seureng hana masalah, gata akan jeut cit menikmati bintang-bintang.

source: Japanese work culture is more hierarchical and formal that what Westerners may be used to.
reference: Budaya keureuja Jeupang leubéh hirarkis ngön formal daripada nyang biasa dipubuet lé awak Barat.
hypothesis: Budaya kerja Jepang leubeh hierarkis ngen formal daripada nyang biasa ureung Barat.

source: Suits are standard business attire, and coworkers call each other by their family names or by job titles.
reference: Jas nakeuh bajèe bisnis nyang standar, ngön rakan keureuja saleng sapa nan keuluarga atawa nan jabatan.
hypothesis: Sutu adalah pakaian bisnis standar, dan rakan kerja saling memanggil deungen nan keluarga atawa deungen geular pekerjaan.

source: Workplace harmony is crucial, emphasizing group effort rather than praising individual accomplishments.
reference: Keuharmonisan teumpat keureuja seb brat peunteng, leubéh penteng keurija grup daripada geupujoe keurija sidroe-droe ureueng.
hypothesis: Harmoni di teumpat kerja sangat peunteng, nyang menekankan usaha kelompok daripada jipujoe pencapaian individu.

source: Workers must often get their superiors' approval for any decisions they make, and are expected to obey their superiors' instructions without question.
reference: Ureung keureuja suah dijok keuseupakatan ureueng rayek awak nyan keu mandum keuputusan nyang awak nyan peugot, ngön beu dipateh keu intruksi ureueng rayek awaknyan, bèk na tanyong-teumanyong.
hypothesis: Karyawan seureng harus mendapat persetujuan atasan awak nyan untuk keputusan yang awak nyan peuget, ngen diharapkan untuk taát instruksi atasan awak nyan tanpa pertanyaan.
